--input experince values, output level

local ExperienceCalculator = {}
local ExperienceFactor = 10

local function GetLevelFromExperience(Experience)
	-- http://stackoverflow.com/questions/6954874/php-game-formula-to-calculate-a-level-based-on-exp
	
	return math.floor((ExperienceFactor + math.sqrt(ExperienceFactor * ExperienceFactor - 4 * ExperienceFactor * (-Experience)))/ (2 * ExperienceFactor))
end
ExperienceCalculator.GetLevelFromExperience = GetLevelFromExperience

local function GetExperienceForNextLevel(CurrentExperience)
	if CurrentExperience - 1 == CurrentExperience then -- Math.huge
		return 0
	end
	
	local CurrentLevel = GetLevelFromExperience(CurrentExperience)
	local ExperienceRequired = ExperienceFactor*(CurrentLevel*(1+CurrentLevel))
	--local ExperienceRequiredForCurrentLevel = ExperienceFactor*(CurrentLevel*(1+CurrentLevel))

	local ExperienceLeft = ExperienceRequired - CurrentExperience
	
	return ExperienceLeft
end
ExperienceCalculator.GetExperienceForNextLevel = GetExperienceForNextLevel



local function GetExperienceRequiredForLevel(Level)
	Level = Level - 1 -- Because normally this formula calculates experience required for next level.
	return ExperienceFactor*(Level*(1+Level))
end

ExperienceCalculator.GetExperienceRequiredForLevel = GetExperienceRequiredForLevel


local function GetSubExperience(CurrentExperience)
	-- @return Achieved of next level, Total required for next level, Percent
	
	if CurrentExperience - 1 == CurrentExperience then -- Math.huge
		return 1,1,1
	end
	
	local CurrentLevel = GetLevelFromExperience(CurrentExperience)
	local LastLevel = CurrentLevel-1
	
	local ExperienceRequiredForCurrentLevel = ExperienceFactor*(LastLevel*(1+LastLevel))
	local ExperienceRequired = ExperienceFactor*(CurrentLevel*(1+CurrentLevel))
	

	
	local AchievedOfNext = CurrentExperience - ExperienceRequiredForCurrentLevel 
	local SubTotalRequired = ExperienceRequired - ExperienceRequiredForCurrentLevel
	local Percent = AchievedOfNext/SubTotalRequired
	
	return AchievedOfNext, SubTotalRequired, Percent
end
ExperienceCalculator.GetSubExperience = GetSubExperience

return ExperienceCalculator

-- Adds an os.date() function back to the Roblox os table!
-- More precise than qTime (doesn't use 365.25 days per year)
-- Abbreviated tables have been left in for now. Could be replaced with dayNames[wday + 1]:sub(1,3)

-- @author Narrev

local firstRequired = os.time()

return {
	help = function(...) return 
	[[Note: Padding for Months, Days, and Hours have been turned off because I don't think it looks as good
	os.date("*t") returns a table with the following indices:
	hour	14
	min	36
	wday	1
	year	2003
	yday	124
	month	5
	sec	33
	day	4
	String reference:
	%a	abbreviated weekday name (e.g., Wed)
	%A	full weekday name (e.g., Wednesday)
	%b	abbreviated month name (e.g., Sep)
	%B	full month name (e.g., September)
	%c	date and time (e.g., 09/16/98 23:48:10)
	%d	day of the month (16) [01-31]
	%H	hour, using a 24-hour clock (23) [00-23]
	%I	hour, using a 12-hour clock (11) [01-12]
	%n	New-line character ('\n')
	%M	minute (48) [00-59]
	%m	month (09) [01-12]
	%p	either "am" or "pm" (pm)
	%r	12-hour clock time *	02:55:02 pm
	%R	24-hour HH:MM time, equivalent to %H:%M	14:55
	%S	second (10) [00-61]
	%t	Horizontal-tab character ('\t')
	%T	Basically %r but without seconds (HH:MM AM), equivalent to %I:%M %p	2:55 pm
	%u	ISO 8601 weekday as number with Monday as 1 (1-7)	4
	%w	weekday (3) [0-6 = Sunday-Saturday]
	%x	date (e.g., 09/16/98)
	%X	time (e.g., 23:48:10)
	%Y	full year (1998)
	%y	two-digit year (98) [00-99]
	%%	the character `%�]]
	end,

	date = function(unix, opt)
		-- Precise!

		--assert(unix == nil or type(unix) == "number" or unix:find("/Date%((%d+)"), "Please input a valid number to \"getDate\"")
		
		local JSONOption = false
		local stringPassed = false
		
		if type(unix) == "string" then
			if unix:match("%d+\-%d+\-%d+T%d+:%d+:[%d%.]+.+") then -- This is for MarketPlaceService compatibility
				local year, month, day, hour, minute, second = unix:match("(%d+)\-(%d+)\-(%d+)T(%d+):(%d+):([%d%.]+).+")

				return {year = year, month = month, day = day, hour = hour, minute = minute, second = second}

			elseif unix:match("/Date%((%d+)") then -- This is for a certain JSON compatibility. It works the same even if you don't need it
				unix		= unix:match("/Date%((%d+)") / 1000
				JSONOption	= true

			elseif unix:find("*t") then
				unix		= unix:find("^!") and os.time() or opt or nil
			else
				assert(unix:find("%%"), "Invalid string passed to os.date")
				opt, unix	= unix:find("^!") and unix:sub(2) or unix, unix:find("^!") and os.time() or opt
				stringPassed = true
			end
		end

		local unix		= type(unix) == "number" and unix or tick()
		local dayCount		= function(yr) return (yr % 4 == 0 and (yr % 100 ~= 0 or yr % 400 == 0)) and 366 or 365 end
		local year		= 1970
		local days		= math.ceil(unix / 86400)
		local wday		= math.floor( (days + 3) % 7 ) -- Jan 1, 1970 was a thursday, so we add 3
		local dayNames		= {"Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"}
		local dayNamesAbbr	= {"Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"}
		local monthsAbbr	= {"Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"}
		local months, month	= {"January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"}
	--	local suffixes		= {"st", "nd", "rd", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th", "st", "nd", "rd", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th", "th", "st"}
		local hours		= math.floor(unix / 3600 % 24)
		local minutes		= math.floor(unix / 60 % 60)
		local seconds		= math.floor(unix % 60)

		 -- Calculate year and days into that year
		while days > dayCount(year) do days = days - dayCount(year) year = year + 1 end
		
		local yDay		= days

		 -- Subtract amount of days from each month until we find what month we are in and what day in that month
		for monthIndex, daysInMonth in ipairs{31,(dayCount(year) - 337),31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31} do
			if days - daysInMonth <= 0 then
				month = monthIndex
				break
			end
			days = days - daysInMonth
		end

	--	string.format("%d/%d/%04d", month, days, year) same as "%x"
	--	string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d %s", hours, minutes, seconds, period) same as "%r"

		if unix == "*t" then
			return {year = year, month = month, day = days, yday = yDay, wday = wday, hour = hours, min = minutes, sec = seconds}
		elseif JSONOption then
			return string.format("%d/%d/%04d", month, days, year)
		elseif stringPassed then
			local returner = opt
			:gsub("%%c", "%%x %%X")
			:gsub("%%x", "%%m/%%d/%%y")
			:gsub("%%T", "%%I:%%M %%p")
			:gsub("%%X", "%%H:%%M:%%S")
			:gsub("%%r", "%%I:%%M:%%S %%p")
			:gsub("%%R", "%%H:%%M")
			:gsub("%%a", dayNamesAbbr[wday + 1])
			:gsub("%%A", dayNames[wday + 1])
			:gsub("%%b", monthsAbbr[month])
			:gsub("%%B", months[month])
			:gsub("%%d", days)
			:gsub("%%H", string.format("%02d", hours))
			:gsub("%%I", hours > 12 and hours - 12 or hours == 0 and 12 or hours)
			:gsub("%%M", string.format("%02d", minutes))
			:gsub("%%m", month)
			:gsub("%%p", hours > 12 and "pm" or "am")
			:gsub("%%S", string.format("%02d", seconds))
			:gsub("%%w", wday)
			:gsub("%%Y", year)
			:gsub("%%y", year % 100)
			:gsub("%%j", yDay)
			:gsub("%%u", wday == 0 and 7 or wday)
			:gsub("%%n","\n")
			:gsub("%%t", "\t")
			:gsub("%%%%", "%%")
			return returner -- We declare returner and then return it because we don't want to return the second value of the last gsub function
		end
		
		return {year = year, month = month, day = days, yday = yDay, wday = wday, hour = hours, min = minutes, sec = seconds}
	end,
	time = function(...) return os.time(...) end,
	difftime = function(...) return os.difftime(...) end,
	clock = function(...) return os.difftime(os.time(), firstRequired) end
}

-- Bezier.lua
-- Used for interpolation curves.
-- @author Quenty

-- A good place to generate and test these out: http://cubic-bezier.com/
-- Based upon https://gist.github.com/gre/1926947#file-keyspline-js

local function BezierFactory(P1x, P1y, P2x, P2y)
	-- Same as CSS transition thing.

	assert(P1x, "[BezierFactory] - Need P1x to construct a Bezier Factory")
	assert(P1y, "[BezierFactory] - Need P1y to construct a Bezier Factory")
	assert(P2x, "[BezierFactory] - Need P2x to construct a Bezier Factory")
	assert(P2y, "[BezierFactory] - Need P2y to construct a Bezier Factory")

	local function A(aA1, aA2)
		return 1.0 - 3.0 * aA2 + 3.0 * aA1
	end

	local function B(aA1, aA2)
		return 3.0 * aA2 - 6.0 * aA1
	end

	local function C(aA1)     
		return 3.0 * aA1
	end

	-- Returns x(t) given t, x1, and x2, or y(t) given t, y1, and y2.
	local function CalculateBezier(aT, aA1, aA2)
		return ((A(aA1, aA2)*aT + B(aA1, aA2))*aT + C(aA1))*aT
	end

	-- Returns dx/dt given t, x1, and x2, or dy/dt given t, y1, and y2.
	local function GetSlope(aT, aA1, aA2)
		return 3.0 * A(aA1, aA2)*aT*aT + 2.0 * B(aA1, aA2) * aT + C(aA1)
	end

	-- Newton raphson iteration
	local function GetTForX(aX)
		local aGuessT = aX

		for Index = 1, 4 do
			local CurrentSlope = GetSlope(aGuessT, P1x, P2x)

			if CurrentSlope == 0 then
				return aGuessT
			end
			local CurrentX = CalculateBezier(aGuessT, P1x, P2x) - aX
			aGuessT = aGuessT - CurrentX / CurrentSlope
		end

		return aGuessT
	end

	return function(aX)
		-- aX is from [0, 1], it's the original time

		return CalculateBezier(GetTForX(aX), P1y, P2y)
	end
end
lib.BezierFactory = BezierFactory

function CameraUtil:GetPitchAngle(focus)
	local radius = (camera.CoordinateFrame.p - focus.Position).magnitude
	local y = camera.CoordinateFrame.p.Y - focus.Position.Y
 	return math.deg(math.asin(y/radius))
end


--rotation angle
function CameraUtil:GetYawAngle(focus)
	--local radius = (camera.CoordinateFrame.p * Vector3.new(1,0,1) - focus.Position * Vector3.new(1,0,1)).unit.magnitude
	local x = camera.CoordinateFrame.p.x - focus.Position.x
	local z = camera.CoordinateFrame.p.z - focus.Position.z
	local angle = math.deg(math.atan2(z,x))
	if angle < 0 then
		angle = 360 + angle
	end
 	return angle
end



function CameraUtil:GetCoordiantesFromAngle(angle,radius)
	local unitX = math.cos(math.rad(angle))
	local unitY = math.sin(math.rad(angle))
	local Y = unitY * radius
	local X = unitX * radius
	return X, Y
end

local TaskScheduler = {}

--[[
	param targetFps  Task scheduler won't run a task if it'd make the FPS drop below this amount
					 (WARNING) this only holds true if it is used properly. If you try to complete 10 union operations
					 at once in a single task then of course your FPS is going to drop -- queue the union operations
					 up one at a time so the task scheduler can do its job.
					
					
	returns scheduler
		method Pause      Pauses the scheduler so it won't run tasks. Tasks may still be added while the scheduler is
						  paused. They just won't be touched until it's resumed. Performance efficient -- disables 
						  renderstepped loop entirely until scheduler is resumed.
		
		method Resume     Resumes the paused scheduler.
		
		method Destroy    Destroys the scheduler so it can't be used anymore.
		
		method QueueTask  Queues a task for automatic execution.
			param callback  function (task) to be run.
	
	Example usage:
	
	local scheduler = TaskScheduler:CreateScheduler(60)
	local totalOperations = 0
	local paused
	for i=1,100 do
		scheduler:QueueTask(function()
			local partA = Instance.new("Part", workspace)
			local partB = Instance.new("Part", workspace)
			plugin:Union({partA, partB}):Destroy()
			totalOperations = totalOperations + 1
			print("Times unioned:", totalOperations)
			if totalOperations == 50 then
				scheduler:Pause()
				paused = true
			end
		end)
	end
	
	repeat wait() until paused
	wait(2)
	scheduler:Resume()
--]]
function TaskScheduler:CreateScheduler(targetFps)
	local scheduler = {}
	local queue = {}
	local sleeping = true
	local event,paused
	
	local start
	local frameUpdateTable = {}
	local sleep--get syntax highlighter to shut up on line 68
	local function onEvent()
		local iterationStart = tick()
		local targetFrameUpdates = (iterationStart-start) < 1 and math.floor(targetFps * (iterationStart-start)) or targetFps
		
		for i=#frameUpdateTable,1,-1 do
			frameUpdateTable[i+1] = (frameUpdateTable[i] >= iterationStart-1) and frameUpdateTable[i] or nil
		end
		frameUpdateTable[1] = iterationStart
		
		if #frameUpdateTable >= targetFrameUpdates then
			if #queue > 0 then
				queue[1]()
				table.remove(queue, 1)
			else
				sleep()
			end
		end
	end
	
	--used for automatically turning off renderstepped loop when there's nothing in the queue
	sleep = function()
		sleeping = true
		if event then
			event:disconnect()
			event = nil
		end
	end
	
	--turns renderstepped loop back on when something is added to the queue and scheduler isn't paused
	local function wake()
		if sleeping and not event then
			sleeping = false
			if not paused then
				start = tick()
				event = game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:connect(onEvent)
			end
		end
	end
	
	function scheduler:Pause()
		paused = true
		if event then
			event:disconnect()
			event = nil
		end
	end
	
	function scheduler:Resume()
		if paused and not event then
			paused = false
			sleeping = false
			start = tick()
			event = game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:connect(onEvent)
		end
	end
	
	function scheduler:Destroy()
		scheduler:Pause()
		for i in next,scheduler do
			scheduler[i] = nil
		end
		setmetatable(scheduler, {
			__index = function()
				error("Attempt to use destroyed scheduler")
			end;
			__newindex = function()
				error("Attempt to use destroyed scheduler")
			end;
		})
	end
	
	function scheduler:QueueTask(callback)
		queue[#queue+1] = callback 
		if sleeping then
			wake()
		end
	end
	
	start = tick()
	event = game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:connect(onEvent)
	
	return scheduler
end

return TaskScheduler

local PlayerMouse = Game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer:GetMouse()

local ScreenSpace = {}

-- Getter functions, with a couple of hacks for Ipad pre-focus.
function ScreenSpace.ViewSizeX()
	local x = PlayerMouse.ViewSizeX
	local y = PlayerMouse.ViewSizeY
	if x == 0 then
		return 1024
	else
		if x > y then
			return x
		else
			return y
		end
	end
end

function ScreenSpace.ViewSizeY()
	local x = PlayerMouse.ViewSizeX
	local y = PlayerMouse.ViewSizeY
	if y == 0 then
		return 768
	else
		if x > y then
			return y
		else
			return x
		end
	end
end

-- Nice getter for aspect ratio. Due to the checks in the ViewSize functions this
-- will never fail with a divide by zero error.
function ScreenSpace.AspectRatio()
	return ScreenSpace.ViewSizeX() / ScreenSpace.ViewSizeY()
end

-- WorldSpace -> ScreenSpace. Raw function taking a world position and giving you the
-- screen position.
function ScreenSpace.WorldToScreen(at)
	local point = Workspace.CurrentCamera.CoordinateFrame:pointToObjectSpace(at)
	local aspectRatio = ScreenSpace.AspectRatio()
	local hfactor = math.tan(math.rad(Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView)/2)
	local wfactor = aspectRatio*hfactor
	--
	local x = (point.x/point.z) / -wfactor
	local y = (point.y/point.z) /  hfactor
	--
	return Vector2.new(ScreenSpace.ViewSizeX()*(0.5 + 0.5*x), ScreenSpace.ViewSizeY()*(0.5 + 0.5*y))
end

-- ScreenSpace -> WorldSpace. Raw function taking a screen position and a depth and 
-- converting it into a world position.
function ScreenSpace.ScreenToWorld(x, y, depth)
	local aspectRatio = ScreenSpace.AspectRatio()
	local hfactor = math.tan(math.rad(Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView)/2)
	local wfactor = aspectRatio*hfactor
	--
	local xf, yf = x/ScreenSpace.ViewSizeX()*2 - 1, y/ScreenSpace.ViewSizeY()*2 - 1
	local xpos = xf * -wfactor * depth
	local ypos = yf *  hfactor * depth
	--
	return Vector3.new(xpos, ypos, depth)
end

-- ScreenSize -> WorldSize
function ScreenSpace.ScreenWidthToWorldWidth(screenWidth, depth)	
	local aspectRatio = ScreenSpace.AspectRatio()
	local hfactor = math.tan(math.rad(Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView)/2)
	local wfactor = aspectRatio*hfactor
	local sx = ScreenSpace.ViewSizeX()
	--
	return -(screenWidth / sx) * 2 * wfactor * depth
end
function ScreenSpace.ScreenHeightToWorldHeight(screenHeight, depth)
	local hfactor = math.tan(math.rad(Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView)/2)
	local sy = ScreenSpace.ViewSizeY()
	--
	return -(screenHeight / sy) * 2 * hfactor * depth
end

-- WorldSize -> ScreenSize
function ScreenSpace.WorldWidthToScreenWidth(worldWidth, depth)
	local aspectRatio = ScreenSpace.AspectRatio()
	local hfactor = math.tan(math.rad(Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView)/2)
	local wfactor = aspectRatio*hfactor
	local sx = ScreenSpace.ViewSizeX()
	--
	return -(worldWidth * sx) / (2 * wfactor * depth)
end
function ScreenSpace.WorldHeightToScreenHeight(worldHeight, depth)
	local hfactor = math.tan(math.rad(Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView)/2)
	local sy = ScreenSpace.ViewSizeY()
	--
	return -(worldHeight * sy) / (2 * hfactor * depth)
end

-- WorldSize + ScreenSize -> Depth needed
function ScreenSpace.GetDepthForWidth(screenWidth, worldWidth)
	local aspectRatio = ScreenSpace.AspectRatio()
	local hfactor = math.tan(math.rad(Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView)/2)
	local wfactor = aspectRatio*hfactor
	local sx, sy = ScreenSpace.ViewSizeX(), ScreenSpace.ViewSizeY()
	--
	return -(sx * worldWidth) / (screenWidth * 2 * wfactor)	
end
function ScreenSpace.GetDepthForHeight(screenHeight, worldHeight)
	local hfactor = math.tan(math.rad(Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView)/2)
	local sy = ScreenSpace.ViewSizeY()
	--
	return -(sy * worldHeight) / (screenHeight * 2 * hfactor)	
end

-- ScreenSpace -> WorldSpace. Taking a screen height, and a depth to put an object 
-- at, and returning a size of how big that object has to be to appear that size
-- at that depth.
function ScreenSpace.ScreenToWorldByHeightDepth(x, y, screenHeight, depth)
	local aspectRatio = ScreenSpace.AspectRatio()
	local hfactor = math.tan(math.rad(Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView)/2)
	local wfactor = aspectRatio*hfactor
	local sx, sy = ScreenSpace.ViewSizeX(), ScreenSpace.ViewSizeY()
	--
	local worldHeight = -(screenHeight/sy) * 2 * hfactor * depth
	--
	local xf, yf = x/sx*2 - 1, y/sy*2 - 1
	local xpos = xf * -wfactor * depth
	local ypos = yf *  hfactor * depth
	--
	return Vector3.new(xpos, ypos, depth), worldHeight
end

-- ScreenSpace -> WorldSpace. Taking a screen width, and a depth to put an object 
-- at, and returning a size of how big that object has to be to appear that size
-- at that depth.
function ScreenSpace.ScreenToWorldByWidthDepth(x, y, screenWidth, depth)
	local aspectRatio = ScreenSpace.AspectRatio()
	local hfactor = math.tan(math.rad(Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView)/2)
	local wfactor = aspectRatio*hfactor
	local sx, sy = ScreenSpace.ViewSizeX(), ScreenSpace.ViewSizeY()
	--
	local worldWidth = (screenWidth/sx) * 2 * -wfactor * depth
	--
	local xf, yf = x/sx*2 - 1, y/sy*2 - 1
	local xpos = xf * -wfactor * depth
	local ypos = yf *  hfactor * depth
	--
	return Vector3.new(xpos, ypos, depth), worldWidth
end

-- ScreenSpace -> WorldSpace. Taking a screen height that you want that object to be
-- and a world height that is the size of that object, and returning the position to
-- put that object at to satisfy those.
function ScreenSpace.ScreenToWorldByHeight(x, y, screenHeight, worldHeight)
	local aspectRatio = ScreenSpace.AspectRatio()
	local hfactor = math.tan(math.rad(Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView)/2)
	local wfactor = aspectRatio*hfactor
	local sx, sy = ScreenSpace.ViewSizeX(), ScreenSpace.ViewSizeY()
	--
	local depth = - (sy * worldHeight) / (screenHeight * 2 * hfactor)
	--
	local xf, yf = x/sx*2 - 1, y/sy*2 - 1
	local xpos = xf * -wfactor * depth
	local ypos = yf *  hfactor * depth
	--
	return Vector3.new(xpos, ypos, depth)
end

-- ScreenSpace -> WorldSpace. Taking a screen width that you want that object to be
-- and a world width that is the size of that object, and returning the position to
-- put that object at to satisfy those.
function ScreenSpace.ScreenToWorldByWidth(x, y, screenWidth, worldWidth)
	local aspectRatio = ScreenSpace.AspectRatio()
	local hfactor = math.tan(math.rad(Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView)/2)
	local wfactor = aspectRatio*hfactor
	local sx, sy = ScreenSpace.ViewSizeX(), ScreenSpace.ViewSizeY()
	--
	local depth = - (sx * worldWidth) / (screenWidth * 2 * wfactor)
	--
	local xf, yf = x/sx*2 - 1, y/sy*2 - 1
	local xpos = xf * -wfactor * depth
	local ypos = yf *  hfactor * depth
	--
	return Vector3.new(xpos, ypos, depth)
end

return ScreenSpace

function Utility:WeldVehicle(object)
	local parts,last = {}
	local function scan(parent)
		for _,v in pairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
			--wait()
			if (v:IsA("BasePart") and v ~= workspace.Terrain and v.Name ~= "Wheel") then
				if (last ) then
					local w = Instance.new("Weld")
					w.Name = ("%s_Weld"):format(v.Name)
					w.Part0,w.Part1 = last,v
					w.C0 = last.CFrame:inverse()
					w.C1 = v.CFrame:inverse()
					w.Parent = last
				end
				last = v
				table.insert(parts,v)
			elseif v:IsA("BasePart") and v.Name == "Wheel" then
				table.insert(parts,v)
			end
			scan(v)
		end
	end
	scan(object)
	for _,v in pairs(parts) do
		v.Anchored = false
	end
end

function Utility:GetModelGlobalSizeAndPosition(model)
	local boundingBox = {Min = Vector3.new(0,0,0),Max = Vector3.new(0,0,0)}
	local initialized = false
	local function search(root)
		for _,obj in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
			if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
				local size = obj.Size
				for _,objectSpaceCornerPoint in ipairs({Vector3.new(size.X, size.Y, size.Z),Vector3.new(-size.X, -size.Y, -size.Z),Vector3.new(-size.X, size.Y, size.Z),Vector3.new(size.X, size.Y, -size.Z),Vector3.new(size.X, -size.Y, size.Z),Vector3.new(-size.X, -size.Y, size.Z),Vector3.new(size.X, -size.Y, -size.Z),Vector3.new(-size.X, size.Y, -size.Z)}) do 
					local worldCornerPoint = obj.CFrame:pointToWorldSpace(objectSpaceCornerPoint/2)
					if worldCornerPoint.X > boundingBox.Max.X or not initialized then boundingBox.Max = Vector3.new(worldCornerPoint.X,boundingBox.Max.Y,boundingBox.Max.Z) end
					if worldCornerPoint.Y > boundingBox.Max.Y or not initialized then boundingBox.Max = Vector3.new(boundingBox.Max.X,worldCornerPoint.Y,boundingBox.Max.Z) end
					if worldCornerPoint.Z > boundingBox.Max.Z or not initialized then boundingBox.Max = Vector3.new(boundingBox.Max.X,boundingBox.Max.Y,worldCornerPoint.Z) end
					if worldCornerPoint.X < boundingBox.Min.X or not initialized then boundingBox.Min = Vector3.new(worldCornerPoint.X,boundingBox.Min.Y,boundingBox.Min.Z) end
					if worldCornerPoint.Y < boundingBox.Min.Y or not initialized then boundingBox.Min = Vector3.new(boundingBox.Min.X,worldCornerPoint.Y,boundingBox.Min.Z) end
					if worldCornerPoint.Z < boundingBox.Min.Z or not initialized then boundingBox.Min = Vector3.new(boundingBox.Min.X,boundingBox.Min.Y,worldCornerPoint.Z) end
					initialized = true
				end
			else
				search(obj)
			end 
		end
	end
	search(model)
	local boxSize = Vector3.new(boundingBox.Max.X - boundingBox.Min.X, boundingBox.Max.Y - boundingBox.Min.Y, boundingBox.Max.Z - boundingBox.Min.Z)
	local modelPosition = Vector3.new(boundingBox.Max.X - boxSize.X/2, boundingBox.Max.Y - boxSize.Y/2, boundingBox.Max.Z - boxSize.Z/2)
	return boxSize,modelPosition
end

local OVERLAP_PERCISION = 2

function Utility:GuiIsOverlapping(guiObject,guiObject2)
	local function Overlapping(obj1,obj2)
		local sizeX = (obj2.AbsoluteSize.X <= 0 and 1) or obj2.AbsoluteSize.X
		local sizeY = (obj2.AbsoluteSize.Y <= 0 and 1) or obj2.AbsoluteSize.Y
		
		for y=0, sizeY, sizeY / OVERLAP_PERCISION do
			for x=0, sizeX, sizeX / OVERLAP_PERCISION do
				if Utility:PointInsideGui(obj1,Vector2.new(obj2.AbsolutePosition.X + x,obj2.AbsolutePosition.Y +y)) then
					return true
				end
			end
		end
		return false
	end
	
	return Overlapping(guiObject,guiObject2) or Overlapping(guiObject2,guiObject)
	
end

function Utility:InterpolateCameraType2(camera,endPosition,focus,duration,finish)
	camera.CameraType = "Scriptable"
	
	local alpha = 0
	local originalPos = camera.CFrame.p
	
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("Interpolate", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value, function()
		camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(originalPos:Lerp(endPosition,alpha),focus.Position)
		if alpha >= 1 then
			RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("Interpolate")
			if finish then
				finish()
			end
		end
		alpha = alpha + (1/60) / duration
	end)

end

function Utility:ConvertScale(input,inputRange,outputRange,noClamp)
	if input and inputRange and outputRange then
		local inputRangeMin = inputRange[1]
		local inputRangeMax = inputRange[2]
		local outputRangeMin  = outputRange[1]
		local outputRangeMax = outputRange[2]
		local scale = (input - inputRangeMin) / (inputRangeMax - inputRangeMin)
		local unclampedOutputValue = ((outputRangeMax - outputRangeMin) * scale) + outputRangeMin
		local clampedOutputValue = math.min(outputRangeMax,math.max(outputRangeMin,unclampedOutputValue))
		return (noClamp and unclampedOutputValue) or clampedOutputValue
	end
end

function Utility:Debounce(func)
    local isRunning = false    -- Create a local debounce variable
    return function(...)       -- Return a new function
        if not isRunning then

            func(...)          -- Call it with the original arguments
 
            isRunning = false
        end
    end
end

function Utility.IsPointInsideBox(box,point)
	local objSpace = box.CFrame:pointToObjectSpace(point)
	local boxSize = box.Size
	return boxSize.X/2 >= math.abs(objSpace.X) and
		   boxSize.Y/2 >= math.abs(objSpace.Y) and
		   boxSize.Z/2 >= math.abs(objSpace.Z)
end


function Utility:IsBoxInsideBox(box,smallerBox,percision) --percision must be greater than one --might want to run twice if boxes are around the same size with the arguments switched
	local IsPointInsideBox = Utility.IsPointInsideBox --optomize
	local size = smallerBox.Size
	for y=-(size.Y/percision),(size.Y/percision),(size.Y/percision) do
		for x=-(size.X/percision),(size.X/percision),(size.X/percision) do
			for z=-(size.Z/percision),(size.Z/percision),(size.Z/percision) do
				local point = smallerBox.CFrame:pointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(x,y,z))
				if IsPointInsideBox(box,point) then
					return true
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function Utility:UserDataToTable(root,properties)
	local currentParent = nil
	local function search(object,tree)
	
		for _,property in ipairs(properties) do
			pcall(function() tree[property] = object[property] end)

		end
	
		for _,child in ipairs(object:GetChildren()) do
			tree[child.Name] = {}
			tree[child.Name] = search(child,tree[child.Name])
		end
		
		return tree
	end
	return {[root.Name] = search(root,{})}
end


--keys cannont be objects when sent through remotes - need to replace keys with ids and then put them together again at client

function Utility:EncodeTableForRemotes(tab)
	local encodedTable = Utility:DeepCopy(tab)
	local idDictionary = {}
	local id = 10000 --start id count at 1000
	local function search(t)
		if type(t) == "table" then
			local newValues = {}
			for key,value in pairs(t) do
				if type(key) == "userdata" then
					newValues[tostring(id)] = value
					idDictionary[tostring(id)] = key
					t[key] = nil

					id = id + 1
				end
				search(value)
			end
			for key,value in pairs(newValues) do --cant remove items from table while its being looped through
				t[key] = value
			end
			
		end
		
	end
	search(encodedTable)
	return encodedTable,idDictionary
end

--send data through a channel and wait for a response
function Utility:SendData(action,channelName,timeout,...)
	local channel = game.ReplicatedStorage.Channels[channelName]
	local eventClassName = (channel:IsA("RemoteEvent") and "RemoteEvent") or "BindableEvent"

	if timeout then --wait to hear back from the server
		
		local response = "no response"
		local response2, response3 --return up to 3 values
		local listener
		
		local function WaitForResponse(act,...)
			if action == act then
				response,response2,response3 = ...
			end
		end
		
		if eventClassName == "RemoteEvent" then
			listener = channel.OnClientEvent:connect(function(act,...) WaitForResponse(act,...) end)
			channel:FireServer(action,...)
		else
			listener = channel.Event:connect(function(act,...) WaitForResponse(act,...) end)
			channel:Fire(action,...)
		end
		
		
		
		local timeoutCount = timeout or 5 --seoncds
		while response == "no response" and timeoutCount > 0 do
			wait(.01)
			timeoutCount = timeoutCount - .01
		end
		
		listener:disconnect()
		
		if response == "no response" then
			return nil
		end

		return response,response2, response3
		
	else
		
		if eventClassName == "RemoteEvent" then
			channel:FireServer(action,...)
		else

			channel:Fire(action,...)
		end
	
		
	end
end


return Utility

local Timer = {}


Timer.__index = Timer



function Timer.new()
	
	local this = {}
	setmetatable(this, Timer)
	this.Count = 0
	this.Callback = nil
	this.InitialCount = 0
	this.State = "Stopped"
	this.ThreadVersion = 0

	return this

end


function Timer:Pause()
	self.State = "Paused"
end

function Timer:Stop()
	self.State = "Stopped"
end

function Timer:Finish()
	if self.State == "Started" then
		self.State = "Finish"
		if self.Callback then
			self.Callback() --call function
		end
	end
end


function Timer:Start(startSeconds)
	self.State = "Started"
	self.InitialCount = startSeconds
	self.Count = startSeconds
	self.ThreadVersion = self.ThreadVersion + 1  --dont allow two threads to run at once
	
	spawn(function()
		
		local version = self.ThreadVersion
		while true do
			
			if self.ThreadVersion ~= version then return end
			while self.State == "Paused" do wait(.1) end
			if self.State == "Stopped" or self.State == "Finished" then return end
			
			self.Count = self.Count - 1
			
			if self.Count == 0 then
				self:Finish()
				break
			end
			
			wait(1)
		end
		
	end)
	
end

function Timer:Reset()
	self.State = "Stopped"
	self:Start(self.InitialCount)
end

function Timer:OnFinish(callback)
	self.Callback = callback
end





return Timer

--[[
	Tween function for tweening any property.  Automatically tweens the property from startValue to endValue over time seconds.
	
	s.tween(
		Object object OR Table object OR Void Function receiver(String propertyName, Variant value),
		String propertyName,
		String valueType,
		Variant startValue = currentValue,
		Variant endValue = nil,
		Number time = 1,
		String easingStyleName = Linear,
		String easingDirectionName = In,
		Variant Tuple easingStyleArgs = nil
	)
	RETURNS:
		RBXScriptSignal onFinished(Bool completed, Object object OR Table object, String propertyName),
		RBXScriptSignal onStepped(Number rawAlpha, Number styledAlpha) Function getOnStepped()
	
	NOTES
		If startValue is not provided it will tween from the existing state of that's object's property.
		If endValue is not provided it will cancel existing tweens, not start a new one, and not return anything.
		Any existing tween on the named property of the defined object will be cancelled automatically.
		easing styles are defined under script.styles.
			Easing style modules should return a function which accepts
			an alpha 0-1 argument and returns a modified alpha value.
		value type interpolators are defined under script.types.
			Value type modules should reutrn a function which accepts a start value,
			an end value, and an alpha value, and returns an interpolated value.
		easingStyleArgs is used to give extra functionality to easing styles.
			If provided, these args will be passed to the easing style function so
			that it can have extra functionality
		The first value returned by the function is a signal that will fire when
			the tween stops (either it completes or it is cancelled).
		The second value returned by the function is a function that when called
			will return a signal that fires every time a new value is calculated
		Functions steps on RenderStepped on clients, runs at 20 Hz on the server.

private.types = {}
private.styles = {}
private.activeTweens = {}

function private.loadTypes()
	for i, module in next, script.types:GetChildren() do
		private.types[module.Name] = require(module)
	end
end

function private.loadStyles()
	for i, module in next, script.styles:GetChildren() do
		private.styles[module.Name] = require(module)
	end
end

function private.stopTween(object, property, completed)
	if private.activeTweens[object] ~= nil then
		if private.activeTweens[object][property] ~= nil then
			local info = private.activeTweens[object][property]
			if info then
				private.activeTweens[object][property] = nil
				info.finishedEvent:Fire(completed, type(object)=='userdata' and object or nil, property)
				info.finishedEvent:Destroy()
				
				if next(private.activeTweens[object]) == nil then
					private.activeTweens[object] = nil
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function private.tween(object, property, vtype, start, finish, time, style, ...)
	private.updateSpecificTween(object, property)
	private.stopTween(object, property, false)
	
	if finish ~= nil then
		local info = {
			object = object,
			property = property,
			type = vtype,
			start = start,
			finish = finish,
			time = time,
			style = style or 'Linear',
			extra = ... and {...} or nil,
			hasExtra = #{...}>0,
			finishedEvent = Instance.new'BindableEvent',
			started = tick(),
			objectType = type(object)=='function' and 'Function' or 'Object'
		}
		
		if info.start == nil then
			if info.objectType == 'Function' then
				info.start = object('Get', property)
			elseif info.objectType == 'Object' then
				info.start = object[property]
			end
		end
		
		if not private.activeTweens[object] then
			private.activeTweens[object] = {}
		end
		private.activeTweens[object][property] = info
		
		return info.finishedEvent.Event, object.Changed
	end
end

function private.updateTween(info)
	local rawAlpha = math.min(1, (tick()-info.started)/info.time)
	local alpha = info.style == 'Linear' and rawAlpha or private.styles[info.style](rawAlpha, info.hasExtra and unpack(info.extra))
	local newValue = private.types[info.type](info.start, info.finish, alpha)
	
	local cf
	if info.property == 'Size' and info.type == 'Vector3' then
		cf = info.object.CFrame
	end
	
	if info.objectType == 'Object' then
		info.object[info.property] =  newValue
	elseif info.objectType == 'Function' then
		info.object(info.property, newValue)
	end
	
	if cf then
		info.object.CFrame = cf
	end
	
	return rawAlpha >= 1
end

function private.updateSpecificTween(object, property)
	if private.activeTweens[object] and private.activeTweens[object][property] then
		private.updateTween(private.activeTweens[object][property])
	end
end

function private.update()
	for object, props in next, private.activeTweens do
		for property, info in next, props do
			local finished = private.updateTween(info)
			if finished then
				private.activeTweens[info] = nil
				private.stopTween(object, property, true)
			end
		end
	end
end

function private.startLoop()
	local isServer = game:FindService'NetworkServer' ~= nil
	
	if isServer then
		spawn(function()
			while true do
				private.update()
				wait(1/20)
			end
		end)
	else
		runService:BindToRenderStep('AutoTweenUpdate', 0, private.update)
	end
end

	local min = v3new(

		imin.y > imax.y and imin.y or imax.y,
		imin.z > imax.z and imin.z or imax.z
	)
	
	return r3new(

		max
	)
end

--[[
	For each point on each line, find the values of the other sequence at that point in time through interpolation
		then interpolate between the known value and the learned value
		then use that value to create a new keypoint at the time
		then build a new sequence using all the keypoints generated
--]]

local sortByTime = function(a, b)
	return a.Time < b.Time
end

return function(a, b, t)
	local keypoints = {}
	local addedTimes = {}
	
	for i, ap in next, a.Keypoints do
		local closestAbove, closestBelow
		
		for i, bp in next, b.Keypoints do
			if bp.Time == ap.Time then
				closestAbove, closestBelow = bp, bp
				break
			elseif bp.Time < ap.Time and (closestBelow == nil or bp.Time > closestBelow.Time) then
				closestBelow = bp
			elseif bp.Time > ap.Time and (closestAbove == nil or bp.Time < closestAbove.Time) then
				closestAbove = bp
			end
		end
		
		local bValue, bEnvelope
		if closestAbove == closestBelow then
			bValue, bEnvelope = closestAbove.Value, closestAbove.Envelope
		else
			local p = (ap.Time - closestBelow.Time)/(closestAbove.Time - closestBelow.Time)
			bValue = (closestAbove.Value - closestBelow.Value)*p + closestBelow.Value
			bEnvelope = (closestAbove.Envelope - closestBelow.Envelope)*p + closestBelow.Envelope
		end
		local interValue = (bValue - ap.Value)*t + ap.Value
		local interEnvelope = (bEnvelope - ap.Envelope)*t + ap.Envelope
		local interp = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(ap.Time, interValue, interEnvelope)
		
		table.insert(keypoints, interp)
		
		addedTimes[ap.Time] = true
	end
	for i, bp in next, b.Keypoints do
		if not addedTimes[bp.Time] then
			local closestAbove, closestBelow
			
			for i, ap in next, a.Keypoints do
				if ap.Time == bp.Time then
					closestAbove, closestBelow = ap, ap
					break
				elseif ap.Time < bp.Time and (closestBelow == nil or ap.Time > closestBelow.Time) then
					closestBelow = ap
				elseif ap.Time > bp.Time and (closestAbove == nil or ap.Time < closestAbove.Time) then
					closestAbove = ap
				end
			end
			
			local aValue, aEnvelope
			if closestAbove == closestBelow then
				aValue, aEnvelope = closestAbove.Value, closestAbove.Envelope
			else
				local p = (bp.Time - closestBelow.Time)/(closestAbove.Time - closestBelow.Time)
				aValue = (closestAbove.Value - closestBelow.Value)*p + closestBelow.Value
				aEnvelope = (closestAbove.Envelope - closestBelow.Envelope)*p + closestBelow.Envelope
			end
			local interValue = (bp.Value - aValue)*t + aValue
			local interEnvelope = (bp.Envelope - aEnvelope)*t + aEnvelope
			local interp = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(bp.Time, interValue, interEnvelope)
			
			table.insert(keypoints, interp)
		end
	end
	
	table.sort(keypoints, sortByTime)
	
	return NumberSequence.new(keypoints)
end

	<Region> .new(<Tuple>)

			Creates a blank Region

			Creates a Region with Center and [0, 0, 0] Rotation and [0, 0, 0] Size

			Creates a Region with Center and Size. Rotation will default to [0, 0, 0]

			Creates a Region with Center, Size, and Rotation specified

	
	Class <Region>
	
		<Vector3> .Center
			Returns the Center of the Region 
			
		<Vector3> .Rotation
			Returns the Rotation of the Region
			
		<Vector3> .Size
			Returns the Size of the Region
			
		<Bool> :isInRegion(<Vector3> Position)
			Returns if Position is within the Region
			
		<Bool> :isInRegionIgnoreY(<Vector3> Position)
			Returns if Position is within the Region disregarding the Y axis
		
--]]

--///////////////--
--Helping Methods--
--///////////////--

local function InvokeVector(Vector, Function)
	return Vector3.new(Function(Vector.X), Function(Vector.Y), Function(Vector.Z))
end


local function GetOffset(Region, Position)
	local Center = Region.Center
	local Rotation = Region.Rotation
	
	local Offset = (CFrame.new(Center) * CFrame.Angles(Rotation.X, Rotation.Y, Rotation.Z)):pointToObjectSpace(Position)
	Offset = InvokeVector(Offset, math.abs)
	return Offset
end

--/////////--
--Utilities--
--/////////--

local function isInRegion(Region, Position)
	local Extents = Region.Size /2
	
	local Offset = GetOffset(Region, Position)
	return Offset.X < Extents.X and Offset.Y < Extents.Y and Offset.Z < Extents.Z
end

local function isInRegionIgnoreY(Region, Position)
	local Extents = Region.Size /2
	
	local Offset = GetOffset(Region, Position)
	return Offset.X < Extents.X and Offset.Z < Extents.Z
end

-- <Region> CreateRegion(<Vector3> Center, <Vector3> Rotation, <Vector3> Size)
	--Creates Region with specific input
	--Returns <Region>
local function CreateRegion(Center, Rotation, Size)
	local Region = {}
		Region.Center = Center or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		Region.Rotation = Rotation or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		Region.Size = Size or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		function Region:isInRegion(Part)
			return isInRegion(Region, Part)
		end
		function Region:isInRegionIgnoreY(Part)
			return isInRegionIgnoreY(Region, Part)
		end

	return Region
end

-- <Region> CreateRegionFromPart(<BasePart> Part)
	--Creates Region from BasePart
	--Returns <Region>
local function CreateRegionFromPart(Part)
	local Center = Part.Position
	local Size = Part.Size
	
	local X, Y, Z = Part.CFrame:toEulerAnglesXYZ()
	local Rotation = Vector3.new(X, Y, Z)

	return CreateRegion(Center, Rotation, Size)
end

--The Meat--

local Region = {}

function Region.new(...)
	local args = {...}
	local Object = nil
	local isBasePart = false
	if args[1] and pcall(function() isBasePart = args[1]:IsA("BasePart") end) and isBasePart then
		Object = CreateRegionFromPart(args[1])
	else
		Object = CreateRegion(args[1], args[3], args[2])
	end
	return Object
end

return Region

	end

local votebounce = false
local VoteButton = game.Workspace["Remove Manager"]

function GetVoteCount()
	local votes = 0
	for _,player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if Players[player] ~= nil and Players[player].Vote_Manager then
			votes = votes + 1
		end
	end
	return votes
end

function ResetVotes()
	for _,player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if Players[player] then
			Players[player].Vote_Manager = false
		end
	end
	VoteButton.Name = "Remove Manager (" .. GetVoteCount() .. "/8)"
end

function Vote(hit)
	local player = Utility:GetPlayerFromBodyPart(hit)
	local playerData = Players[player]
	if player ~= nil and playerData ~= nil then--and Manager.CurrentManager ~= nil then
		if playerData.Job == "Manager" then 
			Manager:FireManager()
			
		elseif not playerData.Vote_Manager and not votebounce then
			votebounce = true
			Players[player]["Vote_Manager"] = true
			VoteButton.Name = "Your vote has been submitted."
			VoteButton.Head.BrickColor = BrickColor.new(23)
			wait(4)
			votebounce = false
			local votes = GetVoteCount()
			VoteButton.Name = "Remove Manager (" .. votes .. "/8)"
			VoteButton.Head.BrickColor = BrickColor.new(21)
				
			--1st count up the votes
			
				
			--if enough votees
			if votes >= 8 then
				Manager:FireManager()
				Dialog:ShowMessageAll("","The manager has been voted off.")
			end
		end
	end
end

function Manager:SetManager(playerData)
	playerData:SetJob("Manager")
	Manager.CurrentManager = playerData.Object
	ShowSeatNotification(false)
	workspace.Main.Chatted:FireAllClients(nil,playerData.Object.Name .. " is the new manager.",false)
	
	ResetVotes()
end


function Manager:FireManager()

	local manager = Manager.CurrentManager
	local managerData = Players[manager]
	if manager and managerData then
		managerData:SetUniform("Shirt")
		managerData:SetJob("Cashier")
		managerData:TeleportToJob()
	end
	
	--let everyone with manager pass know theres an opening
	for _,player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local playerData = Players[player]
		if player ~= manager and playerData and playerData.GamePasses.ManagerTeleport then
			spawn(function()
				if Dialog:GetChoice(player,"Become manager?","The managment position is open. Would you like to teleport to the manager chair?","Yes","No") then
					playerData:Teleport(ManagerChair.Seat.Position + Vector3.new(0,5,0))
				end
			end)
		end
	end
	

	
	ResetVotes()
	
	Manager.CurrentManager = nil
	ShowSeatNotification(true)
end

function Recieve(manager,action,...)
	print("received",action,manager,...)
	local args = {...}
	local CoolCounters = Manager.CoolDownCounters
	if Manager.CurrentManager == manager or Enums.IsStudio then

		if CoolCounters[action] ~= nil then 

			local subjectPlayer = args[1]
			local subjectPlayerData = Players[subjectPlayer]
		
			if CoolCounters[action] == 0 and subjectPlayer and subjectPlayerData and subjectPlayer ~= manager then
				CoolCounters[action] = Manager.CoolDownTimes[action] * 60

				spawn(function()
					while true do
						wait(1)
						CoolCounters[action] = CoolCounters[action] - 1
						if CoolCounters[action] == 0 then
							break
						end
					end
				end)
				
				
				
				if action == "GiveBonus" then
					Paycheck.ManagerBonusPlayer = subjectPlayer
					Paycheck:GiveCheck(subjectPlayer,"Bonus Check from Manager")
					Dialog:ShowMessage(manager,"",subjectPlayer.Name .. " has received the bonus check.","Close")
					workspace.Main.Chatted:FireAllClients(nil,"The manager gave " .. subjectPlayer.Name .. " a bonus.",false)



			
			
				elseif action  == "BackToWork" then
					Dialog:ShowMessage(subjectPlayer,"","The manager has put you back to work.","Ok")
					Dialog:ShowMessage(manager,"",subjectPlayer.Name .. " has been sent back to work.","Close")

					
					subjectPlayerData:TeleportToJob(false,subjectPlayer.TeamColor.Number)
				
				
				
				elseif action  == "NominateForBan"  then
					
					Dialog:ShowMessage(manager,"Voting","Players are now voting.","Ok")
		
					vote_count = 0
					for i,player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
						if player ~= manager and player ~= subjectPlayer then
							game.Workspace.Main.VotePlayers:FireClient(player,subjectPlayer.Name)
						end
					end
					vote_count = 0
					local counter = game.Workspace.Main.VotePlayers.OnServerEvent:connect(function(player)
						vote_count = vote_count + 1
					end)
					
					
					wait(20)
					
					if not subjectPlayer or not subjectPlayer.Parent then return end
					counter:disconnect()
					
					local name = subjectPlayer.Name
					if vote_count >= 9 then  -------0-------
						subjectPlayer:Kick("You have been kicked out of the server for causing trouble.")
					else
						return
					end
					
					wait(1)
					Dialog:ShowMessageAll("Player kicked",name .. " has been kicked from this server.","Close")
				
				
				elseif action == "EmployeeOfTheDay" then
					
					Dialog:ShowMessage(subjectPlayer,"","The manager has made you employee of the day.","Ok")
					Dialog:ShowMessage(manager,"",subjectPlayer.Name .. " is now the employee of the day.","Ok")
				
					workspace.Main.Chatted:FireAllClients(nil,subjectPlayer.Name .. " is now the employee of the day.",false)

				
					for _,obj in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
						if obj.Name == "EmployeeOfTheDay" then
							obj.PlayerName.PlayerName.PlayerName.Text = subjectPlayer.Name
							local URL,ready = game.Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync ( subjectPlayer.userId, Enum.ThumbnailType.AvatarBust,Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size180x180)
							obj.Headshot.Headshot.Headshot.Image = URL
						end
					end
				
				end
			end
			
	
		elseif action == "QuitJob" and Players[manager] then
			print("quiting")
			if Dialog:GetChoice(manager,"Quit job?","Are you sure you want to quit your job as manager?","Yes","No") then
				Manager:FireManager()
			end
					
		elseif action == "GetCounters" then
			print("fireing back")
			return Manager.CoolDownCounters
		end
	end
end


channel.OnServerEvent:connect(function(player,action,...)

local clearedTreesByHouse = {}
function Environment:ClearTreesForHouse(houseObject,areaBlock)
	
	clearedTreesByHouse[houseObject] = clearedTreesByHouse[houseObject] or {}

	for _,tree in ipairs(Trees) do
		local insideBox = Utility:IsBoxInsideBox(areaBlock,tree.LeavesMain,2)
		if not clearedTreesByHouse[houseObject][tree] and insideBox and tree.Parent == workspace.Trees  then
				
			tree.Parent = game.ServerStorage.ClearedTrees
			clearedTreesByHouse[houseObject][tree] = tree
				
				
		elseif clearedTreesByHouse[houseObject][tree] and not insideBox and tree.Parent == game.ServerStorage.ClearedTrees then
			tree.Parent = workspace.Trees
			clearedTreesByHouse[houseObject][tree] = nil
				
		end
	end
	
end

function Environment:StartDayNightCycle()
	if not (Debug.Enabled and (Debug.TimeOfDay or Debug.DayNightCycleDisabled)) then
		spawn(function()
			while true do
				for _,timeOfDay in pairs((Environment.Season == "Winter" and WinterOrder) or Order) do
					
					Environment:SetTimeOfDay(timeOfDay)
					print(Environment.TimeOfDay)
					wait(Durations[timeOfDay]*((Debug.Enabled and Debug.FastCycle) or 60))
				end	
			end
		end)
	else
		Environment:SetTimeOfDay(Debug.TimeOfDay)
	end

end

function WaitForEvent(event_name,this)

	local event_value = nil
	local playerActionClient = workspace.TutorialService.PlayerAction.OnServerEvent:connect(function(player,eventName,eventValue)
	
		
		if this.Player == player and eventName == event_name then
			event_value = eventValue
		end
	end)
	local playerActionServer = workspace.TutorialService.PlayerAction.PlayerAction.Event:connect(function(player,eventName,eventValue)
		
		if this.Player == player and eventName == event_name then
			event_value = eventValue
		end
	end)
	while event_value == nil and not this.CancelListener do
		wait(.1)
	end
	
	this.CancelListener = false
	playerActionClient:disconnect()
	playerActionServer:disconnect()
	return event_value
end

function Tutorial:TeleportToClosestSpawn()
	
	local closest = nil
	local closest_distance = 200
	local character = self.Player.Character
	if character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		for _,spawn in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
			if spawn:IsA("SpawnLocation") and (spawn.Position-character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).magnitude < closest_distance then
				closest = spawn
				closest_distance = (spawn.Position-character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).magnitude
			end
		end
		if closest then
			self.Player.Character:MoveTo(closest.Position)
		end
	end
end


local indexToJobName = {"Cashier","Cook","Boxer","Delivery","Supplier"}

function nextPart(this,i)
	
	local jobIndex = this.JobIndex
	local index = this.Index
	local player = this.Player
	
	if not player or not player.Parent then this:Stop() return end
	
	this.TimeoutCounter = 60 --reset counter after one minute
	
	
	local message = this.TutorialData[jobIndex][index][1]
	local pattern = "{([%a%s.,'()]+)}{([%a%s.,'()]+)}{([%a%s.,'()]+)}" --.,'()
	for pc, mobile, console in message:gmatch(pattern) do --You see how gmatch returns the captures instead of the matches to the pattern here.
		local replaceValue
		if this.TouchEnabled then
			replaceValue = mobile
		elseif Enums.IsConsoleServer  then
			replaceValue = console
		else
			replaceValue = pc
		end
		
		message = string.gsub(message, "{" .. pc .. "}{" .. mobile .. "}{" .. console .. "}", replaceValue)

	end

	for _,ing in ipairs(workspace.Ingredients:GetChildren()) do
		if ing.Name == name and ing:FindFirstChild("Hand") then  --hand only appers in ingreident blocks

function Tutorial:Start()
	--while self.JobIndex <= #self.TutorialData and self.JobIndex > 0 do
	--	while self.Index <= #self.TutorialData[self.JobIndex] and self.Index > 0 do
			--nextPart(self)
		--end
	--end

	--workspace.TutorialService.GuiEnabled:FireClient(self.Player,"Menu",false)
	
	spawn(function() 
		while not self.QuitTutorial do
			wait(1)
			self.TimeoutCounter = self.TimeoutCounter - 1
			if self.TimeoutCounter <= 0 then
				if self.Player then
					Dialog:ShowMessage(self.Player,"Tutorial expired","The tutorial ended because you took too long.","Ok")
					workspace.TutorialService.ShowButton:FireClient(self.Player,self.JobIndex)
					self:TeleportToClosestSpawn()
				end
				
				self:Stop()
			end
		end
	end)
	
	
	
	--record number of time player quit the tutorial - stop tutorial after too many times
	local jobIndex = self.JobIndex
	local playerData = Players[self.Player]
	local CompletedTutorials = playerData["Completed_Tutorials"]
	
	playerData["CurrentJob"] =  jobIndex--change
	
	if type(CompletedTutorials[jobIndex]) ~= "number" then --if boolean value
		CompletedTutorials[jobIndex] = 0
	end
	
	CompletedTutorials[jobIndex] = CompletedTutorials[jobIndex] + 1
	
	if CompletedTutorials[jobIndex] > 3 then  --if quit tutorial 3 times then stop tutorial
		CompletedTutorials[jobIndex] = true
		self:Stop()
	end
	
	
		
	
	while pcall(function() local a =self.TutorialData[self.JobIndex][self.Index] end) and not self.QuitTutorial do
		nextPart(self)
	end
end

function Tutorial:Stop()
	
	self.CancelListener = true
	self.QuitTutorial = true
	workspace.TutorialService.TutorialEnabled:FireClient(self.Player,false)
	workspace.TutorialService.QuitTutorial:FireClient(self.Player)
	
	
	
	if self.Index == 1 and self.JobIndex == 1 and Players[self.Player] and Players["IsNewPlayer"] then --show arrow keys even if player dosent want to do first tutorial
		workspace.TutorialService.ShowArrowKeys:FireClient(self.Player)
	end

	if self.Died then self.Died:disconnect() end
	self.Died = nil
	
	if self.TutorialPlayerOnly then self.TutorialPlayerOnly:Destroy() self.TutorialPlayerOnly = nil end
	
	if Players[self.Player] then
		Players[self.Player]["CurrentJob"] = 0 --stop auto resupply, pizza, and box spawning
		Players[self.Player].TutorialObject = nil
	end
end

function Houses:Initialize()
	for i=1,NumberOfHouses do
		local house =  House.new(self,HousePositions[i],InvertedHouseIndex[i],Addresses[i],i)
		Houses.AllHouses[house.Object] = house
		Houses.AllHouses[house.Object]:LoadHouse()
		Houses.AllHouses[house.Object].Object.Name = "House" .. i
		Houses.AllHouses[house.Object].Index = i
		Houses.AllHouses[house.Object]:StartPlayerListUpdate()
		table.insert(Houses.HouseList,house)

	end
	workspace.House:Destroy() --remove template house
end


function Houses:GetHouseByOwner(player)
	for house,houseData in pairs(Houses.AllHouses) do
		if houseData.Owner == Players[player] then
			return houseData
		end
	end
end


function Houses:GetPlayersInHouseByOwner(player)
	local house = self:GetHouseByOwner(player)
	return house:GetPlayersInside()
	
end

	return nil

function Recieve(player,action,...)
	local args = {...}
	
	local playerData = Players[player]
	if not playerData then return end
	
	local playerHouse = playerData.House
	if not playerHouse then return end
	
	print("received",action,player,...)
	
	
	if action == "GetPlayersInHouseByOwner" then
		return Houses:GetPlayersInHouseByOwner(player)
	
	elseif action == "KickPlayerFromHouse" then
		local kickPlayer = args[1]
		if playerHouse:IsPlayerInsideHouse(kickPlayer) then
			playerHouse:KickPlayerFromHouse(kickPlayer)
		end
		
	elseif action  == "PlaceFurniture" then
		local furnitureModel = args[1]
		local cframe = args[2]
		local assetId = args[3]
		playerHouse:PlaceFurniture(player,assetId,furnitureModel,cframe)
		
	elseif action == "PaintFurniture" then
		local part = args[1]
		local color = args[2]
		playerHouse:PaintFurniture(part,color)
		
	elseif action == "PaintHouse" then
		local part = args[1]
		local color = args[2]
		if part and part.Parent and part:IsDescendantOf(playerHouse.Object) then
			playerHouse:SetColor(part.Name,color)
		end
		
	elseif action == "DeleteFurniture" then
		playerHouse:DeleteFurniture(args[1])

		
	elseif action == "UpgradeHouse" then
		if playerHouse.Upgrade == "Backyard" then
			error("Can't upgrade backyard")
		end
		if playerData.UpgradePayments >= Enums.UpgradePrices[Enums.NextUpgradeName[playerHouse.Upgrade]] then
			playerData.UpgradePayments = 0
			local nextUpgradeName = Enums.NextUpgradeName[playerHouse.Upgrade]
			playerHouse:SetUpgrade(nextUpgradeName)
			workspace.Main.Chatted:FireAllClients(nil,playerData.Object.Name .. " upgraded their house.",false)

			return playerHouse.UpgradeModel
		end
		return false
			
			
	elseif action == "GarageUpgrade" then
		if playerHouse.GarageEnabled then
			playerHouse:LoadGarage()
			playerHouse:RefreshPaint()
			return playerHouse.UpgradeModel
		end
		return false
		
		
	elseif action == "SetWallFloor" then
		local assetId = args[1]
		if playerData.LocationHouse and playerData.LocationHouse == playerHouse then
			playerHouse:SetWallorFloor(playerData.Location,assetId)
		else
			print("NOT INSIDE HOUSE")
		end
	end
end



channel.OnServerEvent:connect(function(player,action,...)
	local response1,response2,response3 = Recieve(player,action,...)
	if response1 then
		channel:FireClient(player,action,response1,response2,response3)
	end
end)

function House.new(container,cframe,inverted,address,index)
	
	local function CreateHouse(this,cframe)
		local house = workspace.House:clone()
		house.Parent = workspace.Houses
		
		
		for _,upgrade in ipairs(house.Upgrades:GetChildren()) do
			upgrade:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(house.PrimaryPart.CFrame)
			this.AllUpgrades[upgrade.Name] = upgrade
		end
		
		house:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(cframe)
		return house
	end
	
	
	local function GetRoomData(self)
		local collection = {}
		for _,upgrade in ipairs(self.Upgrades:GetChildren()) do
			local rooms = {}
			for _,room in ipairs(upgrade.Rooms:GetChildren()) do

				rooms[room] = Room.new(room,upgrade)
		
			end
			upgrade.Parent = game.ServerStorage.HouseStorage --put all the upgrades in storage
			collection[upgrade] = rooms
		end
		return collection
	end
	
	
	
	
	local this = {}
	setmetatable(this,House)

	this.Colors = nil
	this.Wallpapers = nil
	this.Floors = nil
	this.Upgrade = nil

	this.SavedData = {"Colors","Wallpapers","Floors","Upgrade"}
	
	this.Owner = nil
	this.CFrame = cframe
	this.Furniture = {}
	this.Container = container
	this.Address = address
	this.GarageEnabled = false
	this.AllUpgrades = {}
	this.Inverted = inverted
	this.Index = 0
	
	this.Object = CreateHouse(this,cframe)
	this.Garage = this.Object.Garage
	this.OriginalGarageGateSize = this.Garage.Gate.Size
	this.OriginalGarageGateCFrame = this.Garage.Gate.CFrame
	this.BarrierVisible = false

	this.Mailbox = this.Object.Mailbox
	this.Upgrades = this.Object.Upgrades
	this.BoundsBlocks = {}
	
	
	this.UpgradeModel = nil
	this.GivePizza = nil
	this.Rooms = GetRoomData(this)  --UpgadeModel(RoomName(floors and walls))

	if not Enums.IsPartyServer then
		this.Mailbox.Head.LabelBack.TextLabel.Text = this.Address
		this.Mailbox.Head.LabelFront.TextLabel.Text = this.Address
	else
		this.Mailbox.Head.LabelBack:Destroy()
		this.Mailbox.Head.LabelFront:Destroy()
	end
	this.Mailbox.Name = ""
	this.GivePizzaConnection = nil
	
	if not Enums.IsPartyServer then
		this.Guy = this.Object.Guy
		this.Guy.Name = ""
		this.Guy.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(0,10000+math.random(1,1000),0))
	else
		this.Object.Guy:Destroy()
	end
	
	this.Doors = {}
	this.FrontDoor = nil
	this.FurnitureCount = 0
	
	this.Object.Address.Value  = this.Address
	this.Object.MailboxPointer.Value = this.Mailbox
	
	
	this.HouseEvents = {}
	this.GarageEvents = {}
	
	return this
end





--convert old data structure to new
--turn {143454,5477463,758363} into {["FirstFloor"] = "127726526",["SecondFloor"] = "127726526",["ThirdFloor"] = "127726526"}
local function ConvertCompatablilty(data)
	local newTable = {}
	local roomNames = {"FirstFloor","SecondFloor","ThirdFloor","Basement"}
	if data and data[1] then
		for i,assetId in ipairs(data) do
			newTable[roomNames[i]] = assetId
		end
		return newTable
	end
	return nil
end


function AddHouseEvents(self)
	
	for _,event in ipairs(self.HouseEvents) do
		event:disconnect()
	end
	self.HouseEvents = {}

	
	local function setWindowState(player,window)
		if self.Owner and self.Owner == Players[player] then
			if window.Transparency ~= 0 then
				window.Transparency = 0
			else
				window.Transparency = 0.7
			end
		end
	end
	
	local function setBarrierState(player,button)
		if self.Owner and self.Owner == Players[player] then
			for i,obj in ipairs(button.Parent:GetChildren()) do
				if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Name == "Barrier" then
					if obj.Transparency ~= 0 then
						self.BarrierVisible = true
						obj.Transparency = 0
					else
						self.BarrierVisible = false
						obj.Transparency = 1
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	

	
	for _,part in ipairs(self.UpgradeModel:GetChildren()) do
		
		if part.Name == "Window" then
			part.Transparency = .7
			local clickdetector = part:FindFirstChild("ClickDetector") or Instance.new("ClickDetector",part)
			clickdetector.MaxActivationDistance = 10
			table.insert(self.HouseEvents,clickdetector.MouseClick:connect(function(player)
				setWindowState(player,part)
	
			end))
			
			
		elseif part.Name == "WallButton" then
			table.insert(self.HouseEvents,part.ClickDetector.MouseClick:connect(function(player)
				setBarrierState(player,part)
			end))
			if self.BarrierVisible then --make invisibe if visibe
				setBarrierState(self.Owner.Object,self.UpgradeModel.WallButton)
			end
		end
	end
	
	--when players starts going down basement stairs, give player script that makes the water and baseplate dissapear until player comes back to first floor
	if self.Upgrade == "Basement" then
		table.insert(self.HouseEvents,self.UpgradeModel.GoingToBasement.Touched:connect(function(hit)
			if hit and hit.Parent and hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and not hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Basement") then
				local basement = script.Basement:clone()
				basement.Disabled = false
				basement.Parent = hit.Parent
			end
		end))
	end

end






function House:LoadHouse(Player,upgradeName,furniture,colors,wallpapers,floors,garageEnabled)
	
	self.Owner = Player
		
	self.Upgrade = Enums.HouseSizes[upgradeName] or upgradeName or (Player and Debug.Enabled and Debug.HouseSize) or  (Player ~= nil and "Tiny") or "Medium"
	
	self.Colors = colors or {["Wall"] = 5, ["Roof"] = 1003, ["Window"] = 5, ["Door"] = 192}
	
	self.Wallpapers = ConvertCompatablilty(wallpapers) or wallpapers or {["FirstFloor"] = "142751224",["SecondFloor"] = "142751224",["ThirdFloor"] = "142751224",["Basement"] = "142751224"}

	self.Floors = ConvertCompatablilty(floors) or floors or {["FirstFloor"] = "142263417",["SecondFloor"] = "142263417",["ThirdFloor"] = "142263417",["Basement"] = "142263417"}
	
	self.GarageEnabled = garageEnabled or (Debug.Enabled and not Debug.LoadSaveData and Debug.GarageEnabled ) or false
	self:LoadGarage()
	
	self.Mailbox.Name = ((Player and Player.Object.Name) or (Enums.IsPartyServer and "") or self.Address)
	
	self.FurnitureCount = 0
	
	
	self:SetUpgrade(self.Upgrade)
	
	
	 
	
		
	--delete furniture----
	for _,furn in pairs(self.Furniture) do
		furn:Delete()
	end
	
	self.Furniture = {}
	
	--loadfurniture
	if Player and furniture then
		for _,savedData in ipairs(furniture) do
				
			local furniture = Furniture.new(self,savedData)
			if furniture then
				self.Furniture[furniture.Object] = furniture
				furniture:Initialize() --need to be here
								
				--keep track of the number of furniture
				if furniture.Data.Category == "Customization" then
					self.FurnitureCount = self.FurnitureCount + .5
				else
					self.FurnitureCount = self.FurnitureCount + 1
				end
			end
		end
	end
	
	------------
	
	

	
end




function House:PlaceFurniture(player,assetId,furnitureModel,newCFrame)
	
	
	--if has too much furniture in house
	if self.FurnitureCount >= Enums.MaxNumFurniture[self.Upgrade] then
		Dialog:ShowMessage(player,"House Full","You have too much furniture in your house.")
		furnitureModel:Destroy()
		return
	end


	if furnitureModel == nil then
		error("Furniture model dosent exist playerData = " .. tostring(self.Owner))
	end
	
	local playerData = self.Owner
	local inventory = playerData.Inventory
	local placedFurniture = playerData.PlacedFurniture
	local notZero = playerData:IncrementItemQuantity(assetId,-1) --subtract 1 from item in inventory
	if notZero then --if item was in inventory
		

		local border = furnitureModel.BorderPointer.Value
		--furnitureModel:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(newCFrame) --update model to the new positiond define by the client
		local localCFrame = self.UpgradeModel.Marker.CFrame:toObjectSpace(newCFrame) --convert to local
		
		local furniture = Furniture.new(self,nil,assetId,localCFrame,furnitureModel)
		self.Furniture[furniture.Object] = furniture
		furniture:Initialize() --need to be here
		
		--keep track of the number of furniture
		if furniture.Data.Category == "Customization" then
			self.FurnitureCount = self.FurnitureCount + .5
		else
			self.FurnitureCount = self.FurnitureCount + 1
		end
	
		
		
		
		
		playerData.DraggingFurniture = nil

	else
		furnitureModel:Destroy()
		
	end
end

function House:DeleteFurniture(furnitureModel)
	for furnitureObject,furnitureData in pairs(self.Furniture) do
		if furnitureData.Object == furnitureModel then
			local success = furnitureData.House.Owner:IncrementItemQuantity(furnitureData.AssetId,1)
			if success then
				if furnitureData.Data.Category == "Customization" then
					self.FurnitureCount = self.FurnitureCount - .5
				else
					self.FurnitureCount = self.FurnitureCount - 1
				end
				furnitureData:Delete()
				self.Furniture[furnitureObject] = nil
			end
		end
	end
end

		local playerListPart = self.Object.PlayerList

		spawn(function()
				
				math.randomseed(Utility:StringToUniqueNumber(self.Object.Name)) --so the checks happen at differnt times that other houses
				wait(math.random(1,60))
			
				while true do
					wait(10)
					local playersInsideHouse = self:GetPlayersInside()
					for _,player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
						
						local insideHouse = false
						for _,insidePlayer in ipairs(playersInsideHouse) do
							if insidePlayer == player then
								insideHouse = true
							end
						end
						
						if self.Owner and self.Owner.Object == player and player.Character and player.Character.Parent and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
							if not insideHouse and player:DistanceFromCharacter(self.GivePizza.Position) > 50 and player.Character.Head:FindFirstChild("HostBillboardGui") then
								player.Character.Head.HostBillboardGui:Destroy()
							elseif insideHouse and player.Character.Head:FindFirstChild("HostBillboardGui") == nil then
								local host = game.ServerStorage.HostBillboardGui:clone()
								host.Parent = player.Character.Head
							end
						end
						
						if not insideHouse and billboard.Frame:FindFirstChild(player.Name) and player:DistanceFromCharacter(self.GivePizza.Position) > 50 then
							billboard.Frame[player.Name]:Destroy()
						elseif insideHouse and billboard.Frame:FindFirstChild(player.Name) == nil then
							local URL,ready = game.Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync ( player.userId, Enum.ThumbnailType.AvatarThumbnail,Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size180x180)

							local template = billboard.Frame.Template
							local newIcon = template:clone()
							newIcon.Name = player.Name
							newIcon.Visible = true
							newIcon.Image = URL
							newIcon.Parent = billboard.Frame

							workspace.Main.PlayerEnteredHouse:FireAllClients(player.userId,newIcon)
						end

							billboard.Enabled = false
						else

function House:LoadGarage()
	
	for _,event in ipairs(self.GarageEvents) do
		event:disconnect()
	end
	self.GarageEvents = {}

	
	if not self.GarageEnabled then self.Garage.Parent = game.ServerStorage.HouseStorage return end
	
	
	self.Garage.Parent = self.Object
	
	self.Garage.Gate.Size = self.OriginalGarageGateSize
	self.Garage.Gate.CFrame = self.OriginalGarageGateCFrame

	local boundsBlock = self.BoundsBlocks[self.Garage]
	if boundsBlock == nil then
		boundsBlock = self.Garage.HouseBoundsBlock
		boundsBlock.Transparency = 1
		boundsBlock.Parent = game.ServerStorage
		boundsBlock.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(boundsBlock.Position.X,17.4,boundsBlock.Position.Z))
		self.BoundsBlocks[self.Garage] = boundsBlock
	end
	
	Environment:ClearTreesForHouse(self.Garage,boundsBlock)
	

		
	local function openGate(player,gate)
		
		if (self.Owner and self.Owner == Players[player]) or gate.CFrame:pointToObjectSpace(player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).X > 0 then --dont let the player get trapped inside garage
			
			local pos = gate.Position
			local size = gate.Size
			local frame = gate.CFrame
			local loop = gate.Size.y
					
			for i=0,loop,1.2 do
				wait(.1)--wait(.03)
				gate.Size = Vector3.new(size.x,size.y-i,size.z)
				gate.CFrame = frame + Vector3.new(0,i/2,0)
			end
			
			
			local isOwner = (self.Owner and self.Owner.Object and self.Owner.Object == player)
			if isOwner then
				while player and player.Parent and player.Character and player:DistanceFromCharacter(gate.Position) < 50 do
					wait(1)
				end
			end
			
			
			pos = gate.Position
			size = gate.Size
			frame = gate.CFrame
			
			for i=0,loop,1.2 do
				wait(.1)
				gate.Size = Vector3.new(size.x,size.y+i,size.z)
				gate.CFrame = frame + Vector3.new(0,-i/2,0)
			end
		end
	end
	
	
	
	local buttonDebounce = false
	
	self.GarageEvents[1] = self.Garage.Button.ClickDetector.MouseClick:connect(function(player)
		if not Enums.IsPartyServer and not buttonDebounce and player.Character ~= nil and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
			buttonDebounce = true
			if Players[player] and self.Owner and self.Owner == Players[player] then
				Vehicles:SpawnCarInGarage(player,self.Garage.GarageFloor)
			end
			wait(3)
			buttonDebounce = false
		end
	end)
		
	self.GarageEvents[2] = self.Garage.Button.Button.Touched:connect(function(hit) 
		if not buttonDebounce and not Enums.IsPartyServer then
			local player =  Utility:GetPlayerFromBodyPart(hit)
			if player then
				buttonDebounce = true				
				if Players[player] and self.Owner and self.Owner == Players[player] then
					Vehicles:SpawnCarInGarage(player,self.Garage.GarageFloor)
				end
				wait(3)
				buttonDebounce = false
			end
		end
	end)
		

	local gateDebounce = false

	self.GarageEvents[3] = self.Garage.Gate.Touched:connect(function(hit) 
		if not gateDebounce then
			local player =  Utility:GetPlayerFromBodyPart(hit)
			if player then
				gateDebounce = true
				openGate(player,self.Garage.Gate) 
				gateDebounce = false
			end
		end
	end)

	self.GarageEvents[4] = self.Garage.Gate.ClickDetector.MouseClick:connect(function(player) 
		if not gateDebounce then
			gateDebounce = true
			openGate(player,self.Garage.Gate) 
			gateDebounce = false
		end
	end)

end



function House:GetFurnitureInRoom(room)

	for object,data in pairs(self.Furniture) do
		if data.Room == room then
			table.insert(furnitureObjects,object)
		end
	end
	return furnitureObjects
end

function House:PlayerLeftHouse(player)
	if Enums.IsPartyServer then
		local billboard = self.Object.PlayerList.BillboardGui
		if billboard.Frame:FindFirstChild(player.Name) then
			billboard.Frame[player.Name]:Destroy()
		end
		
		if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") and player.Character.Head:FindFirstChild("HostBillboardGui") then
			player.Character.Head.HostBillboardGui:Destroy()
		end
	
	end
end


function House:SetUpgrade(upgradeName)
	
	self.Upgrade = upgradeName
	
	if self.UpgradeModel then --get rid of current upgrade
		SetRoomsEnabled(self,false)
		self.UpgradeModel.Parent = game.ServerStorage.HouseStorage
	end
		
	self.UpgradeModel = self.AllUpgrades[upgradeName]
	self.UpgradeModel.Parent = self.Upgrades
	self.Object.CurrentUpgrade.Value = self.UpgradeModel
	
	--change room object of all the furniture
	for object,data in pairs(self.Furniture) do
		data:UpdateRoom()
	end
		
		
	SetRoomsEnabled(self,true)
	
	self:RefreshPaint()
	
	--window, open garage, open barrier
	AddHouseEvents(self)
	

	local boundsBlock = self.BoundsBlocks[self.UpgradeModel]
	if boundsBlock == nil then
		boundsBlock = self.UpgradeModel.HouseBoundsBlock
		boundsBlock.Transparency = 1
		boundsBlock.Parent = game.ServerStorage
		boundsBlock.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(boundsBlock.Position.X,17.4,boundsBlock.Position.Z))
		self.BoundsBlocks[self.UpgradeModel] = boundsBlock
	end
	
	Environment:ClearTreesForHouse(self.Garage,boundsBlock)
	
	
	
	---doors----
	for i,door in ipairs(self.Doors) do
		--close door
		door:SetState(false)
		door:DisconnectEvents()
		self.Doors[i] = nil
	end
	
	self.Doors = {}
	
	for _,door in ipairs(self.UpgradeModel.Doors:GetChildren()) do
		local doorData = Door.new(door,self)
		table.insert(self.Doors,doorData)
		if doorData.Type == "FrontDoor" then
			self.FrontDoor = doorData
		end
	end
	----------
	
	
	

	
	self.GivePizza = self.UpgradeModel.GivePizza
	
	if self.GivePizzaConnection then self.GivePizzaConnection:disconnect() end
	
	if not Enums.IsPartyServer then
		self.GivePizzaConnection = self.GivePizza.Touched:connect(function(hit)
			workspace.Main.GivePizzaTouched:Fire(hit,self.Object,self.GivePizza,self.Guy)
		end)
	end
	
	
		---Clearing out snow for backyard and garage	
	if game.ReplicatedStorage.GlobalData.Season.Value == "Winter" then
		
		local function SwitchSnow(visible,name)
			local snow = workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
			if not snow then
				snow = game.ServerStorage:FindFirstChild(name)
			end	
			if visible then
				snow.Parent = workspace
			else
				snow.Parent = game.ServerStorage
			end
		end
		
		if self.Owner then
			
			if self.Upgrade == "Backyard" or self.Upgrade == "Basement" then --clear out snow in the backyard
				SwitchSnow(false,"SnowBackyard" .. self.Index)
			end
			
			if self.Upgrade == "Basement" then --get rid of snow underneath the house
				SwitchSnow(false,"SnowHouse" .. self.Index)
			end
			
			if self.GarageEnabled then
				SwitchSnow(false,"SnowGarage" .. self.Index)
			end
		
		else
			SwitchSnow(true,"SnowGarage" .. self.Index)
			SwitchSnow(true,"SnowBackyard" .. self.Index)
			SwitchSnow(true,"SnowHouse" .. self.Index)
		end
	end
	
			

	
	
end






function House:IsPlayerInsideHouse(player)
	local torso = Utility:GetObjectInsideCharacter(player,"HumanoidRootPart")
	if torso then
		for box,data in pairs(self.Rooms[self.UpgradeModel]) do
			if Utility.IsPointInsideBox(box,torso.Position) then
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function House:GetPlayersInside()
	local insidePlayers = {}
	for _,player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if self:IsPlayerInsideHouse(player) then
			table.insert(insidePlayers,player)
		end
	end
	return insidePlayers
end




function House:KickPlayerFromHouse(player)
	local humanoid = Utility:GetObjectInsideCharacter(player,"Humanoid")
	local playerData = Players[player]
	if humanoid and not humanoid.Sit then
		playerData:Teleport(self.UpgradeModel.Walkway.Position)
	--	self:PlayerLeftHouse(player)
	end
end

		Dialog:ShowMessage("Party Shutdown", "The host has left the game.")
	end
end




function House:PaintFurniture(part,color)
	if part and part.Parent and self.Furniture[part.Parent] then -- will be nil if painting other people funrtiture
		self.Furniture[part.Parent]:SetColor(part,color)
	end
end



function House:SetColor(groupName,color)
	
	if groupName == "DoorTouch" then groupName = "Door" end
	
	self.Colors[groupName] = color
	
	local function paintChildren(model)
		for _,part in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
			if part:IsA("Model") then --doors are models
				paintChildren(part)
			elseif part.Name == groupName or (part.Name == "Barrier" and groupName == "Wall") then
				part.BrickColor = BrickColor.new(color)
			end
		end
	end
	
	paintChildren(self.UpgradeModel)

	if self.GarageEnabled then
		paintChildren(self.Garage)
	end
	
end


function House:RefreshPaint()
	for Type,brickcolor in pairs(self.Colors) do
		self:SetColor(Type,brickcolor)
	end
end


--gather properties of the wall and floor assets to be sent to client
function House:PackageWallFloor(zone)
	--backyard does not have wallpaper or floors
	if zone.Name == "Backyard" or zone.Name == "Porch" or zone.Name == "Balcony" then return nil end
	local floorId = self.Floors[zone.Name]
	if not floorId then --if a new updated added a new room
		self.Floors[zone.Name] = "142263417"
		floorId = "142263417"
	end
	local floorObject = AssetLibraryManager:GetAssetById(floorId).Object
	local floorData = {Texture = floorObject.Texture.Texture,Transparency = floorObject.Texture.Transparency,StudsPerTileU = floorObject.Texture.StudsPerTileU,StudsPerTileV = floorObject.Texture.StudsPerTileV,Reflectance = floorObject.Reflectance,Material = floorObject.Material,BrickColor = floorObject.BrickColor}
									
									
	local wallpaperId = self.Wallpapers[zone.Name]
	if not wallpaperId then--if a new updated added a new room
		self.Wallpapers[zone.Name] = "142751224"
		wallpaperId = "142751224"
	end
	local wallpaperObject = AssetLibraryManager:GetAssetById(wallpaperId).Object
	local wallpaperData ={Texture = wallpaperObject.Texture.Texture,Transparency = wallpaperObject.Texture.Transparency,StudsPerTileU = wallpaperObject.Texture.StudsPerTileU,StudsPerTileV = wallpaperObject.Texture.StudsPerTileV}
	return floorData,wallpaperData
end




function House:SetWallorFloor(room,assetId)
	
	local category = AssetLibraryManager:GetAssetById(assetId).Category
	local textureObjects = nil 
	
	if category == "Walls" then
		self.Wallpapers[room.Name] = assetId
	else
		self.Floors[room.Name] = assetId
	end
	
	local floorData,wallpaperData = self:PackageWallFloor(room)
	workspace.Main.WallOrFloorChanged:FireAllClients(self.Object,room,floorData,wallpaperData) --let the rest of the clients know the walls have changed
	
end


function House:GetOwner()
	--if player left but didnt clean up house for some reason
	if self.Owner and (not self.Owner.Object or not self.Owner.Object.Parent) then
 		delay(10,function()
			if self.Owner and (not self.Owner.Object or not self.Owner.Object.Parent) then
				error("House didnt lose ownership when player left.")
			end
		end)
	end
	return self.Owner
end

function House:SetOwner(Player)
	self.Owner = Player
	self.Object.Owner.Value = Player.Object
end
