function ConvertPosition(self,object,savedData)
	local inverse_rotation = {
		[0] = 2,
		[1] = 3,	
		[2] = 0,
		[3] = 1,
	}
	
	local function boxProduct(product,offset)
		if offset == "" or product:FindFirstChild("Border") then return end
		local product_cframe = product:GetModelCFrame()
		local product_position =Vector3.new(product_cframe.x,product_cframe.y,product_cframe.z)
		local product_size = product:GetModelSize()
		local box = Instance.new("Part")
		box.Anchored = true
		box.Transparency = 1
		box.Name = "Border"
		box.CanCollide = false
		box.FormFactor = 0
		box.Size = Vector3.new(Utility:RoundUp(product_size.x,4),Utility:RoundUp(product_size.y,4),Utility:RoundUp(product_size.z,4))
		box.Parent = product
		local axis = nil
		if product.Name == "Workout Dumbells" or product.Name == "Outdoors Log Bench" or product.Name == "Tot Slide" or product.Name == "Patio Umbrella" or product.Name == "Varknox TV" or product.Name == "Princess Vanity"  then
			axis = product_size.z
		elseif product.Name == "Antler Bed" or product.Name == "Modern Coffee Table" or product.Name == "Modern Couch" or product.Name == "Bowling" or product.Name == "Stainless Microwave" or product.Name == "Pink Microwave" then
			axis = product_size.x
		else
			axis = product_size.y
		end
		
		box.CFrame = product_cframe + Vector3.new(0,(Utility:RoundUp(axis,4) - axis)/2,0)
		--box.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(product_position.x, product_position.y + (roundUp(axis,4) - axis),product_position.z))
	end
	
	local function rotateModel(model,orientation)
		local amount = 0--math.pi
		if orientation == 0 then
			return
		elseif orientation == 1 then
			amount = math.pi/2
		elseif orientation == 2 then
			amount = math.pi
		elseif orientation == 3 then
			amount = -math.pi/2
		end
		local rotCF = CFrame.fromEulerAnglesXYZ(0, amount, 0)
		for i, object in pairs(model:GetChildren()) do
			if object:IsA("Part") or object:IsA("TrussPart") or object:IsA("UnionOperation") or object:IsA("WedgePart") or object:IsA("CornerWedgePart") or object:IsA("Seat") or object:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
				object.CFrame = rotCF * object.CFrame
			end
		end
	end
	if self.House.Inverted then
		if savedData.Reflection then
			rotateModel(object,inverse_rotation[savedData.Orientation])
		else
			rotateModel(object,savedData.Orientation)
		end
	else
		if not savedData.Reflection then
			rotateModel(object,inverse_rotation[savedData.Orientation])
		else			
			rotateModel(object,savedData.Orientation)
		end
	end
	local marker = self.House.UpgradeModel.Marker
	if self.House.Inverted then
		Utility:MoveModel(object,Vector3.new(marker.Position.x + savedData["X"],marker.Position.y + savedData["Y"],marker.Position.z + savedData["Z"]))
	else
		Utility:MoveModel(object,Vector3.new(marker.Position.x - savedData["X"],marker.Position.y + savedData["Y"],marker.Position.z - savedData["Z"]))
	end
	
	return marker.CFrame:toObjectSpace(object.PrimaryPart.CFrame)
end


local function ConvertColors(colors)
	if colors then
		while colors[1] do
			table.remove(colors,1)
		end
		return colors
	end
end


local function SetPropertyByName(name,root,properties)
	for _,obj in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
		for propName,value in pairs(properties) do
			if obj.Name == name then
				obj[propName] = value
			end
		end
		SetPropertyByName(name,obj,properties)
	end
end

function Furniture:Initialize()


	local object = self.Object
	local house = self.House
	
	object:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(house.UpgradeModel.Marker.CFrame:toWorldSpace(self.LocalCFrame)) --move furniture to position

	local roomExists = self:UpdateRoom()
	if not roomExists then return end
	
	
	if self.Room.Name == "Porch" or self.Room.Name == "Balcony" or object:FindFirstChild("Preload") then
		
		self.Object.Parent = house.Object.Furniture
		
		if not object:FindFirstChild("Preload") then
			local preload = Instance.new("IntValue")
			preload.Name = "Preload"
			preload.Parent = object
		end
		
		if object:FindFirstChild("MusicPlayer") and house and house.Owner then
			Dialog:ShowMessage(house.Owner.Object,"","Music players don't work on porches and balconies.")
		end
	end
	

	--set config value and listen for changes
	if object:FindFirstChild("Config") then

		--string values cant be set to nil
		if  self.Config == nil and object.Config.ClassName == "StringValue" then
			self.Config = ""
		elseif self.Config == nil and (object.Config.Value ~= 0 and object.Config.Value ~= "" and object.Config.Value ~= 0) then --furniture with default config values like the multi light
			self.Config = object.Config.Value
		end
		
		object.Config.Value = self.Config
		
		self.ConfigChanged = object.Config.Changed:connect(function(value)
			self.Config = value
		end)
		
	end
	
	



	
	--enable then and then put in ServerScriptService
	local function EnableScripts(root) 
		for i,v in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
			if v:IsA("Script") and not v:IsA("LocalScript") then
				
				local objValue = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
				objValue.Value = object
				objValue.Name = "ObjectPointer"
				
				local housePointer = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
				housePointer.Value = house.Object
				housePointer.Name = "HousePointer"
				
				local e = v:clone()
				objValue.Parent = e
				housePointer.Parent = e
				e.Disabled  = (e:FindFirstChild("DontEnable") and true) or false
				e.Parent = game.ServerScriptService
				
				table.insert(self.Scripts,e)
				
				
				v:Destroy()
				
			else
				EnableScripts(v)
			end
		end
	end
	EnableScripts(object)
	
	
	
	--make new furniture visible for players in the same room
	local floorData,wallData = house:PackageWallFloor(self.Room)
	workspace.Main.FurnitureAdded:FireAllClients(house.Object,self.Room,object,nil,wallData)



	
	local houseColors = house.Colors
	
	
	--addpaint walls and doors when loaded or placed
	if object:FindFirstChild("Wall") then
		local wallpaperId = house.Wallpapers[self.Room.Name]
		SetPropertyByName("Wall",object,{BrickColor = BrickColor.new(houseColors.Wall)})
	end 
			
	if object:FindFirstChild("DoorClosed") then
		SetPropertyByName("DoorClosed",object,{BrickColor = BrickColor.new(houseColors.Door)})
		SetPropertyByName("DoorOpen",object,{BrickColor = BrickColor.new(houseColors.Door)})		
	end
	
	
	
	--color all the parts
	local children = object:GetChildren()
	for partName,color in pairs(self.Colors) do
		for _,object in ipairs(children) do
			if object.Name == partName then
				object.BrickColor = BrickColor.new(color)
			end
		end
	end
	
	object.BorderPointer.Value.Parent = game.ReplicatedStorage.BorderStorage
	
	
	
	


end

--when upgrade model changes, need to update
function Furniture:UpdateRoom()
	--find the room the item is in
	for roomObject,_ in pairs(self.House.Rooms[self.House.UpgradeModel]) do
		if Utility.IsPointInsideBox(roomObject,self.Object.BorderPointer.Value.Position) then
			self.Room = roomObject
			
			break
		end
	end
	
	--if not furniture is no inside any room, put back into inventory
	if self.Room == nil then
		self.House:DeleteFurniture(self.Object)
		return false
	else
		return true
	end
end



function Furniture:SetColor(part,color)
	
	self.Colors[part.Name] = color

	for _,obj in ipairs(self.Object:GetChildren()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Name == part.Name then
			obj.BrickColor = BrickColor.new(color)
		end
	end
end

	self.Object:Destroy()

	end

	end

function Customers:FindOpenSeat()
	
	math.randomseed(math.floor((tick()-math.floor(tick()))*10000))
	math.random()
	
	local unoccupied = {} 
	for _,chair in ipairs(workspace.Seating:GetChildren()) do
		for _,part in ipairs(chair:GetChildren()) do
			if part:IsA("Seat") and not part.Occupant then
				local occupied = false
				for customer,data in pairs(self.AllCustomers) do --make sure no other customers are about to sit there
					if data.Seat == part then
						occupied = true
					end
				end
				if not occupied then
					table.insert(unoccupied,part)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if #unoccupied  ~= 0 then
		return unoccupied[math.random(1,#unoccupied)]
	end
end

function PlayerInDriveThrough()
	local areaBlock = workspace.CustomerBlock2
	for _,player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			local sizeX = areaBlock.Size.X
			local sizeZ = areaBlock.Size.Z
			local positionX = areaBlock.Position.X
			local positionZ = areaBlock.Position.Z
			local torsoPos = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
			
			if torsoPos.x > positionX - (sizeX/2) then
			if torsoPos.x < positionX + (sizeX/2) then
			if torsoPos.z > positionZ - (sizeZ/2) then
			if torsoPos.z < positionZ + (sizeZ/2) then
				return true
			end
			end
			end
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end



local LanesOccupied = {
	Right = false,
	Left = false,
	DriveThrough = false
}

local Lanes = {"Right","Left","DriveThrough"}

local parkingLot = workspace.CustomerParking
local spots = {parkingLot.Spot1, parkingLot.Spot2,parkingLot.Spot3,parkingLot.Spot4,parkingLot.Spot5,parkingLot.Spot6,parkingLot.Spot7,parkingLot.Spot8}

local ParkingSpotsOccupied = {}
for _,spot in ipairs(spots) do ParkingSpotsOccupied[spot] = false end

function Customers:UnoccupyLane(laneName) --when customer goes to sit down
	LanesOccupied[laneName] = false
end



function Customers:Initialize(orders)
	

	Customers.Orders =  orders
	
	local function FindParkingSpot()
		for _,spot in pairs(spots) do
			if not ParkingSpotsOccupied[spot] then
				return spot
			end
		end
	end
	
	workspace.Houses:WaitForChild("House1",20) --wait for hosues to load
	wait()
	local houses = workspace.Houses:GetChildren()
	
	local function SpawnCustomerLane(lane,intervalMin,intervalMax)
		spawn(function()
			local currentCustomer = nil
			while true do
				
				--wait for interation to finish before starting countdown for a new customer
				while currentCustomer and currentCustomer.Model and currentCustomer.Model.Parent and (currentCustomer.State ~= Enums.CustomerStates.Leaving and currentCustomer.State ~= Enums.CustomerStates.SittingAtTable) do
					wait(1)
				end
				
				--slow down customer rate at night
				local isNight = Environment.TimeOfDay == "Night"
				local muliplier = (isNight and 2) or 1 --high number = slower
			
				
				if lane == "DriveThrough" then
					wait(math.random(self.SpawnDriveThroughRate - self.DriveThroughVariance, self.SpawnDriveThroughRate + self.DriveThroughVariance) * muliplier)
				else
					wait(math.random(self.SpawnRate - self.SpawnVariance, self.SpawnRate + self.SpawnVariance) * muliplier)
				end
				
				if lane and not LanesOccupied[lane] then
					
					local parkingSpot = FindParkingSpot()
					if (lane ~= "DriveThrough" and parkingSpot) 
					or (lane == "DriveThrough" and not PlayerInDriveThrough()) then
						

						local order = {}
						order.Order = math.random(1,4)
						order.House = houses[math.random(1,#houses)]
						order.Phase = 1
						table.insert(orders,order)
						
						LanesOccupied[lane] = true
						if parkingSpot then ParkingSpotsOccupied[parkingSpot] = true end
						
						currentCustomer = Customer.new(self,order,lane,parkingSpot)
						order.Object = currentCustomer.Model
						spawn(function()
							currentCustomer:StartPathFinding()
						end)
							
						table.insert(self.AllCustomers,currentCustomer)
					
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end
	spawn(function()
		while #self.Outfits == 0 do wait(.1) end
		--start a thread for each lane
		SpawnCustomerLane("Right")
		wait(self.SpawnRate)
		SpawnCustomerLane("Left")
		wait(1)
		SpawnCustomerLane("DriveThrough")
	end)
end


		
function Customers:delete(customer)
	for i,cus in ipairs(self.AllCustomers) do
		if cus == customer then
			if customer.Model then
				customer.Model:Destroy()
			end
			
			if customer.Car then
				customer.Car:Destroy()
			end
			
			if customer.OccupyingLane then
				LanesOccupied[customer.Lane] = false
			end
			
			if customer.ParkingSpot then
				ParkingSpotsOccupied[customer.ParkingSpot] = false
			end
			
			customer.Deleted = true

			table.remove(self.AllCustomers,i)
		end
	end
end

function Customer:StartPathFinding()
	
	wait()
	local function walkPath(path,this)   ---set customer to walk on path
		if not this.Model or not this.Model:FindFirstChild("Torso") then return end
		local torso = this.Model.Torso
		for _,part in pairs(path) do
			
			if self.Deleted then return end
			
			local seated = self.Model.Humanoid.Seated:connect(function(active,seat)
				if active and this.Lane ~= "DriveThrough" and seat ~= self.Seat then
					this.Model.Humanoid.JumpPower = 10
					this.Model.Humanoid.Jump = true
					delay(.5,function() if not this.Deleted and this.Humanoid then this.Humanoid.JumpPower = 50 end end)
				end
			end)
			
			this.Model.Humanoid:MoveTo(part.Position+ Vector3.new(0,2.5,0))
			
			local finished = false
			
			spawn(function() --keep customer walking
				while not this.Deleted and not finished and this.Model and this.Model:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") do
					this.Model.Humanoid:MoveTo(part.Position+ Vector3.new(0,2.5,0))
					wait(2)
				end
			end)
			
			spawn(function() --teleport to destination if take too long
				wait(10)
				if this.Lane ~= "DriveThrough" and not this.Deleted and not finished and self.Model and self.Model:FindFirstChild("Torso") then
					if self.State == Enums.CustomerStates.WalkingToTable and this.Seat and this.Seat.Occupant ~= nil then return end -- see if a player is sitting in the seat
					this.Model.Humanoid.Jump = true
					wait(1)
					if  self.Model and self.Model:FindFirstChild("Torso") then
						self.Model.Torso.CFrame = CFrame.new(part.Position + Vector3.new(0,2.5,0))
					end
				elseif this.Lane == "DriveThrough" and not this.Deleted and not finished and self.Car then
					self:delete()
				end
			end)
			
			local posX = part.Position.X
			local posZ = part.Position.Z
			while not this.Deleted and (torso.Position-Vector3.new(posX,torso.Position.Y,posZ)).magnitude > 2 do
				wait() 
			end	
			finished = true
			
			seated:disconnect()
			
		end
	end
	
	
	local function ReverseTable(tab)
		local newTable = {}
		local j = 0
		for i=#tab,1,-1 do
			j = j + 1
			newTable[j] = tab[i]
		end
		return newTable
	end
	

	
	
	
	
	
	

	local parkingLotPath = nil
	if self.Lane ~= "DriveThrough" then
		parkingLotPath = Paths.ParkingPaths[self.ParkingSpot] --walk from car to entrance
		walkPath(parkingLotPath,self)
		SoundFX:PlaySoundInsideZone("EntranceTone","Cashier")
	end
	
	local lanePath = Paths.Lanes[self.Lane] --walk from entrance to cashier
	walkPath(lanePath,self)
	
	
	if self.Lane == "DriveThrough" and self.Car and self.Car:FindFirstChild("Seat") then --stop car by anchoring
		self.Car.Seat.Anchored = true
	end
	
	
	
	--[[if self.Lane ~= "DriveThrough" then
		self.State = Enums.CustomerStates.WalkingToTable
	else
		self.State = Enums.CustomerStates.Leaving
	end
	wait(8)]]
	
	self.State = Enums.CustomerStates.WaitingForCashier

	
	while not self.Deleted and self.State ==  Enums.CustomerStates.WaitingForCashier do   --- stay in same spot until cashier is finished
		wait(.3)
	end
	
	if self.Deleted then return end

	self.Container:UnoccupyLane(self.Lane)
	self.OccupyingLane = false
	
	wait(2)  --let player read the customer chat
	
	if self.Deleted then return end

	
	
	if self.Lane == "DriveThrough" and self.Car and self.Car:FindFirstChild("Seat") then --stop car by anchoring
		self.Car.Seat.Anchored = false
	end

	
	if self.State ==  Enums.CustomerStates.Leaving  then  --if cashier messed up the order
		if self.Lane == "DriveThrough" then
			wait(2) --give 2 seconds to drive off
			if self.Deleted then return end
		else
			walkPath(ReverseTable(parkingLotPath),self)
			if self.Deleted then return end
		end
	end
	
	
	
	if self.State ==  Enums.CustomerStates.WalkingToTable then  --if cahsier chose correct button
		
		self.Seat = self.Container:FindOpenSeat()-- choose random seat
		
		local seatPathEnter = self.Seat.PathEnter:GetChildren()--Paths.SeatEnter[self.Seat] --find path associated with object
		walkPath(seatPathEnter,self)
		walkPath({self.Seat},self)
		wait()
		if not self.Deleted and self.Humanoid and not self.Humanoid.Sit and self.Seat.Occupant == nil and self.Model and self.Model:FindFirstChild("Torso") then
			self.Model.Torso.CFrame = self.Seat.CFrame
		end
		
		self.State =  Enums.CustomerStates.SittingAtTable
		
		wait(math.random(SitTime-SitTimeVariance,SitTime+SitTimeVariance)) 
		
		self.State =  Enums.CustomerStates.Leaving
		
		if self.Deleted then return end
		
		if not self.Model or not self.Model:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then self:delete() end
		
		self.Humanoid.JumpPower = 10
		self.Humanoid.Jump = true
		delay(.5,function()if self.Humanoid then self.Humanoid.JumpPower = 50 end end)
		
		
		local seatPathExit = self.Seat.PathExit:GetChildren()--Paths.SeatExit[self.Seat] --find path associated with object
		--self.Model.Torso.CFrame = CFrame.new(seatPathExit[1].Position + Vector3.new(0,2,0))
		walkPath(seatPathExit,self)
		if self.Deleted then return end
		
		local doByeEmotion = math.random(1,3) --1 in 3 changes of saying bye when leaving
		if doByeEmotion == 3 then 
			self:ShowEmotion("Bye")
		end
		
		walkPath(ReverseTable(parkingLotPath),self) -- walk to car
		if self.Deleted then return end
	end
	
	self:delete()
	
	
end

		if emote == 1 or emote == 2 or emote == 3 then
			self:ShowEmotion("Angry")
		elseif emote == 4 then

		elseif emote == 5 then

		end
		
		--say somthing negative
		--local negative = ChooseRandom(Dialog.CustomerNegative)
		--game:GetService("Chat"):Chat(self.Model.Head,negative,0)
		--print(negative)	
		
	else
		if self.Lane == "DriveThrough" then
			self.State = Enums.CustomerStates.Leaving
		else
			self.State = Enums.CustomerStates.WalkingToTable
		end
		
		--say something positive

		if math.random(1,3) == 1  then

		end
	end
end






function Customer:ShowEmotion(emotion)
	
	if not debounce and self.Model and self.Model:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
		local model = self.Model
		local humanoid = model.Humanoid

		debounce = true
		local animation = model.Head:FindFirstChild(emotion)
		
		if animation then
			
			local face = model.Head:FindFirstChild("face")
			local newFace = animation:FindFirstChild("Face")
			if face and newFace then
				local FT = face.Texture
				face.Texture = newFace.Texture
				delay(2,function() 
					face.Texture = FT
				end)
			end
		
			local animTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(animation)
			animTrack:Play()
			
			local sound = model.Head:FindFirstChild(animation.Name .. "Sound")
			if sound ~= nil then
				sound:Play()
			end
			
			delay(2,function() 
				debounce = false
			end)
		end
	end
end

function createModel(this)  --creates customer model
	
	local outfits = this.Container.Outfits
	local template = outfits[math.random(1,#outfits)]
	local customer = template:clone()
		
	local remove_debounce = false
	if customer:FindFirstChild("Torso") == nil then  this:delete() return end  --if customer does not spawn correctly
	customer.Torso.Anchored = false

	local humanoid = Instance.new("Humanoid")
	humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = "None"
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = 13
	humanoid.Parent = customer
	
	
	for i,v in ipairs(customer.Head:GetChildren()) do  --sounds won't play inside animation objects
	 	local sound = v:FindFirstChild("Sound")
		if sound ~= nil then
			sound.Name = v.Name .. "Sound"
			sound.Parent = customer.Head
		end
	end
	
	customer.Animate.Disabled = false
	customer.Parent = game.Workspace.Customers
	customer:MakeJoints()
	customer.Torso.Anchored = true
	
	--teleport to fisrt parking path node
	if this.Lane ~= "DriveThrough" then
		local firstPathNode = Paths.ParkingPaths[this.ParkingSpot][1]
		customer.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(firstPathNode.Position + Vector3.new(0,2.5,0))	
	end
	

	for i,v in ipairs(customer:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("Part") then
			v.Anchored = false
		end
	end
	
	
	
	
	--delete customer if stopped working - timeout
	spawn(function()
		local lastState = Enums.CustomerStates.WalkingToEntrance
		while not this.Deleted and this.Model and this.Model.Parent do 
			wait(5)
			
			if lastState ~= this.State and not this.Deleted then
				lastState = this.State
				
				spawn(function() --start new thread for each state change
					
					local currentState = this.State
					if this.State == Enums.CustomerStates.WaitingForCashier or this.State == Enums.CustomerStates.WalkingToEntrance then
						
						wait(300) 
						

						while true do --if timeout happens durring a converation, the customer will never timeout. thats why it loops just incase the player doesnt take the customer order
							
							if not this.Deleted and currentState == Enums.CustomerStates.WaitingForCashier or this.State == Enums.CustomerStates.WalkingToEntrance then --customer waiting too long
							
								local dialog = game.ServerScriptService.GameService.GetCustomerDialog:Invoke(this.Model) --see if anyone is talking to customer and dont make customer leave if so
								if dialog then
									
									if dialog.CurrentPlayer == nil then --if noone is talking
										
										this.State = Enums.CustomerStates.Leaving
										
										wait(60) --give cutstomer 60 seconds to leave else destroy it
										
										if this.Model or this.Model.Parent then
											this:delete()
											return
										end
										
									end
								
								else --if dialong doesnt exist, the destroy
									this:delete()
									return
								end
							
							else  
								return
							end
							
							wait(15)
						end
				
					else
						wait(180)
						
						if not this.Deleted and currentState == this.State then
							this:delete()
						end
					end
				end)
			end
		end
	end)
	

	---Set up dialog---

	local right_index = math.random(1,3)
	for i,choice in ipairs(customer.Head.Dialog:GetChildren()) do
		if right_index == i then  --right answer
				
			local items = {"cheese pizza","pepperoni pizza","sausage pizza","mountain dew"}	
			local customerOrder = ChooseRandom(Dialog.CustomerOrder)
			
			choice.ResponseDialog =  string.gsub(customerOrder,"ordername", items[this.Order.Order])
			choice.Name = "Correct"
			choice.UserDialog =  ChooseRandom(Dialog.PlayerCorrectResponse)
					
			customer.RightOrder.Value = choice
			this.RightOrder = choice
		
		else --wrong answer
	
			choice.ResponseDialog =  ChooseRandom(Dialog.CustomerNegative)
			choice.UserDialog =   ChooseRandom(Dialog.PlayerIncorrectResponse)
					
		end
	end

	delay(.1,function() 
		if customer and customer:FindFirstChild("Torso") then 
			customer.Torso.Anchored = false 
			if this.Lane ~= "DriveThrough" then
				humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) 
			end
		end 
	end)
	
	return customer
end

function createCar(self)
	math.randomseed(math.floor((tick()-math.floor(tick()))*10000))
	math.random()
	local function weld(object)
		local parts,last = {}
		local function scan(parent)
			for _,v in pairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
				--wait()
				if (v:IsA("BasePart") and v ~= workspace.Terrain) then
					if (last ) then
						local w = Instance.new("Weld")
						w.Name = ("%s_Weld"):format(v.Name)
						w.Part0,w.Part1 = last,v
						w.C0 = last.CFrame:inverse()
						w.C1 = v.CFrame:inverse()
						w.Parent = last
					end
					last = v
					table.insert(parts,v)
				elseif v:IsA("BasePart") and v.Name == "Wheel" then
					table.insert(parts,v)
				end
				scan(v)
			end
		end
		scan(object)
		for _,v in pairs(parts) do
			v.Anchored = false
		end
	end
	
	
	
	local vehicles = game.ServerStorage.CustomerVehicles:GetChildren()
	local car = vehicles[math.random(1,#vehicles)]:clone()
	car.Parent = workspace.CustomerCars
	
	if self.Lane == "DriveThrough" then
		car:MakeJoints()
		Utility:RotateModel(car,-90)
		weld(car)
		
			
		car:MoveTo(workspace.CarSpawn.Position)
		car.Seat.Anchored = true
		car.Seat.Disabled = false
		self.Model.Torso.CFrame = CFrame.new(car.Seat.Position)
		
		
		if game.Lighting.TimeOfDay == "15:00:00" or game.Lighting.TimeOfDay == "21:00:00" then
			car.Light.SpotLight.Enabled = true
			car.Light.Material = "Neon"
			car.Light2.Material = "Neon"
			car.Rear_Light.Material = "Neon"
			car.Rear_Light2.Material = "Neon"
		end
	else
		
		car.Seat.BodyVelocity:Destroy()
		car.Seat.BodyGyro:Destroy()
		if math.random(1,2) == 1 then
			Utility:RotateModel(car,180) --half the cars parked the other direction
		end
		Utility:RotateModel(car,math.random(-2,2)) --not always perfect parking
		
		spawn(function()
			repeat
				car:MoveTo(self.ParkingSpot.Position)
				wait(1)
			until not car or not car:FindFirstChild("Seat") or car.Seat.Position.Y < 2.6
		end)	
	end

function onPlayerAdded(player)
	print("Player Added")
	
	

	
	local key = tostring(player.userId)
	local get
	local userId = (Debug.Enabled and Debug.LoadPlayerDataById) or player.userId
	
	--GET saved data - if fail, keep trying
	local success,err
	local NUM_TRIES = 3
	
	if DataStore then
		for i=1,NUM_TRIES do
			success, err = pcall(function()
				get = DataStore:GetAsync(userId)
			end)
			if success then
				break
			else
				wait(1)
			end
		end
		
	end
	
		
	if not success and err then
		spawn(function()
			error(err)
		end)
	end
	
	--use old datastore as a backup just in case the new update fails - save to new one
	-- if player is player the new version of the game but is using the old database
	if success and get == nil then
		success, err = pcall(function()
			get = OldDataStore:GetAsync(userId)
			
		end)
	end
		
	if Debug.Enabled and Debug.SavedData then
		get = Debug.SavedData
	end
	

	if Debug.Enabled and not Debug.LoadSavedData then
		success = false
	
	end 
	

	
	if success then
		
		
		 --is playing for first time
		if (get == nil or get == -1) or player.userId < 0 then
			Players[player] =  Player.new(player,nil)
			if Players[player] == nil then return end
			Players[player]:ListenForEvents()
			print("FIRST TIME PLAYER!")
			Players[player]:Initialize()
			Players[player]:SaveData()
			

		else    --is not playing for the first time
			
			print("saved data loaded")
			Players[player] =  Player.new(player,get)
			if Players[player] == nil then return end
			Players[player]:ListenForEvents()
			Players[player]:Initialize()
			
			--Utility:PrintTable(Players[player])
			
		end

	else						--is playing in solo mode or errored
		
		if game.PlaceVersion ~= 0 then
			print("DATA STORE ERROR")
			workspace.Main.DataStoreError:FireClient(player,"There was an error loading your data. Roblox's saving system may be down. Come back another time.")
			error(player.Name .. err)
			return
		else
			print("solo mode")
			if not Enums.IsOnline then
				Players[player] = Player.new(player,{})
				if Players[player] == nil then return end
				Players[player].DisableSaving = true
				Players[player]:ListenForEvents()
				Players[player]:Initialize()
			else
				error("THIS SHOULD NOT HAPPEN")
			end
		end
		
	end
end




function onPlayerRemoving(player)
	local playerData = Players[player]
	if not Enums.IsStudio and playerData then
		if playerData.DraggingFurniture then playerData.DraggingFurniture:Destroy() end

		if not Enums.IsPartyServer and Vehicles then Vehicles:PlayerLeaving(player) end
		local house = playerData.House
		playerData:SaveData(true) --save before reseting house
		house:KickAllPlayersFromHouse()
		if playerData.LocationHouse then playerData.LocationHouse:PlayerLeftHouse(player) end --for party lists
		house:LoadHouse() --reset house
		if playerData.Gear then playerData.Gear:Destroy() end --remove gear that is in workspace
		Players[player]:Delete() --clean up connections
		Players[player] = nil
	end
end


function Players:Initialize()
	for _,p in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do onPlayerAdded(p) end
	game.Players.PlayerAdded:connect(onPlayerAdded)
	game.Players.PlayerRemoving:connect(onPlayerRemoving)
end

	if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then

		if player.Character:FindFirstChild(particleName) then player.Character[particleName]:Destroy() end

		block.Transparency = 1

	end

	end

	elseif action == "DeleteCanvasProject" and args[1] then
		playerData.CanvasProjects[args[1]] = nil

			table.insert(list,name)
		end
		return list
	
	elseif action == "SetSuit" then
		playerData:SetUniform(tostring(args[2]))

		local newJobName = tostring(args[1])
		if newJobName == "Manager" then return end --prevent exploiters from becoming manager

			--[[playerData:Teleport(playerData.House.UpgradeModel.Walkway.Position)

	elseif action == "GetJobsCompleted" then

	elseif action == "GetSettings" then

	elseif action == "GetSprayId" then

	elseif action == "SetSprayId"  then

	elseif action == "GetHistory" then

	elseif action == "SettingChanged" then

	elseif action == "GetGamePasses" then

	elseif action == "GetVideoCollection" then
		local collectionOwner = args[1]
		local ownerData = Players[collectionOwner]
		if ownerData and ownerData.SavedVideos then
			return ownerData.SavedVideos
		end

				table.remove(playerData.SavedVideos,i)
				break
			end
		end
		return true
		
	elseif action == "TakeVideo" then

	elseif action == "ImportVideo" then
		local serializedVideo = args[1]
		return playerData:ImportVideo(serializedVideo)
		
	elseif action == "GetPlayerCFramesInRoom" then
		local roomName = args[1]

		for _,_player in pairs(game.Players:GetChildren()) do
			if _player ~= player and _player.Parent and _player:FindFirstChild("Room") and _player.Room.Value == roomName and _player.Character and _player.Character.Parent and _player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
				cframes[_player.Name] = _player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
			end
		end
		return cframes
	
		
		
	elseif action == "GetInventory" then
	
		local newInventory = {}
		local library = AssetLibraryManager:GetAssetLibrary()

		for _,item in ipairs(playerData.Inventory) do

				table.insert(newInventory,item)
			end
				
		end
		
		
		return newInventory

	end

function Player:SwitchClothes(uniformOn)
	if self.Character == nil or self.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") == nil then return end
	--put original clothing inside head for storage or put back inside character
	local parent = (self.WearingUniform and self.Character.Head) or self.Character
	for _,obj in pairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
		if obj:IsA("Shirt") or obj:IsA("Pants") or obj:IsA("ShirtGraphic") and obj.Name ~= "Uniform" and obj.Name ~= "BusinessSkirt" then
			obj.Parent = (uniformOn and self.Character.Head) or self.Character
		end
	end

	local bodyColors = self.Character:FindFirstChild("Body Colors") or Instance.new("BodyColors",self.Character)
	bodyColors.LeftLegColor = self.LegColors[1]
	bodyColors.RightLegColor = self.LegColors[2]
	
	
	if self.Character:FindFirstChild("Uniform") then self.Character.Uniform:Destroy() end
	if self.Character:FindFirstChild("BusinessSkirt") then self.Character.BusinessSkirt:Destroy() end

	
	
	if uniformOn then
		
		local uniform = Instance.new("Shirt")
		uniform.ShirtTemplate = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=" .. self.UniformId  
		uniform.Name = "Uniform"
		uniform.Parent = self.Character
		
		
		if self.Character:FindFirstChild("BusinessSkirt") then self.Character.BusinessSkirt:Destroy() end
			
		bodyColors.LeftLegColor = BrickColor.new(1003)
		bodyColors.RightLegColor = BrickColor.new(1003)
				
				
		if self.UniformId  == 81431084 then  -- women suit
					
			local bs = Instance.new("Pants")
			bs.Name = "BusinessSkirt"
			bs.PantsTemplate = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=81924152"
			bs.Parent = self.Character
				
			bodyColors.LeftLegColor = self.LegColors[1]
			bodyColors.RightLegColor = self.LegColors[2]	
		end
	end
	
	
	self.WearingUniform = uniformOn
	
end

function Player:SaveData(waitFinish)
	if self.DisableSaving and Enums.IsOnline then return false end
	if(Debug.Enabled and not Debug.SavingEnabled) or Enums.IsLocalServer then return true end
	
	if not self.Moneyz then error("Moneyz dosent exist") end
	if not self.House then error("House dosent exist") end
	
	self.SavedDataVersion = Enums.SavedDataVersion
	
	
	local savedData = {}
	local function copyTable(dataObject)
		if not dataObject then return end
		for _,key in ipairs(dataObject.SavedData) do
			local value = dataObject[key]
			if type(value) == "table" then
				value = Utility:DeepCopy(value)
			end
			savedData[key] = value
		end
	end
	
	
	copyTable(self)
	copyTable(self.House)


	
	
	--save all the furniture
	savedData.Furniture = {}
	for object,furnitureData in pairs(self.House.Furniture) do
		local saved = {}
		for _,key in ipairs(furnitureData.SavedData) do --get the names of data that needs to be saved
			local value = furnitureData[key]
			if type(value) == "table" then
				value = Utility:DeepCopy(value)
			end
			if key == "LocalCFrame" then
				value = Utility:JSONEncode(value,"CFrame")
			end
			saved[key] = value
		end
		table.insert(savedData.Furniture,saved)
	end
	
	
	
	local finished = false
	local success, err
	
	spawn(function()
		success, err = pcall(function()
			DataStore:SetAsync(tostring(self.Object.userId),savedData)
			print("Finished saving")
			finished = true
		end)
		if not success then 
			finished = true 
			if err then 
				local extension = "("
				local function search(dir)
					local keyType = (type(dir) == "table" and dir[1] and "number") or "string"
					for key,value in pairs(dir) do
						if type(value) == "table" then
							search(value)
						end
						if type(key) ~= keyType then
							extension = extension .. tostring(key) .. tostring(value) .. ","
							return
						end
					end
				end
				search(savedData)

				
				
				if string.find(err,"Cannot convert mixed")  then
					error("Mixed keys " .. extension .. ")ErrorUserId:" .. tostring(self.Object.userId))
				else
					
					error(err) 
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	
	delay(10,function()
		if waitFinish and not finished then
			finished = true
			if not err then
				pcall(function() print(self.Object.Name," took to long to save") end)
				if success then
					error("Saving took too long.")
				else
					error("Saving took too long, errored")
				end
			else
				error(err)
			end
		end
	end)
	
	while waitFinish and not finished do
		wait()
	end
	
	print("Saved player data")
	
	return success or game.PlaceId ~= Enums.PizzaPlaceId
	
end


local function ConvertInventoryStructure(storedAssets)
	local newInventory = {}
	if storedAssets and storedAssets[1] == nil then
		for assetId,quantity in pairs(storedAssets) do
			if quantity > 0 then
				table.insert(newInventory,{AssetId = assetId, Quantity = quantity})
			end
		end
		return newInventory
	end
	return false
end

--some players history was corrumped. had tables with no 1 index. not suppored by json
local function CorruptionCheck(this,history)
	
	if history then
		local copy = Utility:DeepCopy(history)
		for category,categoryList in pairs(history) do
			for i,historyData in ipairs(categoryList) do
				if not historyData[2] or not historyData[1] then
					table.remove(copy[category],i)
					return CorruptionCheck(copy) --need to recurse if there are multiple corrupt items. table gets smaller after removing a item
				end
			end
		end
			
			
			
		return copy
		
	end

	
end

--asset ids were being stored as strings
local function CorruptionCheckInventory(this,inventory)
	
	if this.SavedDataVersion == 0 then --only run once
		if inventory then
			for i,item in ipairs(inventory) do
				if type(item.AssetId) == "string" then
					inventory[i].AssetId = tonumber(item.AssetId)
				end
			end
			return inventory
		end
	else
		return inventory
	end
end

local function ProccessAssetHistory(this,assetHistory)
	
	if assetHistory and this.SavedDataVersion == 0 then --only run once
		
		--remove all defaults from history  --converting to new favorites system and dont want defaults populating the popular list
		local defaults = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Defaults"))
		for category,data in pairs(assetHistory) do
			for i,item in ipairs(data) do
				if defaults[tostring(item[1])] then
					table.remove(data,i)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	
	return assetHistory
end


local function ConvertPlayTimeToPayments(currentUpgrade, play_time)
	
	local seconds_in_hour = 3600
	local upgradeTimes = {seconds_in_hour * 5, seconds_in_hour * 8, seconds_in_hour * 12, seconds_in_hour * 20}
	
	if currentUpgrade and type(currentUpgrade) == "number" and currentUpgrade <= #upgradeTimes and play_time and play_time > 0 then
		--just in case play time is above the max
		if play_time >= upgradeTimes[currentUpgrade] then
			play_time = upgradeTimes[currentUpgrade] - 600 --set back just a little
			play_time = Utility:Round(play_time,10) --min payment increment is 10
		end
		
		return math.floor((play_time/upgradeTimes[currentUpgrade]) * Enums.UpgradePrices[Enums.NextUpgradeName[Enums.HouseSizes[currentUpgrade]]])
	end
	return false
end

		self.Object.Room.Value = "Outside"

		self.LocationHouse = nil

		workspace.Main.LocationChanged:FireClient(self.Object,zone)
		return]]
	end
	
	
	local roomData 
	local houseData
	for _,house in pairs(Houses.AllHouses) do --find the house the zone is located
		if house.Rooms[house.UpgradeModel][zone] then
			houseData = house
			roomData = house.Rooms[house.UpgradeModel][zone]
		end
	end
	
	--if Enums.IsPartyServer and houseData and self.Location == "Outside" then
		--houseData:PlayerEnteredHouse(self.Object)
	
--	end
				

	self.Location = zone
	if roomData and houseData and zone.Name ~= "Balcony" and zone.Name ~= "Porch" then --if zone is a house zone
			
		if  houseData.Owner and houseData.Owner.Object then
			self.Object.Room.Value = houseData.Owner.Object.Name
		else
			self.Object.Room.Value = "Outside"
		end
								
		self.LocationHouse = houseData -- LocationHouse = the house that player is inside
		
		if self.LoadedHouse ~= houseData  then --if player is inside new house, delete all the furniture in the other.
		
			self.LoadedHouse = houseData
			self.LoadedRooms = {}
			workspace.Main.ClearRooms:FireClient(self.Object)
		end
									
																
		if not self.LoadedRooms[zone] then -- dont load room if its already loaded
			self.LoadedRooms[zone] = true
			local furnitureList = houseData:GetFurnitureInRoom(zone)
						
			local floorData,wallpaperData = houseData:PackageWallFloor(zone) --gather all the properties of the walls and floors

			local houseColors = houseData.Colors	
										
			workspace.Main.LocationChanged:FireClient(self.Object,zone,self.LoadedHouse.Object,furnitureList,floorData,wallpaperData,houseColors)
								
		else
			workspace.Main.LocationChanged:FireClient(self.Object,zone,self.LoadedHouse.Object)
		end
									
									
	else --is balcony
		self.LocationHouse = nil
		self.LoadedHouse = nil
		workspace.Main.LocationChanged:FireClient(self.Object,zone)
	end	
end

local MAX_NUM_FAVORITES = 70

function Player:AddAssetToHistory(Type,assetId,assetName)

	if assetName and assetId and Type then
		
		self.AssetHistory[Type] = self.AssetHistory[Type] or {}
		
		for _,assetInfo in ipairs(self.AssetHistory[Type]) do
			if assetInfo[1] == assetId then
				Dialog:ShowMessage(self.Object,"Already Exists","'" .. assetName .. "' has already been added to your favorites.")
				return self.AssetHistory
			end
		end
		
		
		if #self.AssetHistory[Type] == MAX_NUM_FAVORITES then
			Dialog:ShowMessage(self.Object,"Too Many Favorites","You have too many favorites. Delete some favorites to add more.")
			return self.AssetHistory
		end
		
		--alpha numeric and spaces only
		assetName = string.gsub(assetName,"[^%w ]+","")
		
		table.insert(self.AssetHistory[Type],1,{assetId,assetName})
		
		
	end
	return self.AssetHistory
end

function Player:RemoveAssetFromHistory(Type,assetId,assetName)
	for i,assetInfo in ipairs(self.AssetHistory[Type]) do
		if assetInfo[1] == assetId then
			table.remove(self.AssetHistory[Type],i)
			break
		end
	end
	return self.AssetHistory
end

function Player:SellInventoryItem(assetId)

	local success = self:IncrementItemQuantity(assetId,-1)
	if success then
		local asset = AssetLibraryManager:GetAssetById(assetId)
		local price = asset.Price
		price = price / 2
		self:AddMoneyz(price)
		
		--if item sold was a gear item, then remove from backpack
		local name = asset.Name
		local tool = self.Object.Backpack:FindFirstChild(name) or self.Object.Character:FindFirstChild(name)
		if tool then
			tool.Parent = nil
			self:UnsaveBackpackItem(assetId)
		end
		
	end
end




function Player:IncrementItemQuantity(assetId,delta) 

	local item, index = self:GetInventoryItemById(assetId)
	if item then
		
		self.Inventory[index].Quantity = self.Inventory[index].Quantity + delta
		if self.Inventory[index].Quantity == 0 then
			table.remove(self.Inventory,index)
			workspace.Main.InventoryItemQuantityChanged:FireClient(self.Object,assetId,0)  --update inventory list
		else
			workspace.Main.InventoryItemQuantityChanged:FireClient(self.Object,assetId,self.Inventory[index].Quantity)  --update inventory list
		end
		
		
		return true
	
	elseif delta > 0 then --if item dosent dosent exist, create it unless the quantity is not being incremented positivly
	
		
		table.insert(self.Inventory,1,{AssetId = assetId, Quantity = delta})
		
		--creates new inventory item and adds data from asset library to it. category, name, ect.
		local newItemData = Players:AddAssetData(AssetLibraryManager:GetAssetById(assetId),assetId,{Quantity = delta})
		
		
		
		workspace.Main.InventoryItemAdded:FireClient(self.Object,newItemData)  --client will have to get a updated inventory list from the server

		return true
	else
		print("ITEM DOSENT EXIST")
		return false
	end
end

function Player:IncrementPayments(value)
	

	local house = self.House
	local goalAmount = Enums.UpgradePrices[Enums.NextUpgradeName[house.Upgrade]]

	--dont allow incement payments if player has a backyard
	if not goalAmount or not value then

	if self:RemoveMoneyz(value,true) then
		self.UpgradePayments = self.UpgradePayments + value
	end


	if house and self.UpgradePayments >= goalAmount then
		workspace.Main.StartUpgradeCutscene:FireClient(self.Object,house.UpgradeModel,false)
	end
end



local VideoDataStore = (game.PlaceId ~= 0 and game:GetService("DataStoreService"):GetDataStore("Videos"))
local playbackDebounce = {}
function Player:PlayVideo(videoId,videoName,videoCreator)
	
	if not playbackDebounce[self.Object] and VideoDataStore and self.House then
		
		playbackDebounce[self.Object] = true
		local houseData = self.House
		local success,videoClips  = pcall(function() return VideoDataStore:GetAsync(videoId) end)
		if success then
			
			local houseObject = houseData.Object

			local videoClipsJSON = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(videoClips)
			
			if videoClipsJSON ~= houseObject.Video.VideoClips.Value then --dont play the same video twice
			
				
				houseObject.Video.VideoCreator.Value = videoCreator
				houseObject.Video.VideoName.Value = videoName
				houseObject.Video.VideoCurrentFrame.Value = 0 
				houseObject.Video.VideoClips.Value = videoClipsJSON
	
				
				
				local function Play()
					
					houseObject.Video.VideoCurrentFrame.Value = 0
					wait(5) -- title screen
					
					for _,clip in ipairs(videoClips) do
						if houseObject.Video.VideoClips.Value == videoClipsJSON then
							houseObject.Video.VideoCurrentFrame.Value = houseObject.Video.VideoCurrentFrame.Value + 1 
							wait(tonumber(clip[2])) --wait length
						else
							return false
						end
					end
					return true
				end
				
				spawn(function()
					while Play() do wait() end --play on repeat
					houseObject.Video.VideoCurrentFrame.Value = -1
				end)
			end
		end
		
		wait(1)
		playbackDebounce[self.Object] = true
	end
end

function Recieve(player,action,...)
	print("received",action,player,...)
	local args = {...}
		
	if action == "GetAssetLibrary" then
		return AssetLibraryManager.AssetLibrary
		
	elseif action == "GetPetHatsLibrary" then
		return AssetLibraryManager:GetItemsInCategories("PetHats")
	
	elseif action == "GetFurnitureObject" then
		local object = AssetLibraryManager:GetAssetById(args[1]).Object:clone()
		object.PrimaryPart = object.Border
		object.Parent = game.ReplicatedStorage.StreamingFurnitureStorage
		object:MoveTo(Vector3.new(0,10000,0))
		Players[player].DraggingFurniture = object
		return object
		
	elseif action == "GetAssetPrice" then
		local asset = AssetLibraryManager:GetAssetById(args[1])
		if asset then
			return asset.Price
		end
	end
end

	end

function round(a,b)
	return math.floor((a/b)+0.5)*b
end 

function roundUp(a,b)
	if a - math.floor(a) < .1 then
		return round(a,b)
	end
	return math.ceil(a / b) * b
end

function Vehicles:RespawnInactiveTruck() 
	
	--have to decide which truck to respawn
	--a hight score = less likely to respawn
	
	local function PointValue(truck)
		local truckData = Vehicles[truck]
		if truckData then
			local points = #truckData:GetBoxesInTruck() -- start out at #boxes as score
						
			if math.abs(truck.LeftDoor.Position.y - truck.RightDoor.Position.y) > 5 or truck.Bumper.Position.y > truck.Roof.Position.y then --if fliped over
				points = points - 600
			end
			
						
			if truck.Driver.Occupant then --if theres a driver
				points = points + 15
				
			elseif tick() - truckData.LastSeated < 60 then --if used in last 60 seconds
				points = points + 10
				
			elseif tick() - truckData.LastSeated > 60 then
				points = points - 10
			end
						
						
			if truck.Driver:FindFirstChild("TutorialPlayerOnly") then  --truck is being used by player in tutorial
				points = points + 100
			end
				
			return points	
		else
			
			error("Truck data dosent exist" .. 
				"Truck.Driver = " .. (function() local var pcall(function() var =     truck.Driver     end) return var end)() .. ", " ..
				"Truck = " .. (function() local var pcall(function() var =     truck     end) return var end)() .. ", " ..
				"Truck.Parent = " .. (function() local var pcall(function() var =     truck.Parent     end) return var end)() 
			)
		end	
	end
	
	
	
	local lowScore = 1000 
	local lowestTruck = nil
	for _,truck in ipairs(workspace.Trucks:GetChildren()) do
		local score = PointValue(truck)
		if score < lowScore then
			lowestTruck = truck
			lowScore = score
		end
	end
	
	
	return Vehicles:Delete(lowestTruck) --Delete returns the new truck
		
	
end

				Vehicles[object] = nil

			local truck = Truck.new(truckPosition)

local function SetGroupPropertyByName(groupName,properties,self)
	local subgroupName = string.sub(groupName,1,4)
	for _,obj in ipairs(self.Object:GetChildren()) do
		for propName,value in pairs(properties) do
			if string.sub(obj.Name,1,4) == subgroupName then
				obj[propName] = value
			end
		end
	end
end

local function UpdateLights(self)
	if Enviroment.TimeOfDay == "Night" then
		self.Object.LightMain.Light.Enabled = true
		Utility:SetGroupPropertiesByName("Light",{Material = "Neon"},self.Object)
		Utility:SetGroupPropertiesByName("Topper",{Material = "Neon"},self.Object)
		self.Object.LightMain.Light.Color = self.Object.LightMain.BrickColor.Color


	else
		self.Object.LightMain.Light.Enabled = false
		Utility:SetGroupPropertiesByName("Light",{Material = "SmoothPlastic"},self.Object)
		Utility:SetGroupPropertiesByName("Topper",{Material = "SmoothPlastic"},self.Object)
	end	
end



function Car:ToggleHoodVisibility()  
	if self.HoodVisible then
		Utility:SetGroupPropertiesByName("Hood",{Transparency = 1},self.Object)

		self.HoodVisible = false
		self:ShowTopper(false)
	else
		Utility:SetGroupPropertiesByName("Hood",{Transparency = 0},self.Object)
		self.HoodVisible = true
		
		if self.IsDelivery then
			self:ShowTopper(true)
		end
	end
end

	for _,obj in ipairs(self.Object:GetChildren()) do
		if obj.Name == "Topper" then
			obj.Transparency = (visible and 0) or (not visible and 1)
			
		elseif obj.Name == "Image" then
			obj.SurfaceGui.Enabled = visible
		end
	end
	self.TopperEnabled = visible
end

function Car.new(spawnPosition,owner,carId)
	
	
	local asset = AssetLibraryManager:GetAssetById(carId)
	local this = {}
	setmetatable(this, Car)
	this.Object = (asset~=nil and asset.Object) or game.ServerStorage.Vehicles.Car
	this.Object = this.Object:clone()
	local object = this.Object

	this.IsWorkCar = (owner == nil and true) or false
	this.Owner = owner
	this.LightsOn = false
	this.IsDelivery = false
	this.TopperVisible = false
	this.HoodVisible = true
	this.SpawnPosition = spawnPosition
	this.LastSeated = tick()
	this.Deleted = false
	this.Type = "Car"
	this.OriginalMaxSpeed = object.Driver.MaxSpeed  --gamepad driving make changes to these value and need to be reset when the player jumps out of the vehicle
	this.OriginalTurnSpeed = object.Driver.TurnSpeed
	

	this.TimeOfDayChange = game.ReplicatedStorage.GlobalData.TimeOfDay.Changed:connect(function() UpdateLights(this) end)
	UpdateLights(this)
	

	
	object.Hood1.ClickDetector.Detector.Event:connect(function(player) this:ToggleHoodVisibility()  end)
	--object.Topper.ClickDetector.Detector.Event:connect(function(player) this:ToggleHoodVisibility() end)
	object.Hood2.ClickDetector.Detector.Event:connect(function(player) this:ToggleHoodVisibility() end)
	object.Hood1.Touched:connect(Utility:Debounce(function(hit) 
		if hit and hit.Parent and hit.Position.Y < 2 and not this.Deleted then
			object.Driver.BodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(4000000,0,4000000)
			wait(1)
			if not this.Deleted then
				object.Driver.BodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
			end
		end
	end))
	
	delay(1,function() if object:FindFirstChild("Driver") then object.Driver.BodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(0,0,0) end end)
	
	
	object.Parent = workspace.Cars
	object:MakeJoints()
	Utility:WeldVehicle(object)
	Utility:EnableScripts(object)
	object:MoveTo(spawnPosition + Vector3.new(0,5,0))


	
	--set colors
	if owner and Players[owner] then
		for partName,color in pairs(Players[owner].Car_Colors) do
			this:SetColor(partName,color)
		end
	end
	
	if this.IsWorkCar then
		this:ShowTopper(true)
	end
	
	local currentOccupant = nil 
	
	
	local function PlayerSat(weld,state)
		if weld.Name == "SeatWeld" and not this.Deleted then
			this.LastSeated = tick()
			
			local player = Utility:GetPlayerFromBodyPart(weld.Part1)
			if player and state == "Added" then--and state == "Added" then
				if not this.IsWorkCar and this.Owner and this.Owner ~= player then
					wait()
					Dialog:ShowMessage(player,"You are not allowed to drive " .. this.Owner.Name .. "'s car.","Ok")
					object.Driver.Disabled = true

		end
	end)
	
	
	local CAR_IDLE_TIME = 360

				wait(60)
			end
		end)
		
	else

	end
	

	return this

function Truck:GetBoxesInTruck()
	local boxes = {}
	local bottom = self.Object:FindFirstChild("Bottom")
	if bottom then
		for _,box in ipairs(workspace.AllSupplyBoxes:GetChildren()) do  -- set network ownership of all boxes inside truck
					
			local localPos = bottom.CFrame:pointToObjectSpace(box.Position)
			if box and box.Parent and not box.Anchored and math.abs(localPos.X) <= (bottom.Size.X/2)+4 and math.abs(localPos.Z) <= (bottom.Size.Z/2)+4 then
				table.insert(boxes,box)
			end
		end

	end

function Truck.new(spawnPosition,owner,carId)
	

	
	local this = {}
	setmetatable(this, Truck)
	this.Object = game.ServerStorage.Vehicles.Truck
	this.Object = this.Object:clone()
	local object = this.Object

	this.LightsOn = false
	this.SpawnPosition = spawnPosition
	this.LastSeated = tick()
	this.Deleted = false
	this.Type = "Truck"
	this.OriginalMaxSpeed = object.Driver.MaxSpeed  --gamepad driving make changes to these value and need to be reset when the player jumps out of the vehicle
	this.OriginalTurnSpeed = object.Driver.TurnSpeed

	


	this.TimeOfDayChange = game.ReplicatedStorage.GlobalData.TimeOfDay.Changed:connect(function() UpdateLights(this) end)
	UpdateLights(this)


	
	object.Parent = workspace.Trucks
	object:MakeJoints()
	Utility:WeldVehicle(object)
	Utility:EnableScripts(object)

	object:MoveTo(spawnPosition)
	
	
	
	local player = nil ---player that owns the boxes in the truck
	local owner_boxes = {} --collection of boxes the player owns
	local function PlayerSat(weld,Type)
		if weld.Name == "SeatWeld" then
			this.LastSeated = tick()

			if Type == "Added" then
				player = Utility:GetPlayerFromBodyPart(weld.Part1)
				if player then
					
					pcall(function() object.Driver:SetNetworkOwner(player) end)
					game.Workspace.Main.SittingInCar:FireClient(player,object,this.OriginalMaxSpeed,this.OriginalTurnSpeed)
					
					while player and not this.Deleted do

						for _,box in ipairs(workspace.AllSupplyBoxes:GetChildren()) do  -- set network ownership of all boxes inside truck
							
							local localPos = object.Bottom.CFrame:pointToObjectSpace(box.Position)
							if box and box.Parent and not box.Anchored and not owner_boxes[box] and math.abs(localPos.X) <= (object.Bottom.Size.X/2)+4 and math.abs(localPos.Z) <= (object.Bottom.Size.Z/2)+4 then
								box:SetNetworkOwner(player)
								owner_boxes[box] = true

							end
						end
						wait(1)
					end
				end
			elseif Type == "Removed" then
				if object.Driver.Position.Y < 2.45 and player and Players[player] and  Players[player].Settings.WaterEnabled then return end --dont give up physics to server or else the truck will fall though the water
				
				player = nil								

					
				pcall(function() object.Driver:SetNetworkOwnershipAuto() end)
				
					
				for k,v in pairs(owner_boxes) do
					if k and k.Parent and not k.Anchored then
						pcall(function() k:SetNetworkOwnershipAuto() end)
					end
				end
					
				owner_boxes = {}
				
			
			end
		end
	end
	
	this.WeldAdded = object.Driver.ChildAdded:connect(function(weld) PlayerSat(weld,"Added") end)
	this.WeldRemoved = object.Driver.ChildRemoved:connect(function(weld) PlayerSat(weld,"Removed") end)



	
	
	this.SeatDestroyed = object.ChildRemoved:connect(function(part)
		if part.Name == "Driver" then
			this.SeatDestroyed:disconnect()
			Vehicles:Delete(object)
		end
	end)
	
	
	
	local CAR_IDLE_TIME = 360
	if owner == nil then --dont auto respawn with player owned car
		
		spawn(function()
			while not this.Deleted do
				
				if object.Driver.Position.Y < 2.45 and not object.Driver.Occupant then
					Vehicles:Delete(object)
				
				elseif tick() - this.LastSeated > CAR_IDLE_TIME and not object.Driver.Occupant then
					Vehicles:Delete(object)
					
				elseif math.abs(object.LeftDoor.Position.y - object.RightDoor.Position.y) > 5 or object.Bumper.Position.y > object.Roof.Position.y then
					Vehicles:Delete(object)

				end
				
				wait(60)
			end
		end)
		
	
	end
	

	return this

end



return Truck

			if string.sub(obj.Name,1,4) == subgroupName then

--types - Open to anyone, open for owner, open for manager,backyard door

function Door:SetState(open,doorTouchCanCollide)
	
	self.IsOpen = open
	

	for _,part in ipairs(self.Object.Door_Closed:GetChildren()) do
		part.Transparency = (open and 1) or 0
		part.CanCollide = (not open and self.Type ~= "PublicDoor"  and true) or false
	end
	
	for _,part in ipairs(self.Object.Door_Open:GetChildren()) do
		part.Transparency = (open and 0) or 1
	end
	
	if doorTouchCanCollide ~= nil then
		self.Object.DoorTouch.CanCollide = doorTouchCanCollide
	end
	
	if open then 
		self.DoorOpenSound:Play()
	else
		self.DoorClosedSound:Play()
	end
end

function Door:SetDoorbellEnabled(enabled)
	self.DoorbellEnabled = enabled
end



function Door.new(object,house)
	
	local debounce = false
	local function Activate(self,player,clicked)
		
		
		
		if self.Type == "PublicDoor" and not self.IsOpen then
			
			self:SetState(true)
			wait(2)
			
			--keep the door open until no one is nearby
			while true do
				wait(.5)
				local keepOpen = false
				for _,player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
					if player:DistanceFromCharacter(object.DoorTouch.Position) < 6 then
						keepOpen = true
					end
				end
				if not keepOpen then 
					break
				end
			end
			self:SetState(false)


		elseif  self.Type == "ManagerDoor" then 
			
			if player.TeamColor == BrickColor.new("Bright green") and not Manager.CurrentManager then
				spawn(function() error("Player should be manager") end)
			end
			
			if player.TeamColor ~= BrickColor.new("Bright green") and Manager.CurrentManager == player then
				spawn(function() error("Manager does not have the right teamcolors") end)
			end
			
			if self.IsOpen and self.Object.Door_Closed.Door.Transparency == 0 then
				spawn(function() error("Door should be open but is not") end)
			end
			
			if self.Object.Door_Closed.Door.Transparency == 1 and  self.Object.DoorTouch.CanCollide == true then
				spawn(function() error("Door is open but cant go through") end)

			end
			
			
			
			
			
			if not Manager.CurrentManager or not Manager.CurrentManager.Parent or Manager.CurrentManager == player or player.TeamColor == BrickColor.new("Bright green") then
				if not self.IsOpen then
					self:SetState(true)
					wait(2)
					self:SetState(false)
				end
	
			else
				local torso = Utility:GetObjectInsideCharacter(player,"HumanoidRootPart")
				if torso then
					local objPosition = object.DoorTouch.CFrame:pointToObjectSpace(torso.Position)
					if objPosition.X < 0 and not self.IsOpen then --open door for person insdie house - close door behind visitor when the leave
						self:SetState(true)
						wait(2)
						self:SetState(false)
						
					end
				end
			end
			
			
		elseif self.Type == "BackyardDoor" then
			if clicked then
				self:SetState(not self.IsOpen) --toggle]
			else
				if not self.IsOpen then
					self:SetState(true)
				end
			end
				
			
		elseif self.Type == "FrontDoor"  then
			
			if Players[player] == nil then
				spawn(function() error("Player does not have data") end)
			
			elseif house.Object:FindFirstChild(player.Name) ~= nil and house.Owner ~= Players[player] then
				spawn(function() error("Mislabled house") end)
			end
			
			if self.IsOpen and self.Object.Door_Closed.Door.Transparency == 0 then
				spawn(function() error("HOUSE Door should be open but is not") end)
			end
			
			
			
			
			if Players[player] and house.Owner == Players[player] or Players[player].IsAdmin then
				if clicked then --only toggle if player click on door
					self:SetState(not self.IsOpen)
				elseif not self.IsOpen then
					self:SetState(true)
				end
	
			else
				local torso = Utility:GetObjectInsideCharacter(player,"HumanoidRootPart")
				if torso then
					local objPosition = object.DoorTouch.CFrame:pointToObjectSpace(torso.Position)
					if objPosition.X > 0 and not self.IsOpen then --open door for person insdie house - close door behind visitor when the leave
						self:SetState(true)
						wait(2)
						self:SetState(false)
				
					elseif not self.IsOpen and objPosition.X < 0 and not self.DoorbellDebounce and self.DoorbellEnabled then --ring doorbell
						
						self.DoorbellDebounce = true
						
						local players = self.House:GetPlayersInside()
						table.insert(players,player) --let person touching door hear too
							
						for _,player in ipairs(players) do
							SoundFX:PlaySound(player,"Doorbell")
						end
						
						delay(5,function() self.DoorbellDebounce = false end)
						
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	
	
	local this = {}
	setmetatable(this,Door)
	this.Type = object.Name
	this.DoorbellDebounce = false
	this.DoorbellEnabled = true
	this.House = house
	this.Object = object
	this.IsOpen = false
	this.DoorOpenSound = script.DoorOpen:clone()
	this.DoorClosedSound = script.DoorClosed:clone()

	local debounce = false
	this.Touched = object.DoorTouch.Touched:connect(function(hit)
		if not debounce and hit and hit.Parent and hit.Parent.Parent and (hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") or hit.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")) then
			debounce = true
			local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent) or game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent.Parent)
			if player then
				Activate(this,player,false) 
			end
			wait(.3)
			debounce = false
		end
	end)
	
	this.Clicked = nil
	if object:FindFirstChild("ClickDetector") then --only house doors have click dectectors
		this.Clicked = object.ClickDetector.Detector.Event:connect(Utility:Debounce(function(player) Activate(this,player,true) wait(.3) end))
	end
	
	this.DoorOpenSound.Parent = object.DoorTouch
	this.DoorClosedSound.Parent = object.DoorTouch

	return this
end

function Door:DisconnectEvents()
	if self.Touched then self.Touched:disconnect() end 
	if self.Clicked then self.Clicked:disconnect() end
end




print("Door loaded")


return Door

function bodyMoversEnabled(this,enabled)
	local bodyPosition = this.Object.BodyPosition
	local bodyGyro = this.Object.BodyGyro
	if enabled then
		bodyPosition.MaxForce = Vector3.new(this.Object.Size.X * 40, 500, this.Object.Size.Z * 40)
		bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(0, 400000, 0)
	else
		bodyPosition.MaxForce = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
		bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
end

function Weld(x,y)
	local W = Instance.new("Weld")
	W.Name = "PizzaWeld"
	W.Part0 = x
	W.Part1 = y
	local CJ = CFrame.new(x.Position)
	local C0 = x.CFrame:inverse()*CJ
	local C1 = y.CFrame:inverse()*CJ
	W.C0 = C0
	W.C1 = C1
	W.Parent = x
end

function petWithinRange(range,this)
	local pets = {}
	local children = workspace.Pets:GetChildren()
	for _,pet in ipairs(children) do
		if this.Object ~= pet and (this.Object.Position - pet.Position).magnitude < range then
			table.insert(pets,pet)
		end
	end
	if #pets == 0 then return nil end
	return pets[math.random(1,#pets)]
end



	local function ConvertScale(input,inputRange,outputRange)
		local inputRangeMin = inputRange[1]
		local inputRangeMax = inputRange[2]
		local outputRangeMin  = outputRange[1]
		local outputRangeMax = outputRange[2]
		local scale = (input - inputRangeMin) / (inputRangeMax - inputRangeMin)
		return ((outputRangeMax - outputRangeMin) * scale) + outputRangeMin
	end
	--1.4 .7,1.5   9,10
	

function playerWithinRange(range,this)
	local players = {}
	local children = game.Players:GetPlayers()
	for _,player in ipairs(children) do
		if player ~= this.Owner and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") and (this.Object.Position - player.Character.Head.Position).magnitude < range then
			table.insert(players,player)
		end
	end
	if #players == 0 then return nil end
	return players[math.random(1,#players)].Character.Head
end


function SitOnShoulder(self,state)
	local W = nil
	if (self.Owner.Character and self.Owner.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")) then
		
		local rand = math.random(1,3)
		while self.Owner and self.State ~= "Destroyed" and self.Owner.Character:FindFirstChild("Head"):FindFirstChild(rand) do  --if pet is already in that position then there will be a weld in the head
			rand = math.random(1,3)
			wait(.1) 
		end 
		
		if self.State == "Destroyed" then return end
		
		local randomPosition = sitPositions[rand]
		local playerHeadRadius = self.Owner.Character.Head.Size.Y/2
		local petHeadRadius = self.Object.Size.X/2
		local bodyPosition = self.Object.BodyPosition
		local bodyGyro = self.Object.BodyGyro
		
		local reserve = Instance.new("IntValue")
		reserve.Name = rand
		reserve.Parent = self.Owner.Character.Head
		self.Reserve = reserve
		
		--adjust position if sitting on head or shoulders
		local position = nil
		if rand ~= 3 then
			position = randomPosition * (petHeadRadius+playerHeadRadius+.2) - Vector3.new(0,-playerHeadRadius+petHeadRadius-(petHeadRadius/4),0)  --move to left and add .2 to give a little extra space then bring the pet down to the shoulder
		else  
			position = Vector3.new(0,-(playerHeadRadius+petHeadRadius-(petHeadRadius/4)),0)
		end


		while self.State == state and self.Owner.Character  do
			bodyPosition.position = self.Owner.Character.Head.CFrame:pointToWorldSpace(-position)
			bodyGyro.cframe = CFrame.new( self.Object.Position, self.Object.Position - ((self.Object.Position - bodyPosition.Position).unit) * 2 )
			if (bodyPosition.position - self.Object.Position).magnitude < .5 then
				bodyMoversEnabled(self,false)
				break
			end
			wait(.1)
		end
		if self.State == "Destroyed" then return end
		
		
		--self.Object.Size = self.Object.Size - Vector3.new(0,self.Object.Size.Y/4,0) -- squish the pet
		
		
		if self.Owner.Character and self.Owner.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
			W = Instance.new("Weld")
			W.Name = rand
			W.Part0 = self.Owner.Character.Head
			W.Part1 = self.Object
			W.C1 = CFrame.new(position)
			W.Parent = self.Owner.Character.Head
			
			self.HeadWeld = W
		end
		
		
	end
end




local hatRotation = {
	["Dog"] = CFrame.Angles(0,math.pi,0),
	["Bull"] = CFrame.Angles(0,math.pi,0),
}


function WeldToMouth(pet,object,rotation)
	local size = pet.Size.Y
	local angle = 335
	local X = math.cos(math.rad(angle))
	local Y = math.sin(math.rad(angle))
	local unitY = Y *(size/2)
	local unitX = X *(size/2)	
	
	local W = Instance.new("Weld")
	W.Name = object.Name .. "Weld"
	W.Part0 = pet
	W.Part1 = object
	W.C0 = CFrame.new(0,unitY,-unitX) 
											--W.C1 = CFrame.new(pet.CFrame:pointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0,-unitY,unitX ))) --* hatRotation[type]
	if rotation then
		W.C0 = W.C0 * rotation
	end
	W.Parent = pet
	
end

function AttachHat(this,animalType,customHatName)
	
	if animalType and this.Object:FindFirstChild("Hat") then this.Object.Hat:Destroy() end
	if customHatName and this.Object:FindFirstChild("CustomHat") then this.Object.CustomHat:Destroy() end
	
	if not animalType and not customHatName then return end --if there isnt a custom hat
	
	local hat = Instance.new("Part")
	hat.Name = (animalType and "Hat") or "CustomHat"
	hat.FormFactor = "Custom"
	hat.Size = Vector3.new(.2,.2,.2)
	hat.Parent = this.Object
	hat.BrickColor = BrickColor.new(this.SecondaryColor)
	hat.CanCollide = false
	hat.Locked = true
	if customHatName then --custom phsical properties didnt exits before, now I can make new hats weightless
		hat.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0,.4,.25) 
	end
	--hat:SetNetworkOwner(this.Owner)
	--hat.Parent:SetNetworkOwner(this.Owner)
	
	this.Hat = hat
	
	local rotation = nil
	if animalType and hatRotation[animalType] then
		rotation = hatRotation[animalType]
	end
		
	--scale hat mesh
	local defaultSize = 1.5 --all pet parts fit on a 1.5,1.5,1.5 sized pet
	local newSize = this.Object.Size.Y/defaultSize
	if animalType ~= "Default" or customHatName then
		local mesh = (animalType and game.ServerStorage.PetObjects.PetParts[animalType]:clone()) or AssetLibraryManager:GetAssetByName(customHatName).Object:clone()
		mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(mesh.Scale.X*newSize,mesh.Scale.Y*newSize,mesh.Scale.Z*newSize)
		mesh.Offset = Vector3.new(mesh.Offset .X*newSize,mesh.Offset .Y*newSize,mesh.Offset .Z*newSize)
		mesh.Parent = hat
	else
		hat.Transparency = 1
	end
	
	WeldToMouth(this.Object,hat,rotation)
	
	return hat
end


function Joy(self,meter,max_meter)
	
	if self.State == "Destroyed" then return end
	
	if meter and meter >= max_meter then return end   --don't joy if meter is already full
	
	local Eyes = self.Object.Eyes
	local Mouth = self.Object.Mouth
	Eyes.Texture = eyes["Happy"]
	Mouth.Texture = mouth["Open"]
	self.EmotionState = "Joy"
	local heart = game.ServerStorage.PetObjects.PetParticles.HeartParticles:clone()
	heart.Parent = self.Object
	self.Object.Joy:Play()
	
	delay(math.random(300,500)/100,function()
		if self.State == "Destroyed" then return end
		
		if self.State ~= "Sleeping" then
			Eyes.Texture = eyes["Normal"]
			Mouth.Texture = mouth["Smile"]
		end
		
		self.EmotionState = "Normal"
		heart.Enabled = false
		wait(2)
		if self.State == "Destroyed" then return end
		heart:Destroy()
	end)
	
end

function Pet:TeleportToOwner()
	if self.Owner and self.Owner.Character and self.Owner.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		local position = self.Owner.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
		self.Object.Position = position
		self.Object.BodyPosition.position = position
		if self.Hat then self.Hat:Destroy() end
		self.Hat = AttachHat(self,self.Type)
		self.CustomHat = AttachHat(self,nil,self.CustomHatName)
	end
end



function Pet:SetActive(active)
	if self.State == "Destroyed" then return end
	if not active then 
		self.Active = false
		self.Object.Parent = game.ReplicatedStorage
		self.State = "Deactivated"
	else
		if self.Object == nil then
			self:SpawnPet()
			workspace.PetService.PetObjectChanged:FireClient(self.Owner,self.Object)
			--spawn(function() self:StartAI() end)
		else
			
			self.Active = true
			self.Object.Parent = workspace.Pets
			self:TeleportToOwner()
			self.State = "Follow"
			
		end

	end
	return active
end

function Pet:StartPetting()
	
	if self.State == "Sleeping" or self.State == "Petting" or self.PetLevel >= self.Properties.PetMax then 

		workspace.PetService.Petting:FireClient(self.Owner,"Cancel",self.Name,nil)
		return
	end
	

	self.State = "Petting"
	self.SoundPlayed = false
end

function Pet:CancelPetting()
	if self.State == "Petting" then
		self.State = "Follow"
		
		workspace.PetService.Petting:FireClient(self.Owner,"Cancel",self.Name,nil)
	end
end

function Pet:Petting(duration)
	if self.State ~= "Petting" then return end
	if not self.LastDuration then
		self.LastDuration = 0
	end
	
	
	local Eyes = self.Object.Eyes
	local Mouth = self.Object.Mouth
	if duration == 0 then
		Eyes.Texture = eyes["Normal"]
		Mouth.Texture = mouth["Open"]
	elseif duration < 50 then
		
		Eyes.Texture = eyes["Sleep"]
		Mouth.Texture = mouth["Open"]
		if not self.SoundPlayed then
			self.SoundPlayed = true
			self.Object.Satisfied:Play()
		end
	elseif duration < 200 then
		
		Eyes.Texture = eyes["Sleep"]
		Mouth.Texture = mouth["Open"]
		
	else
		Eyes.Texture = eyes["Sleep"]
		Mouth.Texture = mouth["Sleep"]
	end
	
	if self.LastDuration > duration then  --if duration resets
		self.LastDuration  = 0
	end
	
	if math.abs(self.LastDuration - duration) > 100 then  --increment meter every 100 duration
		
		self.LastDuration = duration --debounce
		
		if self.PetLevel < self.Properties.PetMax then
			self.PetLevel = self.PetLevel + 1
			workspace.PetService.MeterChanged:FireClient(self.Owner,self.Name,"PetMeter",self.PetLevel)
			
		end
		
		if self.PetLevel >= self.Properties.PetMax then
			self.LastDuration = 0
			Eyes.Texture = eyes["Normal"]
			Mouth.Texture = mouth["Open"]
			self.Object.Joy:Play()
			self.State = "Staying" --debounce
			wait(1)
			if self.State == "Destroyed" then return end
			Mouth.Texture = mouth["Smile"]
			self.State = "Follow"
			workspace.PetService.Petting:FireClient(self.Owner,"Cancel",self.Name,nil)
			

		end
	end
end

	self.Object.Eat.Pitch = ConvertScale(object.Size.Y,{.7,1.5},{1.5,.8})

	self.Active = true
	
	if self.Type == "Cat" then -- add cat nose
		game.ServerStorage.PetObjects.Nose:clone().Parent = object
	end
	
	for _,obj in ipairs(object:GetChildren()) do
		if obj:IsA("Sound") then
			obj.MaxDistance = 70
		end
	end
	
end

function Pet:StartAI()
	
	

--Decrease Meters--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	spawn(function()
		
		while self.State == "Customize" do
			wait(.1)
		end
	
		local Counters = {}
	
		while true do
			
			if self.State == "Destroyed" then break end
			
			if self.Active and self.State ~= "Sleeping" then
				for _,name in ipairs({"Feed","Sleep","Pet","Play"}) do
		
					if Counters[name.."Counter"] == nil then

		end

	end
end
