function SetProperties(Table)
	local Object = Table.Object
	local Properties = Table.Properties
	if not Object or not Properties then
		return
	end
	for i, v in pairs(Properties) do
		pcall(function()
			Object[i] = v
		end)
	end
	return Object
end

function RegenerateLimb(Character, Limb)
	
	local OriginalTorsoCFrame = nil
	local Torso = Character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
	if Torso then
		OriginalTorsoCFrame = Torso.CFrame
	end
	
	local LimbName = Limb
	local Limb = Limbs[Limb]	
	
	if not Limb then
		return
	end
	
	local Joint = Joints[Limb.Joint]
	if not Joint then
		return
	end
		
		
	local Part = BasePart:Clone()		
	local Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	if Humanoid then
		if Humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
			if LimbName == "Head" then
				Limb.Joint = "R15Neck"
				Joint = Joints[Limb.Joint]
			end
			
			Part = MeshPart:Clone()
		elseif Humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
			if LimbName == "Head" then
				Limb.Joint = "Neck"
				Joint = Joints[Limb.Joint]
			end
		end
	end		

	
	Part.Name = LimbName
	
	--Copy default properties over to new limb
	for i, v in pairs(Limb.Properties) do
		pcall(function()
			Part[i] = v
		end)
	end
	
	local Part0 = ((LimbName == Joint.Part0 and Part) or Character:FindFirstChild(Joint.Part0))
	local Part1 = ((LimbName == Joint.Part1 and Part) or Character:FindFirstChild(Joint.Part1))
	local JointParent = ((Joint.Parent == Part.Name and Part) or Character:FindFirstChild(Joint.Parent))
	if not Part0 or not Part1 or not JointParent then
		return
	end
	
	local JointsSaved = {}
	local ObjectsSaved = {}
	local ConnectedLimbs = {}
	local LimbObject = Character:FindFirstChild(LimbName)
	if LimbObject then
		for i, v in pairs(LimbObject:GetConnectedParts()) do
			local PartLimb = Limbs[v.Name]
			if PartLimb then
				local PartJoint = Joints[PartLimb.Joint]
				if PartJoint and PartJoint ~= Joint then
					local JointInstance = {
						ClassName = "Motor6D",
						Properties = {
							Name = PartLimb.Joint,
							Part0 = ((PartJoint.Part0 == LimbObject.Name and Part) or v),
							Part1 = ((PartJoint.Part1 == LimbObject.Name and Part) or v),
							C0 = PartJoint.C0,
							C1 = PartJoint.C1,
							Parent = ((PartJoint.Parent == Part.Name and Part) or (Character:FindFirstChild(PartJoint.Parent) and Character:FindFirstChild(PartJoint.Parent))),
							MaxVelocity = PartJoint.MaxVelocity,
							CurrentAngle = PartJoint.CurrentAngle,
							DesiredAngle = PartJoint.DesiredAngle,
						}
					}
					if JointInstance.Properties.Part0 ~= JointInstance.Properties.Part1 then
						table.insert(JointsSaved, JointInstance)
					end
					table.insert(ConnectedLimbs, v)
				end
			end
		end
		for i, v in pairs(LimbObject:GetChildren()) do
			if not v:IsA("BasePart") and not v:IsA("JointInstance") then
				table.insert(ObjectsSaved, v:Clone())
			end
		end
	end
	
	for i, v in pairs(Character:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("BasePart") and v.Name == LimbName then
			v:Destroy()
		end
	end
	
	for i, v in pairs(JointsSaved) do
		local JointInstance = SetProperties({Object = Instance.new(v.ClassName), Properties = v.Properties})
	end
	
	if #ObjectsSaved > 0 then
		for i, v in pairs(ObjectsSaved) do
			v.Parent = Part
		end
	elseif Limb.DefaultInstances then --Copy original appearance back to new limbs
		for i, v in pairs(Limb.DefaultInstances) do
			pcall(function()
				local Object = SetProperties({Object = Instance.new(v.ClassName), Properties = v.Properties})
				Object.Parent = Part
			end)
		end
	end
	
	local NewJoint = Create("Motor6D"){
		Name = Limb.Joint,
		Part0 = Part0,
		Part1 = Part1,
		C0 = Joint.C0,
		C1 = Joint.C1,
		Parent = JointParent,
	}

	Part.Parent = Character
	
	local Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	if Humanoid then
		if LimbName == "Head" then
			Character.PrimaryPart = Part
		end
		if LimbName == "Head" or LimbName == "Torso" or LimbName == "UpperTorso" or LimbName == "HumanoidRootPart" then
			local Animate = Character:FindFirstChild("Animate") --Fix animation
			local NewHumanoid = Humanoid:Clone()
			Humanoid:Destroy()
			NewHumanoid.Parent = Character
			if Animate then
				spawn(function()
					Animate.Disabled = true
					wait()
					Animate.Disabled = false
				end)
			end
		end
		
		for i, v in pairs(Character:GetChildren()) do --Keep hats and tools on character
			if v:IsA("Accessory") or v:IsA("Hat") then
				v.Parent = nil
				v.Parent = Character
			elseif v:IsA("Tool") then
				Humanoid:EquipTool(v)
			end
		end
	end
	
	local BodyColors = Character:FindFirstChild("Body Colors") --Fix coloring
	if BodyColors then
		local PartColor = (string.gsub(LimbName, " ", "") .. "Color")
		pcall(function()
			Part.BrickColor = BodyColors[PartColor]
		end)
	end
	
	local Torso = Character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
	if Torso and OriginalTorsoCFrame then
		Torso.CFrame = OriginalTorsoCFrame
	end
		
end

function ScaleCharacter(Character, Scale, Permissions)
	local Permissions = (Permissions or {})
	if not Character --[[or not Character.Parent]] then
		return
	end	
	local Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	--[[if not Humanoid then
		return
	end]]
	if Humanoid and Humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
		Humanoid.HipHeight = Humanoid.HipHeight * Scale
	end	
	
	local Player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Character)
	if not Player and not Permissions.ResizeModels then
		return
	end
	
	local Parts = {}
	local Joints = {}
	local Meshes = {}
	
	local Hats = {}
	local Tools = {}
	
	local ToolsResized = {}
	local HatsResized = {}
	
	local Connections = {}
	
	local function ScaleObjects(BaseParent, BaseScale)
		local Parts = {}
		local Joints = {}
		local Meshes = {}
		local Hats = {}
		local Tools = {}
		
		local function GetScaleObjects(Parent)
			local Objects = Parent:GetChildren()
			if Parent == BaseParent then
				table.insert(Objects, BaseParent)
			end
			for i, v in pairs(Objects) do
				if v:IsA("JointInstance") then
					table.insert(Joints, {
						Joint = v:Clone(),
						Part0 = v.Part0,
						Part1 = v.Part1,
						Parent = v.Parent
					})
				elseif v:IsA("BasePart") then
					table.insert(Parts, v)
				elseif v:IsA("Accessory") or obj:IsA("Hat") then
					table.insert(Hats, v)
	--				v.Parent = nil
				elseif v:IsA("Tool") then
					table.insert(Tools, v)
--					v.Parent = nil --Causes execution scripts again, which is bad.
				elseif v:IsA("DataModelMesh") then
					table.insert(Meshes, v)
				end
				if v ~= BaseParent then
					GetScaleObjects(v)
				end
			end
		end
		
		GetScaleObjects(BaseParent)
		
		for i, v in pairs(Meshes) do
			if v:IsA("FileMesh") then
				if v:IsA("SpecialMesh") and v.MeshType == Enum.MeshType.Head then
					v.Scale = (Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * 1.25)
				else
					v.Scale = (v.Scale * BaseScale)
				end
			end
		end
		
		for i, v in pairs(Parts) do
			pcall(function()
				v.FormFactor = Enum.FormFactor.Custom
			end)
			v.Size = (v.Size * BaseScale)
		end
		
		for i, v in pairs(Hats) do
			local PX, PY, PZ, R00, R01, R02, R10, R11, R12, R20, R21, R22 = v.AttachmentPoint:components()
			v.AttachmentPoint = CFrame.new((PX * BaseScale), (PY * BaseScale), (PZ * BaseScale), R00, R01, R02, R10, R11, R12, R20, R21, R22)
			v.AttachmentPoint = (v.AttachmentPoint + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) * -(0.5 * (BaseScale - 1)))
			--v.Parent = Character
		end
		
		for i, v in pairs(Tools) do
			local PX, PY, PZ, R00, R01, R02, R10, R11, R12, R20, R21, R22 = v.Grip:components()
			v.Grip = CFrame.new((PX * BaseScale), (PY * BaseScale), (PZ * BaseScale), R00, R01, R02, R10, R11, R12, R20, R21, R22)
			v.Grip = (v.Grip + v.Grip.lookVector * -(BaseScale - 1))
			if Humanoid then
				--Humanoid:EquipTool(v)
			end
		end
		
		for i, v in pairs(Joints) do
			local C0PX, C0PY, C0PZ, C0R00, C0R01, C0R02, C0R10, C0R11, C0R12, C0R20, C0R21, C0R22 = v.Joint.C0:components()
			local C1PX, C1PY, C1PZ, C1R00, C1R01, C1R02, C1R10, C1R11, C1R12, C1R20, C1R21, C1R22 = v.Joint.C1:components()
			local NewJoint = SetProperties({Object = v.Joint:Clone(), Properties = {
				Part0 = v.Part0,
				Part1 = v.Part1,
				C0 = CFrame.new((C0PX * BaseScale), (C0PY * BaseScale), (C0PZ * BaseScale), C0R00, C0R01, C0R02, C0R10, C0R11, C0R12, C0R20, C0R21, C0R22),
				C1 = CFrame.new((C1PX * BaseScale), (C1PY * BaseScale), (C1PZ * BaseScale), C1R00, C1R01, C1R02, C1R10, C1R11, C1R12, C1R20, C1R21, C1R22),
				Parent = v.Parent,
			}})
			for ii, vv in pairs(v.Parent:GetChildren()) do
				if vv:IsA("JointInstance") and vv.Part0 == v.Part0 and vv.Part1 == v.Part1 and vv ~= NewJoint then
					vv:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end
		
		return {
			Tools = Tools,
			Hats = Hats
		}
	end
	
	local Objects = ScaleObjects(Character, Scale)
	
	for i, v in pairs(Objects.Tools) do
		table.insert(ToolsResized, {Object = v, Connections = {}})
	end
	for i, v in pairs(Objects.Hats) do
		table.insert(HatsResized, {Object = v, Connections = {}})
	end
	
	if Permissions.ScaleTools then
		Connections.ToolAdded = Character.ChildAdded:connect(function(Child)
			if Child:IsA("Tool") then
				local TableInstance = nil
				for i, v in pairs(ToolsResized) do
					if v and v.Object and v.Object == Child then
						TableInstance = v
					end
				end
				if not TableInstance then
					table.insert(ToolsResized, {Object = Child, Connections = {}})
					ScaleObjects(Child, Scale)
				end
			end
		end)
		Connections.ToolRemoved = Character.ChildRemoved:connect(function(Child)
			if Child:IsA("Tool") then
				local TableInstance = nil
				for i, v in pairs(ToolsResized) do
					if v and v.Object and v.Object == Child then
						TableInstance = v
					end
				end
				if not TableInstance then
					return
				end
				for i, v in pairs(ToolsResized) do
					if v.Object == Child then
						for ii, vv in pairs(v.Connections) do
							if vv then
								vv:disconnect()
							end
						end
						table.remove(ToolsResized, i)
					end
				end
				ScaleObjects(Child, (1 / Scale))
			end
		end)
	end
	
	if Permissions.ScaleHats then
		Connections.HatAdded = Character.ChildAdded:connect(function(Child)
			if Child:IsA("Accessory") then
				local TableInstance = nil
				for i, v in pairs(HatsResized) do
					if v and v.Object and v.Object == Child then
						TableInstance = v
					end
				end
				if not TableInstance then
					table.insert(HatsResized, {Object = Child, Connections = {}})
					ScaleObjects(Child, Scale)
				end
			end
		end)
		Connections.HatRemoved = Character.ChildRemoved:connect(function(Child)
			if Child:IsA("Accessory") then
				local TableInstance = nil
				for i, v in pairs(HatsResized) do
					if v and v.Object and v.Object == Child then
						TableInstance = v
					end
				end
				if not TableInstance then
					return
				end
				for i, v in pairs(HatsResized) do
					if v.Object == Child then
						for ii, vv in pairs(v.Connections) do
							if vv then
								vv:disconnect()
							end
						end
						table.remove(HatsResized, i)
					end
				end
				ScaleObjects(Child, (1 / Scale))
			end
		end)
	end
	
	local Head = Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	local Torso = Character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
	
	local StateChanged = Create("BoolValue"){
		Value = true,
	}
	delay(0.1, function()
		StateChanged.Value = false
	end)
	
	if Head and Torso then
		if Humanoid then
			Humanoid.WalkSpeed = (16 * Scale)
			Humanoid.CameraOffset = Vector3.new(0, (Head.Position.Y - Torso.Position.Y - 0.75), 0)
		end
		if not Permissions.MaintainCFrame then
			Torso.CFrame = Torso.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, Torso.Size.Y, 0)
		end
	end
	
	local ScaleBack = Permissions.ScaleBack
	if ScaleBack and type(ScaleBack) == "table" and tonumber(ScaleBack.Delay) then
		delay(ScaleBack.Delay, function()
			for i, v in pairs(Connections) do
				if v then
					v:disconnect()
				end
			end
			for i, v in pairs({ToolsResized, HatsResized}) do
				for ii, vv in pairs(v) do
					for iii, vvv in pairs(vv.Connections) do
						if vvv then
							vvv:disconnect()
						end
					end
				end
			end
			local PresetPermissions = {
				ScaleBack = false,
				ScaleHats = false,
				ScaleTools = false
			}
			if Character --[[and Character.Parent]] then
				for i, v in pairs(PresetPermissions) do
					Permissions[i] = v
				end
				ScaleCharacter(Character, (1 / Scale), Permissions)
			end
			StateChanged.Value = true
		end)
	end
	
	return {
		Connections = Connections,
		StateChanged = StateChanged
	}
	
end

return {
	RegenerateLimb = RegenerateLimb,
	ScaleCharacter = ScaleCharacter,
}

local DEFAULT_TWEEN_DURATION = .3
local DEFAULT_BLUR_SIZE = 20
local DEFAULT_TWEEN_STYLE = Enum.EasingStyle.Sine






function Window.new(guiManager,window,...)
	
	local args = {...}
	local easeInDirection,easeOutDirection,duration,easingStyle,blurEffect = args[1],args[2],args[3],args[4],args[5]
	
	local this = {}

	
	setmetatable(this, Window)
	this.Object = window
	this.Type = "Window"
	this.GuiManager = guiManager
	this.OriginalPosition = window.Position
	this.TweenDuration = duration or DEFAULT_TWEEN_DURATION
	this.TweenEasingStyle = easingStyle or DEFAULT_TWEEN_STYLE
	this.BlurEffectEnabled = blurEffect or false
	this.IgnoreBlurTween = false --if a new window is tweening and in and current one is tweening out, dont tween BlurEffect
	this.EaseInDirection = easeInDirection
	this.EaseOutDirection = easeOutDirection
	this.Disabled = false --another window is controlling the visiblity of this window, only that window can change the visiblity
	this.WindowsOverriding = {} --list of all the windows this window is controlling
	this.IsCoreGuiWindow = window == GamepadMoneyz or window == Backpack or window == PlayerList or window == ChatWindow or window == ChatMenu or window == Menu --dont allow these windows to controll ther windows when their visiblity changes
	this.TouchControls = {}
	this.GamepadActions = {}
	this.ButtonPopSoundConnections = {}
	this.LastSelection = nil  --reselect that item that was last selected before the window closed
	this.FirstSelectedObject = nil --first object to be selected when window first opens
	this.IsGamepadNavigateable = true --dialog, gamepad radial menu dont need guinaviation
	this.CanBeFocused = true --for notifications that dissapear automatically
	this.IsInteractableCoreGui = false --backpack, chatwindow
	this:UpdateTweenEndPoints()
	this.CanBeCanceled = true
	this.CancelButton = nil

	window.Visible = false
	

	
	--make window close with cancel button is pressed 
	if window:FindFirstChild("CancelButton") and not Enums.GamepadEnabled then
		this.CancelButton = window.CancelButton
		this.CancelButton.MouseButton1Click:connect(function()
			UIEvents.WindowManuallyClosed:Fire(window)
			this:SetVisible(false)
		end)
	--hide cancel button if gamepad enabled and show gamepad controll hints at the bottom of the window
	elseif Enums.GamepadEnabled and (window:FindFirstChild("CancelButton") or window.Name == "Settings" or window.Name == "PetPanel" or window.Name == "Emotions") then
		
		if window:FindFirstChild("CancelButton") then
			window.CancelButton.Visible = false
		end
		
		this:RegisterGamepadAction(Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB,function(action,state,inputObject)
			if state == Enum.UserInputState.Begin and this.CanBeCanceled then
				UIEvents.WindowManuallyClosed:Fire(window)
				this:SetVisible(false)
			end
		end)
		
		--show cancel b button hint at the bottom of all the windows
		if window.Name ~= "DialogBox" then
			local hint = script.CancelGamepadHint:clone()
			hint.Parent = window
			if hint.AbsolutePosition.Y + hint.AbsoluteSize.Y > MainGui.AbsoluteSize.Y then
				hint.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1,1)
				hint.Position = UDim2.new(1,0,0, -5)
			end
		end
		
	end
	
	--this:SetVisible(false)
	
	return this

end

function Window:CancelingEnabled(enabled)
	if Enums.GamepadEnabled then
		self.CanBeCanceled = enabled
		self.Object.CancelGamepadHint.Visible = enabled
	else
		self.CancelButton.Visible = enabled
	end

function Window:UpdateTweenEndPoints()
	
	self.OriginalPosition = self.Object.Position
	
	local easeInDirection = self.EaseInDirection 
	local anchorX = self.Object.AnchorPoint.X
	local anchorY = self.Object.AnchorPoint.Y

	if easeInDirection then					
		self.EaseInStartPosition = UDim2.new(
											--XScale
											(easeInDirection == "Left" or easeInDirection == "Right" and 0)   or   self.Object.Position.X.Scale ,
											--XOffset
											 (easeInDirection == "Left" and -(1-anchorX)*self.Object.AbsoluteSize.X)   or   (easeInDirection == "Right" and MainGui.AbsoluteSize.X + anchorX*self.Object.AbsoluteSize.X)   or   self.Object.Position.X.Offset ,
											--YScale
											 (easeInDirection == "Top" or easeInDirection == "Bottom" and 0)   or   self.Object.Position.Y.Scale ,
											--YOffset
											 (easeInDirection == "Top" and -(1-anchorX)*self.Object.AbsoluteSize.Y)   or   (easeInDirection == "Bottom" and MainGui.AbsoluteSize.Y + anchorX*self.Object.AbsoluteSize.Y)   or   self.Object.Position.Y.Offset
											)
	end
	
	local easeOutDirection = self.EaseOutDirection 
	if easeOutDirection then
		self.EaseOutEndPosition =  UDim2.new(
											--XScale
											(easeOutDirection == "Left" or easeOutDirection == "Right" and 0)   or   self.Object.Position.X.Scale ,
											--XOffset
											 (easeOutDirection == "Left" and -(1-anchorX)*self.Object.AbsoluteSize.X)   or   (easeOutDirection == "Right" and MainGui.AbsoluteSize.X + anchorX*self.Object.AbsoluteSize.X)   or   self.Object.Position.X.Offset ,
											--YScale
											 (easeOutDirection == "Top" or easeOutDirection == "Bottom" and 0)   or   self.Object.Position.Y.Scale ,
											--YOffset
											 (easeOutDirection == "Top" and -(1-anchorX)*self.Object.AbsoluteSize.Y)   or   (easeOutDirection == "Bottom" and MainGui.AbsoluteSize.Y + anchorX*self.Object.AbsoluteSize.Y)   or   self.Object.Position.Y.Offset
											)
	end
end

	self.GamepadActions[GamepadButton] = action
end

	for gamepadButton, action in pairs(self.GamepadActions) do

function HideOverlappingTouchControls(self,phantom)
	
	spawn(function()
		--let last window make the controls visible first
		wait()
		if game:GetService("UserInputService").TouchEnabled then
			local touchGui = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("TouchGui")
			if touchGui then
				local touchFrame = touchGui:FindFirstChild("TouchControlFrame")
				if touchFrame then
					for _,control in ipairs(touchFrame:GetChildren()) do
						if control.Visible and Utility:GuiIsOverlapping(phantom,control) then
							control.Visible = false
							table.insert(self.TouchControls,control)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end


function Window:GamepadCaptureFocus()

	local windowStack = self.GuiManager.WindowFocusStack
	
	--disable camera, walking, and jumping because some windows may have nothing to select with guinavigation
	if #windowStack == 0 then
		UIS.MouseIconEnabled = false
		GuiService.GuiNavigationEnabled = true
		CAS:BindAction("AButtonLock", function() end, false, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA)
		CAS:BindAction("Thumbstick1Lock", function() end, false, Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick1)
		--CAS:BindAction("Thumbstick2Lock", function() end, false, Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick2)
		self.GuiManager:CoreGuiGamepadActionsEnabed(false)
		
	else
					
		windowStack[1].LastSelection = GuiService.SelectedObject --save selection of previous window
	end
		
	GuiService.SelectedObject = nil --reset selection		
				
	self:GamepadActionsEnabled(true)
	
	table.insert(windowStack,1,self)
				
		
	--if opened before, select where the player left off
	delay(self.TweenDuration,function()
		if windowStack[1] == self and self.IsGamepadNavigateable and not self.IsCoreGuiWindow then
			if self.LastSelection and self.LastSelection.Parent then
				GuiService.SelectedObject = self.LastSelection
						
			elseif self.FirstSelectedObject then
				GuiService.SelectedObject = self.FirstSelectedObject
			
							
			end
		end
	end)

end

function Window:GamepadLoseFocus()
	local windowStack = self.GuiManager.WindowFocusStack
	
	for i,windowData in ipairs(windowStack) do
		if windowData == self then
			table.remove(windowStack,i)
		end
	end
	self.LastSelection = GuiService.SelectedObject
				
	self:GamepadActionsEnabled(false)
	
	local previousWindow = windowStack[1]
	
				
	--allow player to move if all the windows have been closed
	if #windowStack == 0 then
		UIS.MouseIconEnabled = true
		GuiService.GuiNavigationEnabled = false
		CAS:UnbindAction("AButtonLock")
		CAS:UnbindAction("Thumbstick1Lock")
		CAS:UnbindAction("Thumbstick2Lock")
		GuiService.SelectedObject = nil
		self.GuiManager:CoreGuiGamepadActionsEnabed(true)
	
	elseif previousWindow.LastSelection and previousWindow.LastSelection.Parent then
		GuiService.SelectedObject = previousWindow.LastSelection
		
	elseif previousWindow.FirstSelectedObject and previousWindow.FirstSelectedObject.Parent then
		GuiService.SelectedObject = previousWindow.FirstSelectedObject
	
	else
		GuiService.SelectedObject = nil
	
	end
	
end


function Window:SetVisible(visible)
	local window = self.Object
	if not self.Disabled and window.Visible ~= visible then
		
		
		--GAMEPAD
		if _G.GamepadEnabled and not self.IsCoreGuiWindow and self.CanBeFocused then
			
			if visible then
				self:GamepadCaptureFocus()
			else
				self:GamepadLoseFocus()			
			end
		end
		
		
		
		--tween window open
		if visible and self.EaseInStartPosition then
			local currentPosition = window.AbsolutePosition
			window.Position = self.EaseInStartPosition
			window.Visible = true
			UIEvents.WindowVisibilityChanged:Fire(self.Object,true)
			
			--dont let coreguiwindows disable other windows
			if not self.IsCoreGuiWindow then
				
				--phantom appear where the window tween ends and is used to detect if overlapping windows
				local phantom = Instance.new("Frame")
				phantom.Size = self.Object.Size
				phantom.Position = self.OriginalPosition 
				phantom.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				phantom.Parent = self.Object.Parent
				phantom.AnchorPoint = self.Object.AnchorPoint
			
				
				HideOverlappingTouchControls(self,phantom)
				
				
				--sets the disabled propery of the core gui menus it overlaps and make visible = false
				for _,wind in ipairs({Backpack,PlayerList,ChatWindow,GamepadMoneyz}) do
					local windowData = self.GuiManager.Data[wind]
					if windowData.Object.Visible and windowData.Disabled == false then
						local phantom2 = Instance.new("Frame")
						phantom2.Size = windowData.Object.Size
						phantom2.Position = windowData.OriginalPosition 
						phantom2.BackgroundTransparency = 1
						phantom2.Parent = windowData.Object.Parent
						phantom2.AnchorPoint = self.Object.AnchorPoint
						if Utility:GuiIsOverlapping(phantom,phantom2) then
							windowData:SetVisible(false)
							windowData.Disabled = true
							table.insert(self.WindowsOverriding,wind)
						else
						end
						phantom2:Destroy()
					end
				end
				phantom:Destroy()
			end
			
			
			
			
			
			window:TweenPosition(self.OriginalPosition, Enum.EasingDirection.Out,self.TweenEasingStyle,self.TweenDuration,true)
			
			if self.BlurEffectEnabled then
				self.GuiManager:TouchControlsEnabled(false)
			end
			
			--tween blur if screen is not already blurred
			if self.BlurEffectEnabled and BlurEffect.Size == 0 then
				BlurEffect.Enabled = true
				Tween(BlurEffect,"Size","Number",0,DEFAULT_BLUR_SIZE,self.TweenDuration,"Linear","Out")
			end
			
			
			
		--tween window closed
		elseif not visible and self.EaseInStartPosition then
		
			for _,wind in ipairs(self.WindowsOverriding) do
				self.GuiManager.Data[wind].Disabled = false
				self.GuiManager.Data[wind]:SetVisible(true)
			end
			self.WindowsOverriding = {}
			
			for _,control in ipairs(self.TouchControls) do
				control.Visible = true
			end
			self.TouchControls = {}
			
			
			window:TweenPosition(self.EaseOutEndPosition, Enum.EasingDirection.In,self.TweenEasingStyle,self.TweenDuration,true,function()
				window.Position = self.OriginalPosition
				window.Visible = false
				UIEvents.WindowVisibilityChanged:Fire(self.Object,false)

			end)
			
			if self.BlurEffectEnabled then
				if self.IgnoreBlurTween then --dont tween blur just one time
					self.IgnoreBlurTween = false
					return
				end
				Tween(BlurEffect,"Size","Number",BlurEffect.Size,0,self.TweenDuration,"Linear","Out"):connect(function()
					
					BlurEffect.Enabled = false
				end)
				wait(self.TweenDuration)
				self.GuiManager:TouchControlsEnabled(true)
			end
			
			
			
		--dont tween window, just make visible/invisible
		else  
			
			window.Visible = visible
			
			UIEvents.WindowVisibilityChanged:Fire(self.Object,visible)
			
			if self.BlurEffectEnabled then
				BlurEffect.Size = DEFAULT_BLUR_SIZE
				BlurEffect.Enabled = visible
			end
			
		end
		
		
		--connect and disconnect the button pop sounds when visiblibt changes
		if visible then
			
			local function connecter(dir)
				if not dir:FindFirstChild("PopSoundDisabled") then
					for i,v in ipairs(dir:GetChildren()) do	
						if v:IsA("TextButton") or v:IsA("ImageButton") then
							self.ButtonPopSoundConnections[v] = v.MouseButton1Click:connect(function() SoundFX:PlaySound("Pop3") end)
						elseif v:IsA("Frame") or v:IsA("ScrollingFrame") or v:IsA("Folder") then
							connecter(v)
						end
					end
				end
			end
			connecter(self.Object)
			
			
			local function decAdded(dec)
				wait()
				if dec:IsA("TextButton") or dec:IsA("ImageButton") and not dec.Parent:FindFirstChild("PopSoundDisabled")  then
					self.ButtonPopSoundConnections[dec] = dec.MouseButton1Down:connect(function() SoundFX:PlaySound("Pop3") end)
				end
			end
			
			local function decRemoved(dec)
				wait()
				if dec:IsA("TextButton") or dec:IsA("ImageButton") and self.ButtonPopSoundConnections[dec] then
					self.ButtonPopSoundConnections[dec]:disconnect()
					self.ButtonPopSoundConnections[dec] = nil
				end
			end
			
			self.ButtonPopSoundConnections[self.Object] = self.Object.DescendantAdded:connect(decAdded)
			self.ButtonPopSoundConnections[self.Object] = self.Object.DescendantRemoving:connect(decRemoved)
		
			
		else
			for object,connection in pairs(self.ButtonPopSoundConnections) do
				connection:disconnect()
			end
			self.ButtonPopSoundConnections = {}
		end

		
	end
	
	
end

		if tab:IsA("TextButton") or tab:IsA("ImageButton") then
			table.insert(this.Tabs,Tab.new(tab,this))
		end
	end
	
	--sort by position
	table.sort(this.Tabs,function(a,b)
		return a.Object.AbsolutePosition.X < b.Object.AbsolutePosition.X
	end)
	
	
	
	this.Tabs[1]:SetPressed(true)
	
	if _G.GamepadEnabled then
		
		tabs.Right.Visible = true
		tabs.Left.Visible = true
		
		local selectionIndex = 1
		local function BumperPressed(direction)
			
			local nextIndex = selectionIndex+direction
		
			if this.Tabs[nextIndex] then
				this.Tabs[nextIndex]:SetPressed(true)
				selectionIndex = nextIndex
	
			elseif nextIndex <= 0 then
				this.Tabs[#this.Tabs]:SetPressed(true)
				selectionIndex = #this.Tabs
				
			elseif nextIndex > #this.Tabs then
				this.Tabs[1]:SetPressed(true)
				selectionIndex = 1
			end
		end
		
		windowData:RegisterGamepadAction(Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1, function(action,state,inputObject)
			if state == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
				BumperPressed(-1)	
			end
		end)
		
		windowData:RegisterGamepadAction(Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR1, function(action,state,inputObject)
			if state == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
				BumperPressed(1)	
			end
		end)

	end

	
	return this

end

function ListView:UpdateData(dataList,template,displayFunction)

	if not dataList then dataList = {} end
	self.Template = template
	self.Data = dataList
	self.NumListItems = #dataList
	
	template.Visible = false
	
	--save button names in order from left to right depending on layout order
	local internalButtons = {}
	for _,child in ipairs(template:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("GuiButton") and child.Visible then
			table.insert(internalButtons,child.LayoutOrder,child.Name)
		end
	end
	
	
	if self.UILayout:IsA("UIGridLayout") then
		self.UILayout.CellSize = UDim2.new(0,template.AbsoluteSize.X,0,template.AbsoluteSize.Y)
		self.NumColumbs = math.floor((self.Object.AbsoluteSize.X + self.UILayout.CellPadding.X.Offset) / (self.UILayout.CellSize.X.Offset + self.UILayout.CellPadding.X.Offset))	
	else
		self.NumColumbs = 1
	end
	
	self.NumRows = math.ceil(#dataList / self.NumColumbs)
	

	
 	--update item data with new data
	local lastIndex = 0
	
	
	
	for i,data in ipairs(dataList) do
		
		if not self.RecycleRows and self.ListItems[i] then --delete all old listitems if not recycling
			self.ListItems[i]:Delete()
			self.ListItems[i] = nil
		end 
		
		local item = (self.RecycleRows and self.ListItems[i]) or ListItem.new(self,self.WindowData)
		item:SetTemplate(template)
		item:UpdateDisplay(data,i,displayFunction) --update the buttons display with new info and image
		item.Object.LayoutOrder = i
		
		
		self.ListItems[i] = item

	
		local previousItem = self.ListItems[i-1]
		
		
		if #internalButtons == 0 then  --can be frame (like ratings list) or guibutton

			--left and right selections for grid layout
			if previousItem and self.UILayout:IsA("UIGridLayout") then
				previousItem.Object.NextSelectionRight = item.Object
				item.Object.NextSelectionLeft = previousItem.Object
			end
		
		--up and down selections
			if i-self.NumColumbs > 0 then
				item.Object.NextSelectionUp = self.ListItems[i-self.NumColumbs].Object
				
				self.ListItems[i-self.NumColumbs].Object.NextSelectionDown = item.Object
			else
				item.Object.NextSelectionUp = nil
			end
		
		
		
		else  --navigate internal buttons -- only works with UIlistlayout

			local previousButton
			--goes through each button starting from the left
			for _,buttonName in ipairs(internalButtons) do
				
				local currentButton = item.Object[buttonName]
				
				if i-self.NumColumbs > 0 then
					currentButton.NextSelectionUp = self.ListItems[i-self.NumColumbs].Object[buttonName]
						
					self.ListItems[i-self.NumColumbs].Object[buttonName].NextSelectionDown = currentButton
				else
					currentButton.NextSelectionUp = nil
				end
				
					
				if previousButton then
					currentButton.NextSelectionLeft = previousButton
					previousButton.NextSelectionRight = currentButton
				end
				
					
				previousButton = item.Object[buttonName]
					
			end
			
		end
		
		item.Object.NextSelectionDown = nil
		item.Object.NextSelectionRight = nil
		
		lastIndex = i
	end	
	
	lastIndex = lastIndex + 1
	
	--delete unused list items
	for i=lastIndex,#self.ListItems do
		if self.ListItems[i] and self.ListItems[i].Object then
			self.ListItems[i]:Delete()
			self.ListItems[i] = nil
		end
	end
	
	
	

	
	
	
	
	
	--start selection back at the top when list is refreshed 
	if _G.GamepadEnabled and self.GamepadSelectFirstItemOnRefresh and #dataList > 0 then
		if #internalButtons == 0 then
			game:GetService("GuiService").SelectedObject = self.ListItems[1].Object
		else
			game:GetService("GuiService").SelectedObject = self.ListItems[1].Object[internalButtons[1]] --select button farthest to the left
		end
	end
	


	--external header to footer scrolling frame resize
	local headerSizeY = (self.Header and self.Header.AbsoluteSize.Y) or (self.ScrollingFrame.AbsolutePosition.Y - self.WindowData.Object.AbsolutePosition.Y)
	local footerSizeY = (self.Footer and self.Footer.AbsoluteSize.Y) or 0
	if self.AutoResize then
		self.ScrollingFrame.Size = UDim2.new(
			self.ScrollingFrame.Size.X.Scale,
			self.ScrollingFrame.Size.X.Offset,
			1,
			- (headerSizeY + footerSizeY)
		)
	end
	
	
	--internal header to footer canvas resize
	local internalHeaderSizeY = (self.InternalHeader and self.InternalHeader.AbsoluteSize.Y) or self.ListOffset
	local internalFooterSizeY = (self.InternalFooter and self.InternalFooter.AbsoluteSize.Y) or 0

	if self.UILayout:IsA("UIGridLayout") then
		self.ScrollingFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,0,(self.NumRows * (self.UILayout.CellSize.Y.Offset + self.UILayout.CellPadding.Y.Offset)) + (internalHeaderSizeY + internalFooterSizeY))
	
	elseif self.UILayout:IsA("UIListLayout") then
		self.ScrollingFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,0,(self.NumRows * (template.AbsoluteSize.Y + self.UILayout.Padding.Offset)) + (internalHeaderSizeY + internalFooterSizeY))
	
	elseif self.UILayout:IsA("UITableLayout") then
		self.ScrollingFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,0,(self.NumRows * (template.AbsoluteSize.Y + self.UILayout.Padding.Y.Offset)) + (internalHeaderSizeY + internalFooterSizeY))
	
	end	

		
	self.ScrollingFrame.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0,0)
	
	
	self:SetSelection(nil)
	
	
		
	if self.Footer or self.InternalFooter then
		print(#self.ListItems,"SAA")
		for i,itemData in ipairs(self.ListItems) do
			if itemData.Object.NextSelectionDown == nil then
				local footer = self.InternalFooter or self.Footer --internal comes first if it exists
				itemData.Object.NextSelectionDown = footer 
				footer.NextSelectionUp = itemData.Object --nextselectionup points to last object in list only
				print(itemData.Object,"HAHA")
			end
		end
		if self.Footer and self.InternalFooter then
			self.Footer.NextSelectionUp = self.InternalFooter
			self.InternalFooter.NextSelectionUp = self.Footer
		end
	end
	
	
	if self.Header or self.InternalHeader then
		for i,itemData in ipairs(self.ListItems) do
			if itemData.Object.NextSelectionUp == nil then
				local header = self.InternalHeader or self.Header --internal comes first if it exists
				itemData.Object.NextSelectionUp = header
				if header.NextSelectionDown == nil then --nextselectiondown points to first object in list only
					header.NextSelectionDown = itemData.Object
				end 
			end
		end
		if self.Header and self.InternalHeader then
			self.Header.NextSelectionDown = self.InternalHeader
			self.InternalHeader.NextSelectionDown = self.Header
		end
	end
	

	
	
end

SliderMinAndMax = 10 --how far the slider can go to the left or right in pixels
localMinPosition = SliderMinAndMax


function Slider:SetPositionAlpha(alpha)
	local object = self.object
	local bar = self.Object.Bar
	local dragger = self.Object.Dragger
	local newPosition = Utility:ConvertScale(alpha,{0,1},{localMinPosition,self.LocalMaxPosition})
	self.Object.Dragger.Position = UDim2.new(0,newPosition,.5,0)
	bar.Size = UDim2.new(0,dragger.Position.X.Offset,bar.Size.Y.Scale,bar.Size.Y.Offset)

function Slider:DragSlider(inputObjectPosX)
		local object = self.Object
		local dragger = self.Object.Dragger
		local localMaxPosition = object.AbsoluteSize.X - SliderMinAndMax
		
		local newPosition = (inputObjectPosX - object.AbsolutePosition.X) + self.DraggingOffsetX --Utility:ConvertScale(x,{absoluteMinPosition,abosoluteMaxPosition},{localMinPosition,localMaxPosition})
		dragger.Position = UDim2.new(0,newPosition,0.5,0)
			
			
		if dragger.Position.X.Offset > localMaxPosition then dragger.Position = UDim2.new(0,localMaxPosition,.5,0)  end
		if dragger.Position.X.Offset < localMinPosition then  dragger.Position = UDim2.new(0,localMinPosition,.5,0) end
			
		object.Bar.Size = UDim2.new(0,dragger.Position.X.Offset,object.Bar.Size.Y.Scale,object.Bar.Size.Y.Offset)
			
		self.PositionAlpha = Utility:ConvertScale(dragger.Position.X.Offset,{localMinPosition,localMaxPosition},{0,1})
			
		UIEvents.SliderMoved:Fire(self.WindowData.Object,object,self.PositionAlpha)
	
end


function Slider.new(object,windowData,initialValue)
		
		
	local this = {}
	setmetatable(this, Slider)
	this.Object = object
	this.Type = "Slider"
	this.IsOn = initialValue
	this.WindowData = windowData
	this.PositionAlpha = initialValue
	this.DraggerSize = object.Dragger.Size.X.Offset
	this.LocalMaxPosition = object.AbsoluteSize.X - SliderMinAndMax
	this.DraggingOffsetX = 0
	
	object.Dragger.MouseEnter:connect(function()
		object.Dragger.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
	end)
	
	object.Dragger.MouseLeave:connect(function()
		object.Dragger.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(230/255,230/255,230/255)
	end)
	

	
	local draggerSize = object.Dragger.Size.X.Offset
	local dragger = object.Dragger
	local bar = object.Bar
	
	
	local draggerPositionY = object.Dragger.Position.Y.Offset
	
	local lastPositionAlpha = initialValue
	
	if initialValue then
		this:SetPositionAlpha(initialValue)
	end
	
	
	
	local inputChanged
	local inputBegan
	local inputEnded
	local selectionGained
	local selectionLost

	
	
	
	local function InputChanged(inputObject, gameProccess)

		if  gameProccess and inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			if TouchEnabled then
				if not Utility:PointInsideGui(this.WindowData.Object,inputObject.Position) then
					UIEvents.SliderStopped:Fire(windowData.Object,object,this.PositionAlpha)
					inputChanged:disconnect()
					return
				end
			end
			
			this:DragSlider(inputObject.Position.X)
			
		
		end
		
	end
	
	
	
	UIEvents.WindowVisibilityChanged.Event:connect(function(window,visible)
		--when the window that contains this slider is opened, set connecitons
		if visible and window == windowData.Object then
			
			inputBegan = dragger.InputBegan:connect(function(inputObject, gameProccess)
				if inputChanged then inputChanged:disconnect() end
				if not gameProccess and inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
					this.DraggingOffsetX = (dragger.AbsolutePosition.X + (draggerSize/2)) - inputObject.Position.X
					inputChanged = UIS.InputChanged:connect(InputChanged)
				end
			end)
			
			
			--dont detect input ended on mobile
			if not TouchEnabled then
				
				inputEnded = dragger.InputEnded:connect(function(inputObject, gameProccess)
					if inputChanged and (inputObject.Position.Y <= 4 or (not gameProccess and (inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch))) then
						if inputChanged then inputChanged:disconnect() end
						if lastPositionAlpha ~= this.PositionAlpha then
							lastPositionAlpha = this.PositionAlpha
							UIEvents.SliderStopped:Fire(window,object,this.PositionAlpha)
						end
					end
				end)
				
			end
			
			
			
			if Enums.GamepadEnabled then

				local x,y,direction


				local function MoveSliderGamepad(direction)
					
					local INCREMENT = 10
					local PixelRange = this.LocalMaxPosition - localMinPosition
					local increment = PixelRange / INCREMENT
					
					this:DragSlider(dragger.AbsolutePosition.X + (dragger.AbsoluteSize.X/2) + (direction * increment))
				end
				
			
			
				selectionGained = dragger.SelectionGained:connect(function()

					GamepadInputBegan = UIS.InputBegan:connect(function(inputObject,gameProcessed)
										
						if inputObject.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.DPadLeft then
							MoveSliderGamepad(-1)
									
						elseif inputObject.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.DPadRight then
							MoveSliderGamepad(1)
								
						end
					end)	
						
						
					GamepadInputChanged = UIS.InputChanged:connect(function(inputObject,gameProcessed)

						if inputObject.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick1 then
							x = inputObject.Position.X
							y = inputObject.Position.Y
							if math.sqrt(math.pow(x,2)+math.pow(y,2)) > .7 then --if thumbstick is nearing the edge.
								if direction == nil then
									if x > -.5 and x < .5 then
										if y > 0 then
											direction = "Up"
										else
											direction = "Down"
										end
									elseif x > .5 then
										direction = "Right"
									elseif x < -.5 then
										direction = "Left"
									end
										
									if direction == "Right" then  --move left and right
										MoveSliderGamepad(1)
									elseif direction == "Left" then
										MoveSliderGamepad(-1)
									end	
								end
										
										
							else
								direction = nil
							end
						end
					end)
					
					
					
						
				end)
				
				selectionLost = dragger.SelectionLost:connect(function()
					if GamepadInputBegan then GamepadInputBegan:disconnect() end
					if GamepadInputChanged then GamepadInputChanged:disconnect() end

				end)
				
			end
			
			
			
		elseif not visible and window == windowData.Object then
			if inputChanged then inputChanged:disconnect() end
			if inputBegan then inputBegan:disconnect() end
			if inputEnded then inputEnded:disconnect() end
			if selectionGained then selectionGained:disconnect() end
			if selectionLost then selectionLost:disconnect() end

	this.Type = "RadialMenu"
	this.WindowData = guiManager:GetWindowDataByName(object.Name)
	this.Options = nil
	this.SelectionMode = false
	this.Selection = nil
	this.HighlightedIndex = nil
	
	this.UnselectedNodes = {object:WaitForChild("TopLeft"),object:WaitForChild("Top"),object:WaitForChild("TopRight"),object:WaitForChild("BottomRight"),object:WaitForChild("Bottom"),object:WaitForChild("BottomLeft")}
	this.SelectedNodes = {object:WaitForChild("TopLeftSelected"),object:WaitForChild("TopSelected"),object:WaitForChild("TopRightSelected"),object:WaitForChild("BottomRightSelected"),object:WaitForChild("BottomSelected"),object:WaitForChild("BottomLeftSelected")}

function RadialMenu:GetSelection()
	local x,y,deg,highlightedIndex 
	
	self.Object.RadialLabel.Visible = false
	
	local function ThumbstickMoved(str,UserInputState,inputObject)
		--print(math.abs(inputObject.Position.Y)+math.abs(inputObject.Position.X))
		x = inputObject.Position.X
		y = inputObject.Position.Y
		if math.sqrt(math.pow(x,2)+math.pow(y,2)) > .7 then
			deg = math.deg(math.atan2(y,x))
			highlightedIndex = self.HighlightedIndex
			for i,range in ipairs(ranges) do
				if deg > range[2] and deg < range[1] and i ~= highlightedIndex then -- and i ~= 1 then --REMOVE i~=1 to enabled pets
					if highlightedIndex then
						self.SelectedNodes[highlightedIndex].Visible = false
						self.UnselectedNodes[highlightedIndex].Visible = true
					end
					
					self.SelectedNodes[i].Visible = true
					self.UnselectedNodes[i].Visible = false
					
					self.Object.RadialLabel.Visible = true
					
					local text = self.Options[i]
					self.Object.RadialLabel.Text = (text == "PetPanel" and "Pets") or (text == "Catalog" and "Shop") or text
					
					self.HighlightedIndex = i
				end
			end
		end
	end
	
	local function Thumbstick2Moved(str,UserInputState,inputObject)
	end
	
	local function AButtonPressed(actionName,InputState,InputObject)
		if InputState == Enum.UserInputState.End and self.HighlightedIndex then
			self.Selection = self.Options[self.HighlightedIndex]
			self.SelectionMode = false
		end
	end
	
	local function BButtonPressed()
		self.Selection = nil
		self.SelectionMode = false
	end
	
	CAS:BindAction("ThumbstickMoved", ThumbstickMoved, false, Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick1)
	CAS:BindAction("Thumbstick2Moved", Thumbstick2Moved, false, Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick2)
	CAS:BindAction("AButton", AButtonPressed, false, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA)
	CAS:BindAction("BButton", BButtonPressed, false, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB)

	
	self.Selection = nil
	self.SelectionMode = true
	
	while self.SelectionMode do
		wait(.1)
	end
		
	self.WindowData:SetVisible(false)
	
	self:CancelSelection()
	
	return self.Selection
end

function RadialMenu:SetOptions(options)
	self.Options = options
end

function RadialMenu:CancelSelection()
	self.SelectionMode = false
	CAS:UnbindAction("ThumbstickMoved")
	CAS:UnbindAction("Thumbstick2Moved")
	CAS:UnbindAction("BButton")
	CAS:UnbindAction("AButton")
end

function DropdownMenu.new(dropdownButton,windowData)

	local this = {}
	setmetatable(this, DropdownMenu)
	this.Object = dropdownButton
	this.Type = "DropDownMenu"
	this.WindowData = windowData
	this.List = {}
	this.TextButtons = {}
	this.ScrollingFrame = dropdownButton:WaitForChild("ScrollingFrame")
	this.SelectedOption = dropdownButton:WaitForChild("SelectedOption")
	this.Template = dropdownButton:WaitForChild("Template")
	this.MaxScreenCoverageScaleY = .5  -- .5 takes up half the screen 


	
	this.Object.MouseButton1Down:connect(function()

		local ScrollFrame = this.ScrollingFrame
		local Template = this.Template
		
		UIEvents.DropDownMenuOpened:Fire(this.WindowData.Object)
		
		if not ScrollFrame.Visible then
			ScrollFrame.Visible = true
			
			
			for i,optionName in ipairs(this.List) do
				local newButton = Template:clone()
				newButton.OptionName.Text = optionName
				newButton.Parent = ScrollFrame
				newButton.Visible = true
				newButton.Selectable = false
				
				if _G.GamepadEnabled then
					local previousButton = this.TextButtons[i-1]
					if previousButton then
						newButton.NextSelectionUp =  previousButton--previous button
						previousButton.NextSelectionDown = newButton
					end
					if newButton.OptionName.Text == this.SelectedOption.Text then
						GuiService.SelectedObject = newButton
					end
				end
				
				
				local originalColor = newButton.BackgroundColor3
				local originalTextColor = newButton.OptionName.TextColor3
			
				newButton.MouseButton1Click:connect(function()
					if _G.GamepadEnabled then
						GuiService.SelectedObject = dropdownButton
					end
					this.SelectedOption.Text = optionName
					this:Close()
					UIEvents.DropDownMenuOptionSelected:Fire(this.WindowData.Object,optionName)
				end)
				
				newButton.MouseEnter:connect(function()
					newButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(152/255, 152/255, 152/255)
					newButton.OptionName.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
				end)
				
				newButton.MouseLeave:connect(function()
					newButton.BackgroundColor3 = originalColor
					newButton.OptionName.TextColor3 = originalTextColor
				end)
					
				table.insert(this.TextButtons,newButton)
			end
			
			
			
			---Adjust Size Of Scrolling Frame
			local firstTextButton = this.TextButtons[1] 
			
			local listItemSize = (firstTextButton and firstTextButton.AbsoluteSize.Y) or 0 --template dosent have the accurate size, it changes when it goes inside the scrollingframe, get first item size instead
			
			local scrollSizeY = #this.List * listItemSize
			
			ScrollFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,0,scrollSizeY)
			
			--make the scroll frame the same size as the CanvasSize as long as it take up less than half (by default) the screen
			if scrollSizeY < MainGui.AbsoluteSize.Y * this.MaxScreenCoverageScaleY then
				ScrollFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1,10,0,scrollSizeY)

				
			--make scrolling frame take up half (by defualt) the screen as long at it dosent go off screen
			elseif ScrollFrame.AbsolutePosition.Y + (MainGui.AbsoluteSize.Y * this.MaxScreenCoverageScaleY) < MainGui.AbsoluteSize.Y then
				ScrollFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1,10,0,MainGui.AbsoluteSize.Y * this.MaxScreenCoverageScaleY)

			--make scrolling frame aligh to the bottom of the screen
			else
				ScrollFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1,10,0,MainGui.AbsoluteSize.Y - ScrollFrame.AbsolutePosition.Y)
			end
		else
			this:Close()
		end
	end)
	
	
	
	return this
end



function DropdownMenu:SetList(list,initialSelectionName)
	if list then
		self.List = list
		self:Close()
		self.SelectedOption.Text = initialSelectionName or list[1] or ""
	end
end

function DropdownMenu:Close()
	self.ScrollingFrame.Visible = false
	for _,button in ipairs(self.TextButtons) do
		button:Destroy()
	end
	self.TextButtons = {}
end

function TextInput.new(textInput,windowData)

	local this = {}
	setmetatable(this, TextInput)
	this.Object = textInput
	this.WindowData = windowData
	this.NumbersOnly = false
	this.LettersOnly = false
	this.SpacesAllowed = true
	this.PunctuationAllowed = true
	this.UnderscoresAllowed = true
	this.NumLines = 1
	this.MaxLength = 1000 -- characters
	this.MinLength = 3
	this.DefaultMessage = nil
	this.DefaultMessageColor = Color3.new(179/255, 179/255, 179/255)
	this.TextColor = textInput.TextColor
	this.FilteredString = nil
	this.UnfilteredText = nil
	this.IsValid = false
	this.ExludedCharacters = nil
	this.IsHashtagedTextValid = true
	this.NeedsToBeFiltered = true
	
	return this
	
end


function TextInput:Initialize()
	
	local object = self.Object
	
	object.TextScaled = false
	object.TextSize = math.floor(object.AbsoluteSize.Y / self.NumLines) -2
	
	if self.DefaultMessage then
		object.TextColor = self.DefaultMessageColor
		object.Text = self.DefaultMessage
	end
	


	object.Focused:connect(function()
		if object.Text == self.DefaultMessage then
			object.Text = ""
			object.TextColor = self.TextColor
		end
	end)
	
	
	
	
	object.FocusLost:connect(function()
		
		
		if string.len(object.Text) < self.MinLength then
			self.Object.ErrorTextLabel.Text = "Too short"
			return
		end
		
		if self.NeedsToBeFiltered then
			self.UnfilteredText = object.Text
			self.FilteredText = workspace.Main.FilterString:InvokeServer(nil,object.Text)
			object.Text = self.FilteredText
			if string.find(self.FilteredText,"##") and not self.IsHashtagedTextValid then
				self.Object.ErrorTextLabel.Text = "Some of the text was filtered. Try again using different words."
				return
			end
		end
		
		
		self.IsValid = true
		
		UIEvents.TextInputChanged:Fire(self.WindowData.Object,self.Object,object.Text)
		UIEvents.TextInputFocusLost:Fire(self.WindowData.Object,self.Object,object.Text)
		
	end)
	
	
	
	
	
	object:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):connect(function()
		
		self.IsValid = false
		
		if string.len(object.Text) > self.MaxLength then
			object.Text = string.sub(1,self.MaxLength)
			return
		end
		--this part has not been tested, may not work
		local pattern = ""
		if self.NumbersOnly then
			pattern = pattern .. "%d"
		elseif self.LettersOnly then
			pattern = pattern .."%a"
			
			if self.SpacesAllowed then
				pattern = pattern .. "%s"
			end
			
		else
			pattern = pattern .."%w" --alpha numeric
			
			if self.SpacesAllowed then
				pattern = pattern .. "%s"
			end
			
			if self.PunctuationAllowed then
				pattern = pattern .. "%p"
			end
		
		end
		
		if self.ExludedCharacters then
			object.Text = object.Text:gsub("[" .. self.ExludedCharacters .. "]+", "")
		end
		
		object.Text = object.Text:gsub("[^" .. pattern .. "]+", "")
		
		UIEvents.TextInputChanged:Fire(self.WindowData.Object,self.Object,object.Text)
		
	end)

end
	
	


function TextInput:IsValid()
	return self.IsValid
end

function TextInput:Reset()
	if self.DefaultMessage then
		self.Object.TextColor = self.DefaultMessageColor
		self.Object.Text = self.DefaultMessage
	else
		self.Object.Text = ""
	end
end

function workspace.PetService.GetRandomPetWithinRange.OnInvoke(range,this)
	local pets = {}
	for _,pet in ipairs(Pets[this.Owner]) do
		if this ~= pet and this.Object and (this.Object.Position - pet.Object.Position).magnitude < range then
			table.insert(pets,pet)
		end
	end
	if #pets == 0 then return nil end
	return pets[math.random(1,#pets)]
end


function workspace.PetService.Command.OnServerInvoke(player,petName,action)
	local Pet = GetPetByName(player,petName)
	if Pet and Pet.Active and Pet.State ~= "Sleeping" and Pet.State ~= "Destroyed" then
		if action == "Stop" then
			Pet.State = "Follow"
		elseif action == "Hold" then
			Pet.State = "Holding"
		elseif action == "Stay" then
			Pet.State = "Staying"
			Pet.Object.Stay.Value = true
		elseif action == "StopCommand" then
			if Pet.State == "Holding" then
				Pet.State = "Follow"
			end
		end
	else 
		return false
	end
	return true
end



function workspace.PetService.ToggleActive.OnServerInvoke(player,petName)
	local Pet = GetPetByName(player,petName)
	if Pet then
		if Pet.State == "Destroyed" then return Pet.Active end
		if Pet and not Pet.Active then  --if about to be activated
			local activePetsCount = 0
			for name,pet in pairs(Pets[player]) do
				if pet.Active then
					activePetsCount = activePetsCount + 1
				end
			end
			if activePetsCount >= MaxNumPets then
				return nil
			end
		end
		return Pet:SetActive(not Pet.Active)
	end
	return false
end



function workspace.PetService.GetPetData.OnServerInvoke(player)
	while petDataLoaded[player] == nil do wait(.1) end
	if not Pets[player] then return {} end
	local petData = {}
	for _,pet in pairs(Pets[player]) do
		table.insert(petData,PackagePetData(pet))
	end
	return petData
end

local inactivityTimer = {}

function updateJobsCompleted(player,job)
	if player ~= nil and Players[player] ~= nil then
		local player_data = Players[player]
		
		local jobs = player_data["Jobs_Completed"]
		if jobs[job] ~= nil then
			jobs[job] = jobs[job] + 1
		else
			jobs[job] = 1
		end
		
		--if player doesnt work for 5 mintues, then put them on break except for managers
		if player ~= Manager.CurrentManager then
			local timer = inactivityTimer[player]
			if timer == nil then
				timer = Timer.new()
				timer:Start(300)
				timer:OnFinish(function()
					inactivityTimer[player] = nil
					if player and player.Parent and player ~= Manager.CurrentManager then
						Players[player]:SetJob("On Break")
					end
				end)
				inactivityTimer[player] = timer
			else
				timer:Reset()
			end
		end


		game.workspace.Main.RefreshJobsCompleted:FireClient(player,jobs)
		
		return jobs
	end
end

function orderCheckerTouched(hit)
	
	
	local function changeIngredientSupply(amount,toppings,hit)
		if hit.Name == "Dough" then
			if toppings:FindFirstChild("MeltedCheese") or toppings:FindFirstChild("Cheese") then
				changeSupply("Cheese",amount)
			end
			if toppings:FindFirstChild("TomatoSauce") then
				changeSupply("TomatoSauce",amount)
			end
			if toppings:FindFirstChild("Sausage") then
				changeSupply("Sausage",amount)
			end
			if toppings:FindFirstChild("Pepperoni") then
				changeSupply("Pepperoni",amount)
			end
		elseif hit.Name == "MountainDew" then
			changeSupply("MountainDew",amount)
		end
	end
	
	
	 if not order_checker_debounce and hit ~= nil and hit.Parent ~= nil and last_hit ~= hit and not hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
		order_checker_debounce = true
		delay(.3,function() order_checker_debounce = false end)
		last_hit = hit
		local toppings = nil
		if hit.Name == "Dough" then
			toppings = hit.SG.Frame
		else--if mountain dew
			toppings = hit
		end
		if (hit.Name == "Dough" and toppings:FindFirstChild("MeltedCheese") and toppings:FindFirstChild("TomatoSauce")) or hit.Name == "MountainDew" then
			
			local pepperoni = toppings:FindFirstChild("Pepperoni")
			local sausage = toppings:FindFirstChild("Sausage")
			
			if not pepperoni and not sausage and hit.Name ~= "MountainDew" then
				order_type = 1
			elseif pepperoni and not sausage then
				order_type = 2
			elseif not pepperoni and sausage then
				order_type = 3
			elseif hit.Name == "MountainDew" then
				order_type = 4
			end
			local order,order_index = findOrder("Order",order_type,2)
			if order ~= nil then
				changeIngredientSupply(-1,toppings,hit)
				updateJobsCompleted(hit.LastDragger.Value,"Cook")

				refreshLock = true  --stop order board from refreshing
				if hit.Name == "Dough" then  --move to boxing model
					hit.Name = "Pizza"
					hit.Parent = workspace.BoxingRoom
				else
					hit.Name = "Dew"
					hit.Parent = workspace.BoxingRoom
					delay(1,function () hit.Size = Vector3.new(2,1.2,2) end)
				end
				num_orders_on_board = num_orders_on_board - 1

				SoundFX:PlaySoundInsideZone("Correct","Cook")

				local order_image = order_board_decals[order.Order]
				local img = nil
				for i,v in ipairs(board_objects) do--find anything that matches on order board and show check mark
					if v.SG.ImageLabel.Image == order_image then
						img = v.SG.ImageLabel
						v.SG.ImageLabel.Image = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=168401336"
						v.Sparkles.Enabled = true
						break
					end
				end
				order.Phase = 3
				order.Object = hit
				wait(2)
				if img ~= nil then --remove the check mark
					img.Image = ""
					img.Parent.Parent.Sparkles.Enabled = false
				end
				refreshLock = false
				refreshOrderBoard()
				last_hit = nil
				return
			end
		end
		
		
		SoundFX:PlaySoundInsideZone("Incorrect","Cook")

		game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(hit,30)
		
		local x = game.ServerStorage.XBillboard:clone()
		x.Parent = hit
		x.Adornee = hit
			
		hit.Velocity = Vector3.new(-100,hit.Velocity.y,hit.Velocity.z)
			
		workspace.PizzaConvayor.Velocity = Vector3.new(-10,0,0)
		wait(.4)
		workspace.PizzaConvayor.Velocity = Vector3.new(0.01,0,0)
		wait(1)
		workspace.PizzaConvayor.Velocity = Vector3.new(10,0,0)
		x:Destroy()
		smoke(hit)
		
	end
	
end

		tool.Handle.Position = positions[math.random(1,#positions )]
		tool.Handle.Rotation = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
		tool.Order.Value = order.Order

		local equip = nil

			if tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") then 
				tool.Handle.Locked = true 
			end 
			equip:disconnect()
		end)
		
		if order.House then
			tool.House.Value = order.House
			tool.BringToHouse.Text = "Bring to house " .. order.House.Address.Value
			tool.TextureId = order.House and house_numbers_decals[order.House.Address.Value]
			
		else --if player's pizza
			tool.Name = "Pizza"
			tool.PlayerCustomer.Value = order.Customer
			tool.CanBeDropped = false
			tool.BringToHouse.Text = "Deliver to " .. order.Customer.Name
			tool.TextureId = order_board_decals[order.Order]
			local connection = nil
			connection = tool.Handle.Touched:connect(function(hit) PizzaTouched(hit,tool,connection) end)
		end

		--

		if not workspace.CheckMark.SG.Enabled then

			workspace.CheckMark.Sparkles.Enabled = true
			delay(2,function() workspace.CheckMark.SG.Enabled = false workspace.CheckMark.Sparkles.Enabled = false end)

function InFrontOfCashReigster(player,areaBlock)
	if player and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		local sizeX = areaBlock.Size.X
		local sizeZ = areaBlock.Size.Z
		local positionX = areaBlock.Position.X
		local positionZ = areaBlock.Position.Z
		local torsoPos = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
		
		if torsoPos.x > positionX - (sizeX/2) then
		if torsoPos.x < positionX + (sizeX/2) then
		if torsoPos.z > positionZ - (sizeZ/2) then
		if torsoPos.z < positionZ + (sizeZ/2) then
			return true
		end
		end
		end
		end
	end
	return false
end

local playerOrders = {}

function GetClosestPlayerAtRegisterWithOrder(cashier)
	
	local insideBounds = {}
	for _,player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if (player ~= cashier or player.Name == "Player1" or player.Name == "Player" or player.Name == "Player2" or player.Name == "Dued1") then
			if playerOrders[player] and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and player.userId > -3 then
				if InFrontOfCashReigster(player,workspace.CustomerBlock1) or InFrontOfCashReigster(player,workspace.CustomerBlock2) then
					table.insert(insideBounds,player)	
				end
			end
		end
	end
	
	local distance = 100000
	local closestPlayer = nil
	for _,player in ipairs(insideBounds) do
		local dis = player:DistanceFromCharacter(cashier.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
		if dis < distance then
			closestPlayer = player
			distance = dis
		end
	end
	return closestPlayer
end

local PurchaseHistory = (game.PlaceId ~= 0 and game:GetService("DataStoreService"):GetDataStore("PurchaseHistory"))

function ProcessReceipt (receiptInfo)
	print("Process stared")
	local userId = receiptInfo.PlayerId
	local purchaseId = receiptInfo.PurchaseId
	print(userId,purchaseId)
	local playerProductKey = userId .. ":" .. purchaseId
	local cancelPetKey = userId .. ":" .. purchaseId  .. "err"
	
	
	if PurchaseHistory and PurchaseHistory:GetAsync(playerProductKey) then
        return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted --We already granted it.
	
	elseif receiptInfo.ProductId == Enums.PetProductId and PurchaseHistory and PurchaseHistory:GetAsync(cancelPetKey) then --if pet errors then give refund
		--[[local seconds = PurchaseHistory:GetAsync(cancelPetKey)
		local daysLeft = 3 - math.floor((tick() - seconds) / 86400)
		workspace.MessageService.Dialog:InvokeClient(player,"You will automatically get a refund for your pet in " ..  " days.","Ok","")]]
		print("Pet purchase was already canceled")
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	
	
	local player = game.Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
	
	if not player then 
		print("Player = nil")
		script.PurchaseFinished:Fire(false)
		if receiptInfo.ProductId == Enums.PetProductId and PurchaseHistory then
			PurchaseHistory:SetAsync(cancelPetKey,true)
		end
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet 
	end
	
	
	
	local playerData = Players[player]
	
	if not playerData then 
		warn("PURCHASE ERROR Data data doesnt exist")
		Dialog:ShowMessage(player,"ERROR!", "There was an error. If you don't get your item within 3 days, you will automatically be refunded.")
		script.PurchaseFinished:Fire(false)
		if receiptInfo.ProductId == Enums.PetProductId and PurchaseHistory then
			PurchaseHistory:SetAsync(cancelPetKey,true)
		end
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet 
	end
	
	--get ahold of funtion
	local action
	for product_id,func in pairs(Products) do
		if product_id == receiptInfo.ProductId then
			action = func
			break
		end
	end
	
	--if gamepass
	if not action then return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted end
	
	
	
	
	--call it safely with pcall, to catch any error
	local success,result = pcall(action,receiptInfo,player,playerData,Products)

local throttle = {}
local function RecordError(message,trace,scriptObject,touchEnabled)
	if Enums.IsStudio or Enums.IsLocalServer or (scriptObject and scriptObject.Parent and scriptObject.Parent:FindFirstChild("Gear")) then return end
	local key = Utility:StringToUniqueNumber(trace)
	if (throttle[key] == nil or tick() - throttle[key] > 60) and not string.find(message,"during remote call") then
		for _,str in ipairs(ignoreList) do
			if string.match(message,str) then
				
				return
			end
		end
		for _,player in ipairs(game.Players:GetChildren()) do
			message = string.gsub(message,player.Name,"PLAYERNAME")
			trace = string.gsub(trace,player.Name,"PLAYERNAME")
		end
		local success,err = pcall(function()
			print("Unique ID",Utility:StringToUniqueNumber(trace))
			local data = {}
			data.error = message .. "\n" .. trace
			data.tablename = Enums.ErrorLogTableName
			data.groupid = Utility:StringToUniqueNumber(trace .. message)
			data.ismobilelocalscript = (scriptObject and scriptObject:IsA("LocalScript") and touchEnabled) or false
			data.serveruptimeinhours = workspace.DistributedGameTime / 3600
			data.isservererror = (scriptObject and not scriptObject:IsA("Script") and true) or false
			game:GetService("HttpService"):PostAsync("http://34.194.159.134/ErrorLog.php",game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(data))
			throttle[key] = tick()
		end)
		print("Saved error",err)
	else
		print("Throttled")
	end
end

local scriptStates = {}

local function LoadRobloxItem(player,assetId,category,dontEquip)

	local asset = AssetLibraryManager:GetAssetById(assetId)
	if asset then
		
		--unsellable items are devierly bike, paint bucket, hang glider
		local item = (asset.Unsellable and game.ServerStorage:FindFirstChild(asset.Name)) or game.ServerStorage.CatalogCache:FindFirstChild(asset.Name) or game.ServerStorage.CatalogCache:FindFirstChild(tostring(assetId))
	
	
		if not item then --if item in not in cache, then load one
			pcall(function()
				item = game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadAsset(assetId):GetChildren()[1]	
			end)
			if item then	
				
				item.Name = asset.Name
				
				local clone = item:clone()
				clone.Parent = game.ServerStorage.CatalogCache
				
				--disable scripts and save original state
				scriptStates[item.Name] = {}
				for _,obj in ipairs(clone:GetChildren()) do
					if obj:IsA("Script") and not obj.Disabled then
						scriptStates[item.Name][obj.Name] = true
						obj.Disabled = true
					end
				end
				
				--Utility:PrintTable(scriptStates)
				
				
			else
				return nil
			end
		else
			item = item:clone()
		end
		
		
			 
		if category == "Hats" then
			item.Parent = player.Character
			
			
			
		elseif category == "Packages" then
			local pack = game.ServerStorage.CatalogCache:FindFirstChild(assetId)
			if pack ~= nil then
				Utility:ClearChildrenByClassName(player.Character,"CharacterMesh","Hat")
				for i,v in ipairs(pack:GetChildren()) do
					v:clone().Parent = player.Character
				end
			end
				
		elseif category == "Gear" then
			
			local function lowerVolume(gear)
				for _,v in ipairs(gear:GetChildren()) do
					if v:IsA("Sound") then
						v.Volume = v.Volume / 3
					end
					lowerVolume(v)
				end
			end
			
			--put marker letting backpack know not to equip
			if dontEquip then
				local auto = Instance.new("IntValue")
				auto.Name = "DontAutoEquip"
				auto.Parent = item
			end
			
			if asset.Name == "ROBLOX Skateboard" or asset.Name == "Beach Ball" or asset.Name == "ROBLOX U Frisbee" then
				local gearOwner = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
				gearOwner.Value = player
				gearOwner.Name = "GearOwner"
				gearOwner.Parent = item
			end
			
			--reenable scripts
			if scriptStates[item.Name] then
				for scriptName,_ in pairs(scriptStates[item.Name]) do
					item:FindFirstChild(scriptName).Disabled = false
				end
			end
			
			local g = Instance.new("IntValue")
			g.Name = "Gear"
			g.Value = assetId
			spawn(function() lowerVolume(item) end)
			g.Parent = item
		
			item.Parent = player.Backpack			
			item.CanBeDropped = false
		end
		
	
		
		return item
	end
end

function GetAllConnectedParts(Object)
	local Parts = {}
	local function GetConnectedParts(Object)
		for i, v in pairs(Object:GetConnectedParts()) do
			local Ignore = false
			for ii, vv in pairs(Parts) do
				if v == vv then
					Ignore = true
				end
			end
			if not Ignore then
				table.insert(Parts, v)
				GetConnectedParts(v)
			end
		end
	end
	GetConnectedParts(Object)
	return Parts
end

function ThrustUpdater()
	
	for i, v in pairs(CurrentSpeed) do
		CurrentSpeed[i] = 0
	end
	for i, v in pairs(Controls) do
		Controls[i].Mode = false
	end

	while ToolEquipped and Body and Body.Parent and CheckIfAlive() and RotationForce and RotationForce.Parent and ThrustForce and ThrustForce.Parent and TurnGyro and TurnGyro.Parent do
		
		RotationForce.angularvelocity = Vector3.new(0, CurrentSpeed.Turn, 0)
		if math.abs(CurrentSpeed.Turn) > Speed.TurnSpeed.AlphaDampening then
			CurrentSpeed.Turn = (CurrentSpeed.Turn - (Speed.TurnSpeed.AlphaDampening * (math.abs(CurrentSpeed.Turn) / CurrentSpeed.Turn)))
		else 
			CurrentSpeed.Turn = 0		
		end
				
		if not Controls.Forward.Mode or Controls.Backward.Mode then --Slow down if not controlling.
			CurrentSpeed.Movement = (CurrentSpeed.Movement * 0.99)
		end
		
		local MySpeed = Vector3.new(Body.Velocity.X, 0, Body.Velocity.Z).magnitude
		local VelocityDifference = math.abs((MySpeed - (ThrustForce.velocity.magnitude)))
		if MySpeed > 3 and ThrustForce.velocity.magnitude > 3 and VelocityDifference > (0.7 * ThrustForce.velocity.magnitude) then
			CurrentSpeed.Movement = (CurrentSpeed.Movement * 0.9)
		end
		
		if Controls.Forward.Mode then --Handle acceleration
			CurrentSpeed.Movement = math.min(MaxSpeed.Movement.Max, (CurrentSpeed.Movement + (MaxSpeed.Acceleration * Rate)))
		end
		if Controls.Backward.Mode then --Handle deceleration, if speed is more than 0, decrease quicker.
			CurrentSpeed.Movement = math.max(-MaxSpeed.Movement.Min, (CurrentSpeed.Movement - (MaxSpeed.Deceleration * ((CurrentSpeed.Movement > 0 and 2.8) or 1) * Rate)))
		end
		
		if thumbstickPosition then --that means its gamepad
			local turn = (CurrentSpeed.Turn + (Speed.TurnSpeed.TurnAlpha * -thumbstickPosition.X))
			if thumbstickPosition.X < 0 then
				CurrentSpeed.Turn = math.min(Speed.TurnSpeed.Speed.Max, turn)
			else
				CurrentSpeed.Turn = math.max(-Speed.TurnSpeed.Speed.Min, turn)
			end

		else

			if Controls.Left.Mode then --Handle left turn speed
				CurrentSpeed.Turn = math.min(Speed.TurnSpeed.Speed.Max, (CurrentSpeed.Turn + (Speed.TurnSpeed.TurnAlpha)))
			end
			if Controls.Right.Mode then --Handle right turn speed
				CurrentSpeed.Turn = math.max(-Speed.TurnSpeed.Speed.Min, (CurrentSpeed.Turn - (Speed.TurnSpeed.TurnAlpha)))
			end
		end
		
		local Direction = Torso.CFrame.lookVector
		Direction = Vector3.new(Direction.x, 0, Direction.z).unit
		
		local Velocity = (Direction * CurrentSpeed.Movement) --The thrust force which you move.
		
		if script.Parent.Handle.Position.Y < -8 then  --if underwater
			ToolEquipped = false--	ThrustForce.velocity  = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
			script.Parent.Parent = workspace
			Handle:SetNetworkOwner(Player)
			delay(40,function()
				script.Parent:Destroy()
			end)
			ThrustForce.maxForce = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
			break
		else
			ThrustForce.velocity = Vector3.new(Velocity.X, ThrustForce.velocity.Y, Velocity.Z)
		end
		
		local LeanAmount = (-CurrentSpeed.Turn * (math.pi / 6) / 4) --Amount your character leans over.
		local XZAngle = math.atan2(Torso.CFrame.lookVector.z, 0, Torso.CFrame.lookVector.x) --Handle rotation
		TurnGyro.cframe = CFrame.Angles((LeanAmount * Direction.x), 0, (LeanAmount * Direction.z))
		
		--Wheel animation
		local DesiredAngle = (999999999 * (-CurrentSpeed.Movement / math.abs(CurrentSpeed.Movement)))
		local MaxVelocity = (CurrentSpeed.Movement / 250)
		for i, v in pairs({FrontMotor, BackMotor}) do
			if v and v.Parent then
				v.DesiredAngle = DesiredAngle
				v.MaxVelocity = MaxVelocity
			end
		end
		
		--Smoke exhaust from vehicle running.
		for i, v in pairs(ExhaustSmoke) do
			if v and v.Parent then
				v.Opacity = ((math.min(math.abs(CurrentSpeed.Movement), 10) / 10) * 0.5)
			end
		end
		
		--Engine running sound which pitch changes while in motion.
		Sounds.Engine.Pitch = (1 + (math.abs(CurrentSpeed.Movement / MaxSpeed.Movement.Max) * 1))
		
		
		
		wait(Rate)
		
	end
end

function OnServerInvoke(player, mode, value)
	if player == Player and ToolEquipped and value and CheckIfAlive() then
		if mode == "GamepadThumbstickMove" then
			thumbstickPosition = value.Position
		end
		
		if mode == "KeyPress" then
			local Down = value.Down
			local Key = value.Key
			local ByteKey = string.byte(Key)
			for i, v in pairs(Controls) do
				if Key == v.Key or ByteKey == v.ByteKey then
					Controls[i].Mode = Down
				end
			end
			if Key == " " and Down then --Jump controller
				if math.abs(tick() - Jump.LastJump) > Jump.ReloadTime and not Jump.Jumping and ThrustForce and ThrustForce.Parent then
					Jump.Jumping = true
					local Parts = GetAllConnectedParts(Body)
					local Mass = 0
					for i, v in pairs(Parts) do
						Mass = (Mass + v:GetMass())
					end
					ThrustForce.maxForce = Vector3.new(ThrustForce.maxForce.X, ((Mass * Gravity) * 100), ThrustForce.maxForce.Z)
					ThrustForce.velocity = (Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) * Jump.JumpForce) + Vector3.new(ThrustForce.velocity.X, 0, ThrustForce.velocity.Z)
					wait(0.1)
					ThrustForce.maxForce = Vector3.new(ThrustForce.maxForce.X, 0, ThrustForce.maxForce.Z)
					ThrustForce.velocity = Vector3.new(ThrustForce.velocity.X, 0, ThrustForce.velocity.Z)
					Jump.LastJump = tick()
					Jump.Jumping = false
				end
			elseif Key == "x" and Down then --Toggle light(s) on/off.
				for i, v in pairs(Lights) do
					if v and v.Parent then
						v.Enabled = not v.Enabled
					end
				end
			elseif Key == "h" and Down then --Play honk sound.
				local Sound = Sounds.Honk
				if (tick() - Honk.LastHonk) >= (Sound.TimeLength + Honk.ReloadTime) and not Honk.Honking then
					Honk.Honking = true
					local TempSound = Sound:Clone()
					Debris:AddItem(TempSound, Sound.TimeLength)
					TempSound.Parent = Body
					TempSound:Play()
					Honk.LastHonk = tick()
					Honk.Honking = false
				end
			elseif Key == "q" and Down then --Activate special.
				if not Special.Allowed or not Special.Enabled or Special.Active then
					return
				end
				Special.Enabled = false
				Special.Active = true
				wait(Special.Duration)
				Special.Active = false
				wait(Special.ReloadTime)
				Special.Enabled = true
			elseif ByteKey == 48 and Down then --Activate speed boost.
				if not SpeedBoost.Allowed or not SpeedBoost.Enabled or SpeedBoost.Active then
					return
				end
				SpeedBoost.Enabled = false
				SpeedBoost.Active = true
				for i, v in pairs(Sparkles) do
					if v and v.Parent then
						v.Enabled = true
					end
				end
				MaxSpeed.Acceleration = Speed.Acceleration.Boost
				MaxSpeed.Deceleration = Speed.Deceleration.Boost
				MaxSpeed.Movement = Speed.MovementSpeed.Boost
				wait(SpeedBoost.Duration)
				MaxSpeed.Acceleration = Speed.Acceleration.Normal
				MaxSpeed.Deceleration = Speed.Deceleration.Normal
				MaxSpeed.Movement = Speed.MovementSpeed.Normal
				for i, v in pairs(Sparkles) do
					if v and v.Parent then
						v.Enabled = false
					end
				end
				SpeedBoost.Active = false
				wait(SpeedBoost.ReloadTime)
				SpeedBoost.Enabled = true
			end
		end
	end
end

	local ClientReturn = nil
	pcall(function()
		ClientReturn = ClientControl:InvokeClient(Player, Mode, Value)
	end)
	return ClientReturn
end

	if player and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then

		local sizeZ = areaBlock.Size.Z
		local positionX = areaBlock.Position.X

		if torsoPos.x > positionX - (sizeX/2) then

function distance(to,from)
		if to == nil or from == nil then return 10000 end

	return (to.Position - from.Position).magnitude
end

	if workspace:FindFirstChild("Trucks") == nil then return true end
	local trucks = workspace.Trucks:GetChildren()
	if (#trucks >= 1 and distance(script.Parent,trucks[1]:FindFirstChild("Bottom")) < 60) or (#trucks == 2 and distance(script.Parent,trucks[2]:FindFirstChild("Bottom")) < 60) then
		return true
	else
		return false
	end
end

		pos = script.Parent.Position

		for i=0,loop,1.2 do

		end
		lockGate = false
